etymology.historical_story: The word brings physical and social support into the same lexical family. Sokong supplies the idea of holding something up, while peN- forms a noun naming a supporter or supporting implement. Malay therefore uses penyokong for both structural supports and people whose help or loyalty sustains a team, person, or cause. [DBP: penyokong](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=penyokong)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sokong 想成“撑住”：penyokong 可以撑住一根梁，也可以用行动撑住一支球队。

morphology.pattern_note: 爪哇语整词借入，不按现代马来语词缀拆分。ng 表示单一鼻音 /ŋ/；é 为 e taling /e/。音节据词典标音补全。

word_family.gloss: 诸位王子或贵族；整词重叠表示复数

senses.zh_definition: 王族子弟或贵族的称号，尤见于爪哇及相关宫廷传统；具体身份须依当地制度判断。
senses.en_definition: A title for a prince, member of a royal family, or noble, especially in Javanese court traditions.
senses.ms_definition: Gelaran untuk anak atau keluarga raja dan orang besar.
senses.nuances: 属于身份称号，不一定指王储，也不必然仅指国王的亲生儿子。马来西亚语境常见于历史、文学及区域王室报道。文莱 Pengiran 有其具体身份规则，引用姓名时应保留本人正式拼写。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=pangeran)、[Pengiran 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pengiran)。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合历史、文学、宫廷文化及人物介绍。称号置于人名前时通常大写，如 Pangeran Diponegoro；泛指身份时小写。不要把 pangeran 与文莱 Pengiran 随意替换。

etymology.historical_story: DBP identifies pangeran as a Javanese borrowing and records its use for royal relatives and nobles. Its learner’s dictionary also mentions Java and Brunei. The word therefore carries a regional courtly setting: translating it simply as prince can conceal differences between royal descent, noble standing, and local titles. Its spelling should follow the historical person or institution concerned. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=pangeran)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pa-ngé-ran 三拍配上画面：宫门打开，一位王族贵人走来。整词记作“王族或贵族称号”。

morphology.formula: ∅ + penentang → penentang（按输入包的词根标注保留）
morphology.pattern_note: is_root、root_word及零词缀分析仅保留输入包的标注，不代表实际构词分析。实际为 peN- + tentang → penentang：peN- 在 t 前实现为 pen-，词根首音 t 脱落，第二个 t 保留。DBP 将其列入 tentang 的派生词族。[DBP：penentang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=penentang)。

senses.zh_definition: 反对某种意见、政策、行动或权力的人、团体等；反对者，抵抗者。
senses.en_definition: A person, group, or other entity that opposes or resists something; an opponent.
senses.ms_definition: Orang dan sebagainya yang menentang.
senses.nuances: 指持反对立场的主体，常见于政策争议、社会运动和历史叙述。词义本身不表示违法、暴力或敌对，也不专指国会反对党成员。与表示反对行为的 penentangan 区分。[DBP：penentang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=penentang)。

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合明确存在反对立场的新闻、历史和政策讨论。不要仅因别人提出问题就称其为 penentang；需要区分批评、反对与敌意。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 直接称某人为 penentang 可能显得在给对方贴阵营标签。职场讨论具体分歧时，可说 pihak yang tidak bersetuju（持不同意见的一方）。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合明确存在反对立场的新闻、历史和政策讨论。不要仅因别人提出问题就称其为 penentang；需要区分批评、反对与敌意。

etymology.historical_story: Penentang belongs to the Malay family built on tentang in its opposing or confronting sense. The productive agent prefix peN- identifies whoever performs that action, while nasal substitution removes the root's initial t. In historical writing, penentang penjajahan describes people resisting colonial rule; in contemporary reporting, the same formation identifies opponents of policies, proposals, or projects.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 menentang（反对）和 penentang（反对者）配对记：meN- 看行动，peN- 找行动者。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语整词，在马来语夹杂英语时使用；不作马来语词缀拆分。原包的 various translations 并非音节划分；英语读作一个音节，词首 /pl/ 为辅音连缀。

senses.zh_definition: 地方；地点；场所；口语中也可指某人的住处。标准马来语通常用 tempat，住处可用 rumah。
senses.en_definition: A location, area, or premises; informally, someone's home.
senses.ms_definition: Kata bahasa Inggeris yang merujuk kepada tempat, kawasan atau premis; dalam penggunaan tidak formal, juga rumah seseorang.
senses.nuances: 这是英语词，不能仅凭词频认定为标准马来语词。正式马来文用 tempat、lokasi 或 rumah，按语境选择。搭配列出马来语对应表达，括号内为英语搭配。释义为编写的马来文说明，并非 DBP 原文；official 沿用指定数据标签，不表示 DBP 收词认证。词义与读音参见 [Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/place)。

senses.zh_definition: 位置；座位；名额；比赛名次，具体对应词随语境而变。
senses.en_definition: A position, seat, available admission, or rank in a competition.
senses.ms_definition: Kedudukan, tempat duduk, tempat yang tersedia untuk kemasukan, atau kedudukan dalam pertandingan.
senses.nuances: 比赛的 first place 通常对应 tempat pertama；座位对应 tempat duduk；不能将所有用法机械译成 lokasi。[Cambridge Dictionary](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/place)。

collocations.ms: tempat di universiti (a place at university)

senses.zh_definition: 把某物放置在某处；安排或确定其位置。
senses.en_definition: To put or arrange someone or something in a particular position.
senses.ms_definition: Meletakkan atau menempatkan seseorang atau sesuatu pada kedudukan tertentu.
senses.nuances: 英语动词 place 的马来语对应词常为 meletakkan、menempatkan 或 menyusun，取决于动作。正式马来文使用这些对应词。[DBP 英马词典用例](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=melantik)。

collocations.ms: meletakkan dokumen di atas meja (place documents on the table)

etymology.historical_story: English place came through French from Latin platea, referring to a broad street or open space, ultimately linked to Greek wording for a broad way. Its meanings expanded from physical space to position and rank. In mixed Malay conversation, the English form may appear where standard Malay uses tempat. [Etymology reference](https://www.etymonline.com/word/place).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: place /pleɪs/：把地图上的一个点圈起来，就是一个“地方”；把东西放到那个点上，就是“放置”。

etymology.historical_story: Malay proverbial tradition contrasts a turtle laying many eggs quietly with a hen announcing a single egg noisily. DBP records this comparison as commentary on how people discuss the gains of the rich and poor differently. The animal therefore carries a cultural association with unnoticed abundance, beyond its everyday zoological meaning. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=penyu)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pe.nyu 分成两拍，ny 连成一个鼻音；边读边想海龟划动两只前鳍游向大海。

morphology.pattern_note: 这是英语词形，所列 IPA 为英式英语读音；不能据此确立马来语标准读音或马来语派生规则。

word_family.gloss: 英语相关词：采珠；采珠业

senses.zh_definition: 【英语】珍珠：某些软体动物体内形成的、通常具有光泽的坚硬珠状物；也可指其仿制品。标准马来语对应词为 mutiara。
senses.en_definition: A hard, usually lustrous rounded formation produced within certain molluscs, valued as a gem; also an imitation of it.
senses.ms_definition: Huraian bagi kata Inggeris pearl: mutiara yang terbentuk di dalam moluska tertentu, atau mutiara tiruan.
senses.nuances: 这是英语释义及其马来语对应表达，并非已确认的标准马来语借词。以下 ms 搭配使用 mutiara，不能当作 pearl 的马来语搭配。输入排名仅保留数据包数值，不证明其马来语词汇身份。[DBP 英马词典释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=mutiara+kata)

senses.zh_definition: 【英语，比喻】像珍珠一样珍贵或美好的事物；在 pearl of wisdom 中指智慧箴言。
senses.en_definition: A person or thing regarded as especially precious or excellent, including a valuable piece of wisdom.
senses.ms_definition: Huraian makna kiasan kata Inggeris pearl: seseorang atau sesuatu yang sangat bernilai; dalam ungkapan tertentu, kata-kata hikmah.
senses.nuances: 比喻义须按英语上下文判断。马来语可根据语境译为 bak mutiara、mutiara kata 或 kata-kata hikmah，不宜机械保留英语词形。[DBP 英马词典比喻义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=mutiara+kata)

etymology.historical_story: English pearl entered Middle English through French perle and is associated with Medieval Latin perla. Its deeper origin remains uncertain, so proposed links to shell shapes should not be presented as settled history. For Malay learners, the important distinction is that an English word appearing in local text does not automatically become a standard Malay headword. [Etymology](https://www.etymonline.com/word/pearl)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看见英语 pearl，就想到马来语 mutiara：把两张写着不同语言的标签贴在同一颗珍珠上。

morphology.pattern_note: 单音节，保留词首辅音组合 /pr/；作为独立借词使用，不拆成马来语词缀。未核实派生词，不以术语短语冒充词族。

senses.zh_definition: 计算机提示符：屏幕上表示系统正在等待用户输入的符号或字符。
senses.en_definition: A symbol or sequence of characters indicating that a computer system is ready to receive user input.
senses.ms_definition: Simbol pada skrin komputer yang memerlukan input daripada pengguna.
senses.nuances: 这是输入包提供的《Kamus Pelajar Edisi Kedua》义项，释义已展开缩写。命令行中的 prom 表示可输入命令，不等同于表示输入位置的光标。例：C:>。参见 [DBP：prom](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=prom)。

senses.zh_definition: 生成式人工智能提示：提供给模型、用于引导其生成回答或其他输出的指令、问题或相关输入。
senses.en_definition: An instruction, question, or other input supplied to a generative AI model to guide its output.
senses.ms_definition: Arahan, soalan atau input yang diberikan kepada model kecerdasan buatan generatif untuk membimbing penghasilan respons.
senses.nuances: 此为根据 DBP 人工智能术语条目概括的释义，不是输入包旧词典释义的逐字引文。此处由用户向模型提供输入；计算机提示符义则由系统提示用户输入。参见 [DBP：kejuruteraan prom、penjana prom](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=prom)。

senses.zh_definition: 言语治疗中用于引导患者作出目标言语反应的提示或提示技术。
senses.en_definition: A cue or prompting technique used to elicit a target speech response in therapy.
senses.ms_definition: Teknik terapi yang memberikan kiu dalam pertuturan.
senses.nuances: DBP 卫生科学术语义，限言语治疗等专业语境。以下是说明性组合，不声称为统计上的高频搭配。参见 [DBP：prom 的卫生科学术语义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=prom)。

etymology.historical_story: Malay prom corresponds to English prompt in DBP terminology. Its computing sense concerns a screen signal inviting user input, while its generative AI use concerns input supplied to a model. These related technical uses explain why context matters: the same Malay spelling can describe either a system asking for instructions or instructions given to an AI.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 prom 记成“提示”：屏幕上的 prom 提示你输入；写给 AI 的 prom 提示模型如何回答。

morphology.formula: pembayar + -an → pembayaran；完整构词关系：peN- + bayar + -an → pembayaran
morphology.pattern_note: 按输入包保留 pembayar 为直接词基，此层分析为加后缀 -an；最终词根为 bayar，完整构词通常分析为 peN-…-an。peN- 在 /b/ 前变为 pem-，原有 b 保留；末尾 r 在加 -an 后成为下一音节的声母。

senses.zh_definition: 支付款项、结清货款或清偿债务的行为或过程。
senses.en_definition: The act or process of paying money, settling a charge, or discharging a debt.
senses.ms_definition: Perihal atau tindakan membayar, penjelasan harga barang dan sebagainya, atau pelunasan hutang.
senses.nuances: 侧重付款行为、程序或交易的完成。bayaran 则常侧重所付或应付的款项、费用及报酬；例如 membuat pembayaran 是办理付款，jumlah bayaran 是款项金额。词义及区别依据：[DBP PRPM：bayar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=bayar)。

etymology.historical_story: Pembayaran belongs to the Malay family built around bayar, meaning to pay. Its structure turns an everyday action into a noun suited to describing procedures and transactions. In administrative language, this helps distinguish the process of paying from bayaran, the money or fee involved, a useful distinction in invoices, receipts, and payment notices.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 bayar＝付钱，再记 pembayar＝付款人；pembayaran 把注意力转向整件付款的事：办理、确认或完成支付。

etymology.historical_story: Pemungut belongs to the pungut family, linking the physical act of picking things up with collecting money and revenue. Its agent prefix turns that action into the person responsible. The dictionary records both everyday collectors and officials heading revenue departments, showing how one word connects practical gathering with administrative responsibility. See [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pungut).

etymology.historical_story: Pertunangan belongs to the tunang family, with per-...-an naming the state or relationship of being engaged. In Malay cultural practice, a ring and a meeting between families may publicly mark this promise. These customs help explain familiar expressions such as majlis pertunangan, but the underlying concept is the promise to marry rather than the ceremony itself. [Cultural explanation](https://www.muftiwp.gov.my/ms/artikel/al-kafi-li-al-fatawi/2558-al-kafi-798-apa-itu-tunang-5?templateStyle=16)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 tunang＝未婚伴侣；per-...-an 把它变成一种关系：pertunangan＝订婚关系。

etymology.historical_story: Pengasas is built from asas, meaning a foundation or basis, with the Malay agent prefix peN-. Its literal image is a person who lays the foundations. The related verb mengasaskan connects establishing an organization with grounding an argument, preserving the same foundation metaphor across institutional life and reasoning. [DBP word family](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=pengasas)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: asas＝基础；peng- 把它变成做事的人。先打基础的人，就是 pengasas：创办人。

morphology.pattern_note: pedas 是完整形容词词根，不能拆成 pe- + das。派生 memedaskan 时，meN- 在 p 前实现为 mem-，词根首音 p 脱落。[DBP：pedas 及其派生词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pedas)

etymology.historical_story: Malay proverbial language connects the heat of pedas with the sting of criticism. In the saying Siapa makan lada, dialah terasa pedas, the person who eats pepper feels its heat: a pointed image for someone who feels personally addressed by a remark. This cultural connection helps explain the word's figurative force. [DBP on culinary metaphors](https://tunascipta.jendeladbp.my/2026/10/27/858/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: pedas 先记“舌头被辣到”，再转到“耳朵被话刺到”：食物辣，批评也能辛辣。

etymology.historical_story: DBP identifies porno as a shortened form of pornografi. The shorter word is convenient in conversation, headlines, and combinations such as filem porno, while the full form suits more formal discussion. Its history within Malay therefore illustrates lexical shortening: speakers retain the opening portion of a longer term and use it as an independent word. [DBP: porno](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=porno)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pornografi 后面的 grafi 收起来，就剩 porno；记住它是“色情内容”的简称，不是所有成人话题的统称。

morphology.formula: pemilik + -nya → pemiliknya；底层构词：peN- + milik → pemilik
morphology.pattern_note: -nya 是附着于名词后的第三人称代词或定指成分，此处归入后缀栏；不改变词类。pemilik 的词尾 k 通常读作 [ʔ]，ny 读作 [ɲ]。输入包的 Jawi 仅记录 pemilik，未包含 -nya。

senses.zh_definition: 其所有者；该物品、动物、产业等的主人或拥有者。
senses.en_definition: The owner of the previously mentioned thing, animal, property, or business.
senses.ms_definition: Orang atau pihak yang empunya sesuatu yang telah disebut atau diketahui daripada konteks.
senses.nuances: pemilik 的 DBP 核心义为所有者；-nya 通常回指被拥有的对象。例如 kereta itu dan pemiliknya 指“那辆车及其车主”，不能机械译为“他的主人”。-nya 不标示性别，也不能单凭词形确定所有者人数。此处为依照基础词义作出的组合释义，并非声称 DBP 为 pemiliknya 单独立项。[DBP：pemilik](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=pemilik)

etymology.historical_story: Malay makes ownership visible through a productive word family: milik names possession, pemilik identifies the owner, and pemilikan names ownership. Adding -nya lets a speaker point back to an already mentioned object without repeating its name. This is a morphological account, rather than a claim about the expression's first historical appearance. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=pemilik)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 milik＝拥有，pemilik＝拥有者；再加 nya，把箭头指回前面那件东西：pemiliknya＝它的主人。

morphology.pattern_note: 直接添加 -kan，词根无音变；ng 表示 /ŋ/，其后的 g 仍发音。此形式常用于祈使句，也可用于第二人称被动结构；带 meN- 的主动形式为 memanggilkan。输入包的 Jawi 仅记录 panggil，未包含 -kan。

senses.zh_definition: 替某人叫来、请来某人；常用于请求或指示对方代为传唤。
senses.en_definition: To call or summon someone for another person, especially in a request or instruction.
senses.ms_definition: Memanggil seseorang supaya datang bagi pihak atau untuk keperluan orang lain.
senses.nuances: -kan 在常见请求中带有受益义，如 Panggilkan doktor untuk saya。不能把 panggil 的“称呼、命名”等全部义项直接移植过来；若只表示打电话，通常用 telefon 或 hubungi 更明确。这里的马来文释义是派生形式的组合释义。[DBP：memanggil 及派生词表](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=memanggil)

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries record panggil as a base for summoning, inviting, and naming, alongside derivatives such as memanggilkan and panggilan. Panggilkan illustrates how Malay builds a practical request from that base: the speaker asks someone to perform the calling for another person. No specific borrowing history or first attestation is established here. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=memanggil)

morphology.pattern_note: 以上词根字段按数据包保留，仅表示整词索引，并非实际派生分析。语言学构词为 per- + arak + -an → perarakan，实际属于派生名词；arak 的 Jawi 为 ارق。读音可有 /pə.ra.raʔ.kan/ 变体。参见 [DBP：arak II](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=arak)。

senses.ms_definition: Perbuatan berarak atau iring-iringan yang mengarak seseorang atau sesuatu; pawai.
senses.nuances: 侧重集体、有次序地行进，不限于抗议活动，也用于国庆、婚礼及宗教纪念活动。参见 [DBP：perarakan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=perarakan)。

senses.nuances: 这是由活动转指参加者的用法，常与经过、抵达或领队等动作搭配。参见 [DBP：perarakan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=perarakan)。

etymology.historical_story: Perarakan belongs to the arak word family concerned with proceeding in company or escorting someone. Its historical range includes both the moving procession and the conveyance carrying a participant. That older vehicle sense helps explain scenes in classical narratives where someone climbs onto a perarakan, rather than merely joining a crowd. See [DBP: arak II](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=arak).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按 pe-ra-ra-kan 四拍读，想象队伍一步一步向前；再连起 berarak“列队走”和 perarakan“游行”。

morphology.formula: peN- + selamat + -an → penyelamatan；数据包所列相关基底：penyelamat
morphology.pattern_note: 按要求保留 root_word 的数据包值，但 penyelamat 是相关施事名词，不是最深层词根。规范构词以 selamat 为基础：词首 s 在 peN- 后脱落，鼻音变为 /ɲ/。penyelamatan 表示施救行为或过程，不能仅解释成给“救援者”加 -an。

senses.zh_definition: 使人或动物脱离危险、灾难或困境的救援行动或过程。
senses.en_definition: The act or process of rescuing people or animals from danger.
senses.ms_definition: Tindakan atau usaha membawa manusia atau haiwan keluar daripada bahaya.
senses.nuances: 数据包所引 Kamus Dewan 将其概括为 menyelamatkan 的行为或努力；这里按常见对象展开。penyelamatan 是救援行动，penyelamat 是救援者，keselamatan 则是安全状态。

senses.zh_definition: 防止财产、机构、资源或文化遗产毁损、流失或失败的挽救行动。
senses.en_definition: The act of saving assets, institutions, resources, or heritage from loss or failure.
senses.ms_definition: Usaha mengelakkan harta, institusi, sumber atau warisan daripada musnah atau gagal.
senses.nuances: 是救援概念向非生命对象的延伸，不必涉及现场救人；具体措施由对象决定。

senses.zh_definition: 在特定宗教语境中，指从罪、死亡或灵性危险中获得拯救。
senses.en_definition: Salvation or deliverance in a religious context.
senses.ms_definition: Pembebasan daripada dosa atau kebinasaan menurut kepercayaan agama tertentu.
senses.nuances: 见于部分马来文基督教材料，是有特定信仰框架的用法，并非一般救灾语境的默认含义。用例见 [马来文宗教释义](https://www.jw.org/ms/ajaran-bible/soalan/apakah-itu-penyelamatan/)。

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 救灾、动物救助、企业挽救及遗产抢救均可使用，但应明确对象。宗教义须有清楚语境，并尊重不同信仰对得救概念的理解。

etymology.historical_story: Selamat provides a familiar Malay image of being safe and unharmed. The related verb menyelamatkan means bringing someone or something into that condition, while penyelamatan names the effort itself. In Malaysian flood reporting, this distinction becomes concrete: the penyelamat is the rescuer, penyelamatan is the rescue, and selamat describes the hoped-for outcome.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: selamat＝平安；penyelamat＝救援者；penyelamatan＝把人带回平安的行动。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根本身不带词缀；派生 memicu 时，meN- 在 p 前变为 mem-，词首 p 脱落；c 读 /tʃ/。

senses.zh_definition: 手枪、步枪等枪械上用于启动击发机构的扳机。
senses.en_definition: The trigger of a pistol, rifle, or other firearm.
senses.ms_definition: Pemetik pistol, senapang dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 这是名词，表示枪械部件；“扣动扳机”通常说 menarik picu 或 memicu。不要把 picu 本身直接当作一般的“引发”动词。

senses.zh_definition: 技术系统中在被操作或特定条件出现时启动某项动作的触发装置。
senses.en_definition: A device that initiates an action when operated or when a specified condition occurs.
senses.ms_definition: Peranti pada sistem yang menggerakkan sesuatu tindakan apabila digunakan atau apabila sesuatu keadaan terjadi.
senses.nuances: 这是计算机等技术领域的引申义，强调启动动作的机制；具体译法须依系统语境确定。[来源：DBP 技术词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=picu)。

dual_scenarios.context: 博物馆说明 / 技术介绍
dual_scenarios.ms: Pegawai muzium menerangkan fungsi picu pada senapang lama yang dipamerkan itu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 博物馆工作人员讲解了那支展出的旧步枪上扳机的功能。
dual_scenarios.en: The museum officer explained the function of the trigger on the old rifle on display.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Picu pistol mainan ni dah rosak lah.

spoken_features: ni 对应 ini，dah 对应 sudah。
lah 在此加强说明和轻微抱怨的语气。
口语常省略可由语境补出的主语。

messages.zh: 就用盒子里那把吧。那把还是好的。
messages.en: Just use the one in the box. That one's still fine.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 该词本身语体中性，常见于新闻、历史与技术说明；是否显得冒犯主要取决于整句话是否带有威胁意味。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 可客观描述枪械部件、影视道具或技术触发装置。向他人直接说出带有扣动扳机内容的句子时，应避免产生人身威胁的歧义。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 该词本身语体中性，常见于新闻、历史与技术说明；是否显得冒犯主要取决于整句话是否带有威胁意味。

etymology.historical_story: Picu names a small mechanism with a decisive effect: the trigger of a firearm. Malay dictionaries also record a technical extension for a device that starts an action under specified conditions. The connection offers a useful picture of semantic expansion, although these dictionary entries do not establish the word's deeper origin. [Source: DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=picu).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pi-cu 联想成“劈出”：轻轻扣动一个小部件，动作便被触发；c 要读成 /tʃ/。

morphology.formula: 按输入中间基底：pengurus + -an → pengurusan；基本构词分析：peN- + urus + -an → pengurusan
morphology.pattern_note: 输入将 pengurus 列为中间基底，故保留该字段；基本词根是 urus，常规分析采用 peN-...-an。peN- 在元音 u 前实现为 peng-；接 -an 后词干末尾 s 与后续元音组成 san。

senses.zh_definition: 对事务、资源或机构进行安排、协调和处理的工作或过程；管理。
senses.en_definition: The work or process of managing affairs, resources, or an organisation.
senses.ms_definition: Perihal atau kerja mengurus sesuatu, termasuk syarikat, badan perniagaan dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 核心是“管理活动”，并非单个经理；经理是 pengurus。可用于企业、社区设施、时间、财务和项目等对象。此义依据输入中的《Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat》定义。

senses.zh_definition: 负责经营或管理某机构的人员整体；管理层。
senses.en_definition: The people collectively responsible for managing an organisation.
senses.ms_definition: Golongan atau pihak yang bertanggungjawab mengurus sesebuah organisasi.
senses.nuances: 这是由管理活动转指管理人员整体的常用用法，尤其见于 pihak pengurusan 和 pengurusan tertinggi；输入的核心释义未将其单独编号。[DBP 用法资料](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pengurusan)收有这些表达。

dual_scenarios.context: 职场汇报：改进项目管理
dual_scenarios.ms: Pengurusan projek yang cekap dapat mengurangkan kos dan memastikan kerja disiapkan mengikut jadual.
dual_scenarios.zh: 高效的项目管理能够降低成本，并确保工作按期完成。
dual_scenarios.en: Efficient project management can reduce costs and ensure that work is completed on schedule.

luluskan 在此省略主动动词前缀，标准形式为 meluluskan。
je 对应 sahaja；正式职场书面沟通宜使用完整形式。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: pihak pengurusan 是职场或公共事务中较中性的管理方称呼。提出问题时可说 memohon penjelasan daripada pihak pengurusan，语气比直接指责某位主管更适合正式沟通。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 区分“管理有问题”和“某位经理有问题”，避免把 pengurusan 一律译成“经理”。向管理层投诉时，交代具体事项、时间和所需处理，有助于保持专业。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: pihak pengurusan 是职场或公共事务中较中性的管理方称呼。提出问题时可说 memohon penjelasan daripada pihak pengurusan，语气比直接指责某位主管更适合正式沟通。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 区分“管理有问题”和“某位经理有问题”，避免把 pengurusan 一律译成“经理”。向管理层投诉时，交代具体事项、时间和所需处理，有助于保持专业。

etymology.historical_story: Malay distinguishes an activity from its practitioner within the urus family: pengurus names a manager, while pengurusan names management. The distinction is useful far beyond business. The supplied Kamus Dewan example concerns a locally chosen committee managing a surau or mosque, showing how the same vocabulary describes community responsibilities as naturally as commercial administration.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: pengurus 是“管理的人”，pengurusan 是“管理这件事”；看到末尾 -an，就联想成一整套管理工作。

morphology.formula: 按输入词基的部分重叠分析：patah → pa- + patah → pe- + patah → pepatah
morphology.pattern_note: 这里的 pe- 按首音节部分重叠理解，重叠音节的元音弱化为 /ə/，不是普通派生前缀。该分析用于说明词形，不等于已经证实唯一历史词源；可参照 [DBP 部分重叠说明](https://dewanbahasa.jendeladbp.my/2022/09/15/5030/)。

senses.zh_definition: 凝练表达传统经验、劝诫或人生教益的谚语、格言。
senses.en_definition: A traditional proverb or saying expressing advice, wisdom, or a moral lesson.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis peribahasa yang mengandungi nasihat atau ajaran orang tua-tua; bidal.
senses.nuances: 属于 peribahasa 的范围，重点在劝诫和教益；不能把所有习语或新造口号都称为 pepatah。pepatah adat 特指涉及习俗规范的传统言辞；pepatah dan petitih 是并列固定表达，不构成另一种词性。[DBP 词条](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=pepatah)支持这些用法。

collocations.zh: 习俗格言；传统习俗谚语

dual_scenarios.zh: 这种合作精神体现了马来谚语“重担共同扛，轻担共同提”的道理。
dual_scenarios.en: This spirit of cooperation reflects the Malay proverb, "Heavy burdens are carried together, and light burdens are shared too."

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 引用谚语可使劝告显得含蓄，但当面用教训式谚语评价长辈、上司或失误者，仍可能让人难堪。宜把重点放在共同处境，例如 sama-sama kita ingat pepatah…。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合致辞、作文、文化交流及朋友间的鼓励。引用时保留公认措辞并确保寓意切题；涉及 pepatah adat 时，应尊重具体社群的习俗背景，避免把一句格言说成所有马来社群共同遵守的规定。

etymology.historical_story: Pepatah carries advice in a form people can remember and pass on. DBP describes it as a proverb containing elders' teachings and recognises pepatah adat for customary sayings. Its connection with patah offers a useful morphological reading, but should not be turned into an invented origin story. The cultural thread is concise language preserving shared practical wisdom.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pepatah 想成“一小截话，装着一大段智慧”：听见 pepatah，就想到长辈留下的谚语。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词借入，不拆成 pre- 与 bet；两个 e 均读 e taling /e/。下列词族项目为含该词的组合，不是派生词。

senses.zh_definition: 列兵；军队中最低一级的正式军衔，亦指具有该军衔的军人。
senses.en_definition: Private: the lowest military rank, or a soldier holding that rank.
senses.ms_definition: Pangkat yang rendah sekali dalam pasukan polis atau tentera.
senses.nuances: 马来语释义保留《Kamus Dewan》的广义表述。现代马来西亚语境通常指陆军列兵；不能据此把普通警员一律称为 prebet。DBP 也收录该词指持有这一军衔的人员。[DBP：prebet](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=prebet)

senses.zh_definition: 私人的；供个人使用而非供公众使用的，属口语用法。
senses.en_definition: Private or intended for personal rather than public use; colloquial.
senses.ms_definition: Persendirian, perseorangan; tidak rasmi atau umum.
senses.nuances: 这是 DBP 另列的口语义，常见于 kereta prebet 等说法。正式文字应按语境选择 persendirian、peribadi 或 swasta，不能把英语 private 的所有意思都机械译为 prebet。

dual_scenarios.ms: Seorang anggota berpangkat prebet telah ditugaskan untuk membantu urusan logistik di pusat pemindahan sementara.

dual_scenarios.en: A soldier holding the rank of private has been assigned to assist with logistics at the temporary evacuation centre.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Adik aku dah habis latihan dan sekarang berpangkat prebet.

dah 是 sudah 的口语缩略。
habis latihan 对应正式表达 menamatkan latihan。
je 是 sahaja 的口语形式。

messages.ms_spoken: Adik aku dah habis latihan dan sekarang berpangkat prebet.
messages.ms_standard: Adik saya telah menamatkan latihan dan kini berpangkat prebet.
messages.zh: 我弟已经完成训练，现在是列兵了。
messages.en: My younger brother has finished training and is now a private.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 谈及军人时尊重其正式军衔，不把 prebet 当作贬称。军衔与姓名连用时通常写作 Prebet Ahmad；泛指时写 seorang prebet。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 军衔义适合新闻、军旅叙述及正式介绍。私人使用义带口语色彩；在申请表、合同或正式报告中，kereta persendirian 更清楚。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 谈及军人时尊重其正式军衔，不把 prebet 当作贬称。军衔与姓名连用时通常写作 Prebet Ahmad；泛指时写 seorang prebet。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 军衔义适合新闻、军旅叙述及正式介绍。私人使用义带口语色彩；在申请表、合同或正式报告中，kereta persendirian 更清楚。

etymology.historical_story: Prebet is a Malay adaptation of English private. The borrowed word carries a military meaning, naming a low-ranking soldier, and a colloquial meaning associated with personal use. Malay dictionaries record both senses. This pairing makes the word memorable: the same English source underlies a soldier's rank and the description of a privately used car.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 prebet 与英语 private 连起来记：军衔是“列兵”；kereta prebet 则是“私家车”。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 连写，可参与感叹、评注或名词化结构，不一定表示“他的”。词根末尾 k 在常见马来西亚读音中读作 /ʔ/。headword.jawi 按词包保留，但 ڤليق 仅为 pelik；peliknya 的完整拼写为 ڤليقڽ。

senses.zh_definition: 奇怪的是；令人意外的是。用于评注整个句子所述的情况。
senses.en_definition: Strangely or oddly; used to introduce a surprising circumstance.
senses.ms_definition: Yang menghairankan atau menganehkan ialah keadaan yang dinyatakan dalam ayat berikutnya.
senses.nuances: 常置于句首并后接逗号，如 Peliknya, pintu itu masih berkunci。这里评注整件事情，不表示“以奇怪的方式”。这是 pelik 加 -nya 的语境用法；DBP 所列词根基本义为“奇怪、反常”。[DBP：pelik](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pelik)

collocations.zh: 奇怪的是，那件事再次发生

senses.zh_definition: 真奇怪；好奇特。用于感叹某人、某事或某物的异常。
senses.en_definition: How strange or unusual; expressing surprise at something's oddness.

etymology.historical_story: Peliknya combines pelik with the versatile Malay ending -nya. Rather than adding one fixed meaning, this ending helps speakers frame surprise, emphasize an unusual quality or turn that quality into something discussable. Dictionaries also record difficult and important among the meanings of pelik, but these should not automatically replace the ordinary modern reading of peliknya as an expression of strangeness.

etymology.historical_story: Persiapkan belongs to the Malay family built on siap, expressing readiness or completion. Related forms organize different perspectives: bersiap describes getting ready, persiapan names preparations, and mempersiapkan presents the act of making something ready. Persiapkan appears naturally in instructions. Its formation is transparent within Malay; no speculative foreign origin is needed to explain its meaning. See [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=169476&keyword=siap).

etymology.historical_story: Paranormal belongs to an international vocabulary of unusual phenomena. Its historical construction combines para-, a Greek-derived element suggesting something beyond or alongside, with normal. The French Academy dates the French formation to the twentieth century. In Malay, the complete form functions as a descriptive adjective, giving discussions of mysterious experiences a shared international label. [Académie française](https://dictionnaire-academie.fr/article/A9P0520)

etymology.historical_story: Pencari illustrates a productive Malay way of naming people through their activities: cari means to seek, and peN- creates an agent noun. Its familiar combinations connect personal aspiration with everyday livelihood. A pencari kebenaran pursues truth, while a pencari nafkah earns support for a household. The word's structure remains transparent to modern speakers.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: cari 是“找”，peN- 给动作添上“做这件事的人”：pencari 就是“寻找的人”。记住 pencari kerja＝找工作的人。

etymology.historical_story: Pengiring is built from iring, associated with following or accompanying, and the agent-forming prefix peN-. DBP illustrates the word through royal attendants and accompanying music. These settings connect courtly service with everyday accompaniment: a teacher accompanying pupils, an attendant accompanying a guest, and music accompanying a performance all share the central idea of going along with something. [Source: DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=iring).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 iring 记成“随行”，peN- 标记执行者：pengiring 就是“随行的人”；lagu pengiring 则是跟着表演走的音乐。

morphology.pattern_note: 现代马来语中作为完整借词记忆；末音节 taip 含双元音 /ai̯/。pemprototaipan 中保留借词首辅音群 pr-。

senses.zh_definition: 为开发和改进某项产品、系统或软件而制作的初始模型或试验版本；原型。
senses.en_definition: An initial model or version used as a basis for developing and improving a product or system.
senses.ms_definition: Model awal sesuatu produk atau sistem yang dibina sebagai asas untuk menghasilkan model yang lebih baik.
senses.nuances: 可指实体样机、软件试用版本或界面模型；不要求已经具备成品的全部功能，也不一定按比例缩小。重点在于作为后续开发与改进的基础。[DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=103260&keyword=prototaip)。

etymology.historical_story: Prototaip corresponds to English prototype, whose history reaches back through European languages to Greek prōtotypon, an original model. Its components connect the ideas of first and form or pattern. That older image remains useful in modern workshops and software teams: an initial version gives later versions something concrete to develop from. [Etymology](https://www.etymonline.com/word/prototype).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 prototaip 直接连到 prototype：先做出一个可观察、可试验的“第一版模型”，再逐步改进。

morphology.formula: pangkal + -an → pangkalan；pengkalan 是需依语境处理的拼写形式
morphology.pattern_note: 普通名词的规范构词是 pangkal 加后缀 -an，不是 peN- 加 kalan，也不是 pengkal 加 -an。规范 pangkalan 读 /paŋkalan/；本条不把 pengkalan 的读音冒充规范读音。[DBP 构词说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pingkal)

senses.zh_definition: 作为普通名词时，是 pangkalan 的非规范拼写；所指可为船只停泊处、货物集散处或行动基地。pangkalan data 专指数据库。
senses.en_definition: A nonstandard common-noun spelling of pangkalan: a landing place, goods collection point, or operational base; pangkalan data means database.
senses.ms_definition: Ejaan tidak baku bagi pangkalan sebagai kata nama am, iaitu tempat berlabuh, tempat pengumpulan barang atau pusat operasi; pangkalan data ialah himpunan data yang disimpan dan dikendalikan dengan komputer.
senses.nuances: 此处解释的是规范词 pangkalan 的相关意义，不为 pengkalan 新设独立标准词义。以下搭配使用更正后的规范拼写；不能在正式普通名词表达中写成 pengkalan data 或 pengkalan tentera。[DBP 拼写说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pingkal)、[DBP pangkalan 释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pangkalan)

senses.zh_definition: Pengkalan：部分马来西亚地名中沿用的名称组成部分，应依正式地名保留拼写。
senses.en_definition: Pengkalan, an established element in certain Malaysian place names, retained according to the official name.
senses.ms_definition: Unsur nama khas dalam sesetengah nama tempat di Malaysia yang dikekalkan mengikut ejaan rasmi nama tersebut.
senses.nuances: 例如 Pengkalan Hulu。专名中的既定拼写不能直接套用普通名词的纠错规则；以下是地名实例。[马来西亚皇家警察官方用例](https://rmp2u.rmp.gov.my/content/posting-pilihan-timbalan-mdn-hadir-majlis-ramah-mesra-bersama-warga-ipd-pengkalan-hulu-dan-pesara-polis)、[国家档案局 Pengkalan Gawi 用例](https://www.arkib.gov.my/images/akta-pekeliling-garis-panduan/konvensional/PanduanPembangunanKlasifikasiFailPejabatAwam.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: DBP analyses the standard noun pangkalan as pangkal plus -an. Its recorded meanings include places for boats, goods and military operations, while pangkalan data names a computer database. Pengkalan also survives in established geographical names. This distinction matters: correcting an ordinary noun and reproducing a place name require different spelling decisions. [Sources: DBP spelling advice](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pingkal), [DBP dictionary](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pangkalan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: pangkal 是根基，pangkal + an 成为基地 pangkalan；看到 Pengkalan，先检查它是否属于正式地名。

senses.nuances: 通常写作 Peabody，不是可直接赋予普通马来语词义的词形。资料包未提供正式马来语收录证据；马来语释义为编辑释义，排名仅沿用资料包。没有可靠的马来语派生词，因此 word_family 留空。下列为专名组合示例，不能据此认定原始语料指向奖项。参考读音见 [Cambridge: Peabody pronunciation](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/pronunciation/english/peabody)；奖项名称见 [Peabody Awards: Our Story](https://peabodyawards.com/our-story/)。

etymology.historical_story: One cultural association of Peabody comes from the broadcasting awards named after George Foster Peabody. The first awards were presented in 1941 for radio programmes broadcast in 1940. The name honoured his contributions to the University of Georgia; the awards were not created through a provision in his will. This explains the award name, not the surname's ultimate etymology. [Source: Peabody Awards](https://peabodyawards.com/our-story/).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 用“皮博迪奖”的奖章联想 Peabody；这是专名记忆钩子，不是 pea + body 的词源解释。

etymology.historical_story: Pegangan is transparently formed from pegang, meaning to hold, with the noun-forming suffix -an. Its meanings connect a physical handhold with an intellectual foundation: something the hand grips and something a person relies upon. The older administrative sense adds another connection, an office or district entrusted to someone's charge. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=pegangan)

etymology.historical_story: Malay perasaan brings bodily sensation and inner emotion into one lexical family centred on rasa. Its dictionary meanings also extend to perceptiveness and judgment, showing how feeling can bridge body and thought. Adding the inherited pronominal clitic -nya identifies whose experience is involved. The resulting form therefore carries a small relationship inside the word: a feeling belonging to someone.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先抓住 rasa（感觉），再把 perasaan（感受）接上 nya（他／她的）：perasaannya＝他／她的感受。中间 a.a 分开读，感受也要细细体会。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于考核、学习、体育和技术评估。讨论他人的成绩或考核结果时，应顾及隐私；prestasi cemerlang 是明确赞扬，prestasi 单独使用则保持中性。

etymology.historical_story: Prestasi has a strong institutional life in Malaysia: it turns everyday ideas of doing well or poorly into something schools and workplaces can evaluate. Public-service assessment connects it with work results, competencies, values, and contributions. This cultural setting explains why the word often appears beside penilaian, meaning assessment, and why it need not imply excellence. See [Malaysia's public-service performance framework](https://docs.jpa.gov.my/docs/myppsm/PPSM/UP/Pengurusan-prestasi/7/).

senses.zh_definition: 私人生活或独处空间不受他人打扰、窥探的状态；隐私、私密空间。
senses.en_definition: The state of being free from unwanted intrusion into one's personal life or private space.
senses.ms_definition: Keadaan atau suasana bersendiri tanpa sebarang gangguan.
senses.nuances: 强调个人边界及不受干扰的空间，不一定涉及秘密。需要独处可说 memerlukan privasi；rahsia 则指不公开的秘密或机密。

senses.zh_definition: 个人资料、通信及网络活动受到保护，不被他人擅自获取、使用或公开的私密性。
senses.en_definition: Privacy concerning access to, use of, or disclosure of personal information and communications.
senses.ms_definition: Keadaan maklumat, komunikasi dan kegiatan peribadi seseorang terlindung daripada akses, penggunaan atau pendedahan tanpa kebenaran.
senses.nuances: 这是现代资料与网络语境中的常用延伸义；此处马来语释义为综合释义。privasi 指私密性，keselamatan data 指资料安全，两者相关但侧重点不同。参见[马来西亚个人资料保护局隐私通知](https://www.pdp.gov.my/privasi/)。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 提出隐私要求时，可用 Saya perlukan sedikit privasi, boleh?（可以给我一点私人空间吗？），清楚表达边界，同时保持礼貌。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合谈论住所、家庭照片、私人通信及个人资料。发布他人照片、转发聊天内容或询问敏感私事前，先征求当事人同意。

etymology.historical_story: Privasi connects the familiar idea of an undisturbed personal space with the digital world. Someone sharing a rented home may lack privacy; someone sharing photographs online may expose another person's private life. Malaysian institutional usage also applies the word to personal information, showing how one term links physical boundaries with informational boundaries. See the [official privacy notice](https://www.pdp.gov.my/privasi/).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pri-va-si 与英语 privacy 联想：关上私人空间的门，也关好个人资料的门；两扇门都在守护 privasi。

etymology.historical_story: Persimpangan is built from simpang, a word associated with branching routes, through the Malay circumfix per-...-an. The resulting noun names the place where roads branch or meet. That concrete image also supports the expression di persimpangan hidup: a person facing several possible futures is pictured as a traveller choosing a road.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: simpang 是“岔开”，per-...-an 把画面定在地点：道路岔开的地方就是 persimpangan。

senses.zh_definition: 绑架者；掳走儿童或成人的人，可能以索取赎金、杀害或其他目的实施绑架。
senses.en_definition: A person who abducts a child or adult, including for ransom, killing, or another purpose.
senses.ms_definition: Orang yang mencuri atau melarikan kanak-kanak, atau menangkap dan melarikan seseorang untuk dibunuh, diminta wang tebusan dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 输入词典的 a、b 两项分别突出掳走儿童及更广泛的绑架行为，此处合并为一个涵盖两者的义项。对象不限于儿童，索取赎金也不是必要条件。词义指实施者，事件本身用 penculikan。释义展开自所给《Kamus Dewan》资料，亦可参阅 [DBP：culik](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=culik)。

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary preserves a striking cultural layer: culik can denote a child-stealing spirit in older literary usage. In the same entry, it also denotes a human abductor. Penculik transparently names the human agent through peN-. This juxtaposition connects folklore with ordinary vocabulary, without establishing which meaning came first. See [DBP: culik](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=culik).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 culik“绑架”，再加表示行为执行者的 peN-：penculik 就是“实施绑架的人”。

senses.zh_definition: 苦的；具有类似胆汁的苦味的。
senses.en_definition: Having a bitter taste, like that of bile.

senses.zh_definition: 令人伤心或难受的；尤指话语刺痛人的。

senses.nuances: 由苦味引申为情绪上的刺痛，重点在听者感受到的伤害；不能把英语 bitter 的所有人格或情绪用法直接套用到 pahit。

senses.zh_definition: 艰苦的；充满困难、困顿或磨难的。
senses.en_definition: Hard or difficult, involving hardship or suffering.
senses.ms_definition: Tidak senang serta penuh kesusahan atau kesukaran.
senses.nuances: 通常形容生活、处境或人生历程。pahit getir 把这种艰辛感加强，常用于回顾长期经历的磨难。

senses.zh_definition: 痛苦而难以承受或接受的；尤指现实、经历或事件。

senses.nuances: 重点是面对某件事实或经历时的承受与接受难度；kenyataan pahit 指令人痛苦却必须面对的现实。

etymology.historical_story: Historical comparison connects pahit with a wider Austronesian family of words for bitterness, rather than a recent European food term. Malay also uses the same taste word for hurtful speech, hardship and painful experiences. This movement from tongue to emotion makes literal bitterness a memorable bridge to its figurative meanings. See the [historical linguistic discussion in Dialectologia](https://www.edicions.ub.edu/revistes/dialectologia32/documentos/1934.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 pa-hit 时，想象苦味 hit 到舌头，再刺到心里：pahit 既能说嘴里的苦，也能说心里的苦。

etymology.historical_story: Perhentian is a transparent Malay formation built around henti, “stop.” The circumfix per-...-an gives it a place meaning, turning stopping into somewhere to stop. Everyday transport makes that structure easy to see: a perhentian bas is where a bus stops. The dictionary also records a less prominent sense referring to stopping itself. [Source: DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=132088&keyword=perhentian).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 henti＝停；per-...-an 在这里把“停”变成“停的地方”：perhentian bas＝巴士停靠站。

etymology.historical_story: Pemberian belongs to the Malay family built around beri, meaning 'give'. Its two established meanings preserve both sides of an exchange: the giving itself and the thing received. This makes the word equally useful for a treasured family gift and an administrative description of assistance. That connection explains its semantic range without requiring a separate origin for each meaning.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 beri＝给：pemberi 是给的人，pemberian 是给的东西或给予这件事。

etymology.historical_story: The base sembah evokes reverence and respectful address. Its derived verb connects three familiar settings: presenting information respectfully, offering something with honour, and presenting a performance. The stage meaning preserves the idea of placing something before others, although it need not imply worship. This semantic connection helps explain why the same verb suits both ceremonial offerings and ordinary concerts.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sembah 联想为“恭敬呈上”：呈上歌舞是演出，呈上心意是献给，呈上文书是恭呈。

etymology.historical_story: Pengajian belongs to the Malay kaji family. Its established meanings connect Quranic learning with advanced academic study, two settings in which knowledge is carefully acquired. This shared vocabulary offers a cultural link between religious learning and university education. The dictionary records both meanings, but does not establish which developed first or provide a dated origin.

etymology.historical_story: Pendatang belongs to the Malay word family built around datang, meaning “to come.” The noun-forming prefix peN- produces the idea of someone who comes from elsewhere. Its everyday associations include migration and settlement, while pendatang baru also welcomes newcomers into neighbourhoods or professional fields. The dictionary additionally preserves less familiar meanings involving structural support and premonition, showing a wider semantic range than modern migration reporting suggests.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 datang＝“来”：peN- + datang → pendatang，“从别处来的人”；再加 baru＝“新”，就是“新来者”。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词作为独立词素记忆；par- 和 -kel 不是马来语词缀。末音节 e 为 e pepet /ə/。词族列出常见术语组合，不把组合成分误作词缀。

senses.zh_definition: 小品词；主要表达语法、强调、疑问等功能的虚词或附着成分，如 -kah、-lah、pun。
senses.en_definition: A grammatical particle: a function word or attached element such as -kah, -lah, or pun.
senses.ms_definition: Kata tugas seperti -kah, -lah dan pun; kata penyerta.
senses.nuances: 这是数据包所列《Kamus Dewan》的语言学义项。partikel 是这类成分的名称，本身属于名词。各小品词的拼写规则不同，不能一律分写或连写；例如 -lah、-kah 与前词连写，pun 通常分写，但有固定例外。

senses.zh_definition: 颗粒；微粒，指物质中很小的粒状部分，见于科学、环境与技术语境。
senses.en_definition: A particle; a very small portion of matter.
senses.ms_definition: Bahagian jirim yang sangat kecil; zarah.
senses.nuances: 这一科技用法见于马来西亚官方材料，但不在所给《Kamus Dewan》摘录的语言学释义中。马来西亚科学表达也广泛使用 zarah；不能因英文 particle 同时有两义，就在任何语境中混用。用例参见：[马来西亚卫生部柔佛州卫生局：悬浮颗粒](https://jknjohor.moh.gov.my/jknj/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/BKPAS2-2019.pdf)。

etymology.historical_story: Partikel offers a useful connection between grammar and the material world. In language study, a small element such as -lah can shape emphasis without naming an object. In environmental writing, partikel can denote tiny pieces of matter. The shared learning image is smallness: a small component may still have an important effect.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 par-ti-kel 联想到英语 particle：语法里是“小成分”，物质里是“小颗粒”；小小一粒，也能改变整体效果。

senses.zh_definition: 退休金；政府或雇主定期向退休雇员支付的生活保障款项，通常按月发放。
senses.en_definition: A regular, usually monthly payment made by a government or employer to a former employee after retirement.
senses.ms_definition: Bayaran berkala, lazimnya setiap bulan, daripada kerajaan atau majikan kepada bekas pekerja yang telah bersara.
senses.nuances: 指退休后领取的款项，不等于在职工资 gaji，也不等于一次性退休酬金 ganjaran。词义依据：[DBP：pencen](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=pencen)。

senses.zh_definition: 已退休并领取退休金的；日常口语中也常泛指已经退休。
senses.en_definition: Retired and receiving a pension; also used more loosely in conversation to mean retired.
senses.ms_definition: Tidak bekerja lagi setelah bersara dan menerima wang sara secara berkala.
senses.nuances: 常作状态谓语，如 sudah pencen。正式人事文件通常用 bersara 表示退休行为，用 menerima pencen 表示领取退休金；退休与享有退休金并非必然相同。

kat 对应标准语的 di
aku 用于熟人交流；正式表达可改为 saya

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合讨论退休生活和退休收入。初次见面时不宜直接追问退休金金额；也不要仅凭对方已经退休，就认定其必定领取退休金。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 谈长辈退休可用 beliau sudah bersara，语气较庄重。pencen 本身并不失礼，但拿退休开玩笑，可能让对方觉得被暗示年老或失去价值。

etymology.historical_story: Pencen is a Malay adaptation of English pension. Its familiar spelling shows how a borrowed administrative term can settle into local pronunciation rather than retain its foreign appearance. The word names the payment itself, but everyday speakers also use it for the recipient’s retired state, linking money and a new stage of life. See the [etymological entry](https://wiki.rus.family/content/wiktionary_en_all_nopic_2025-07/pencen).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pencen 与英文 pension 连起来记：退休以后，每月到账的那笔钱。两个 e 都读清楚的 /e/。

morphology.pattern_note: 按英语整词识记，ie 在此读 /aɪ/，不按马来语字母逐个拼读。马来西亚规范马来语拼写为 pai；词族列出规范对应形式及其词组。

senses.ms_definition: Pai, iaitu makanan berinti buah-buahan, daging atau bahan lain yang menggunakan kulit pastri dan dibakar.

etymology.historical_story: The English food name pie goes back to Middle English. Its deeper origin is uncertain: one proposal connects mixed fillings with the varied things associated with a magpie, but this is not established fact. In Malaysian Malay, the spelling pai represents the familiar pronunciation while fitting local spelling conventions. Sources: [Oxford](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/pie), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=pai).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: pie 读起来近似中文“派”：苹果派就是 apple pie；写规范马来语时，把同一个声音写成 pai。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词专名，按三个音节发音，不作马来语词缀拆分。数据键保留小写，规范行文写 Pasifik。没有在此列入未经核实的派生词。

senses.zh_definition: 太平洋，位于亚洲、澳大利亚与南北美洲之间的大洋；也用于以该大洋命名的地区名称。

senses.ms_definition: Lautan Teduh.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，通常写作 Pasifik，完整名称为 Lautan Pasifik。Asia-Pasifik 等地域组合由此得名。本条不将英语形容词 pacific 的“和平的”义直接套入马来语。[DBP：Pasifik](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=105584&keyword=Pasifik)

etymology.historical_story: The ocean's international name recalls Ferdinand Magellan's expedition. In November 1520, after passing through the strait now bearing his name, his fleet encountered comparatively calm waters. He named the ocean for that peaceful appearance. Malay preserves this geographical name as Pasifik; the dictionary equivalent Lautan Teduh echoes the same image of calmness. [NOAA：Pacific 名称的由来](https://oceanservice.noaa.gov/facts/pacific.html)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: pa-si-fik 对应英语 Pacific；想象地图上亚洲与美洲之间那片太平洋。

morphology.pattern_note: peN- 在 g 前实现为 peng-，词根 g 保留，形成 /ŋɡ/。据 DBP 的 godam 词条纠正数据包将 penggodam 标为词根的分析。

word_family.gloss: 用大锤击打；入侵电脑系统

senses.zh_definition: 大锤；用于重力敲击或破拆的锤具。
senses.en_definition: A sledgehammer or heavy hammer.
senses.ms_definition: Palu godam.
senses.nuances: 这是所给 Kamus Dewan 词条的第一义。现代一般交流中，此工具更常称 godam 或 tukul godam；penggodam 单独出现时往往先让人想到电脑黑客。

senses.zh_definition: 黑客；未经许可侵入电脑系统，以获取数据或机密信息等的人。
senses.en_definition: A person who gains unauthorized access to a computer system, especially to obtain data or confidential information.
senses.ms_definition: Orang yang menceroboh masuk ke dalam sistem komputer untuk mengakses data dan maklumat sulit dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 这是数据包所引 Kamus Dewan 的电脑义，带有未经授权入侵的含义。新闻中的 serangan penggodam 通常采用此义。

senses.zh_definition: 在信息技术专业语境中，指深入理解、研究或改造电脑系统的技术人员；可以从事获授权的安全工作，也可能滥用技术。
senses.en_definition: In technical usage, a person skilled in exploring or modifying computer systems, whether for constructive or malicious purposes.
senses.ms_definition: Individu yang mahir memahami, meneliti atau mengubah suai sistem komputer, sama ada untuk meningkatkan prestasinya atau untuk tujuan penyalahgunaan.
senses.nuances: 此较广义的用法见 DBP 信息技术术语资料；本项马来语释义为概括改写。说 penggodam beretika 可明确表示从事获授权安全测试的人员。[来源：DBP PRPM 信息技术术语](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=penggodam)。

collocations.zh: 道德黑客；获授权进行安全测试的黑客

dual_scenarios.zh: 网络安全团队正在调查黑客试图未经许可访问公司数据库的事件。

pasal 在此对应正式语 tentang。
tu 对应 itu。
句末 ke 表示疑问。
baca 在口语中省略 meN- 前缀。

messages.ms_spoken: Kau dah baca berita pasal penggodam tu ke?

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 单称他人为 penggodam 可能被理解为指控其入侵系统。介绍安全专业人员时，宜明确说 penggodam beretika 或说明其获授权的工作。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 新闻语境常带负面意味，技术社群中的含义可以较中性。描述尚未查明的事件时，应区分已证实的行为与猜测，避免把一般电脑高手直接称为入侵者。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 单称他人为 penggodam 可能被理解为指控其入侵系统。介绍安全专业人员时，宜明确说 penggodam beretika 或说明其获授权的工作。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 新闻语境常带负面意味，技术社群中的含义可以较中性。描述尚未查明的事件时，应区分已证实的行为与猜测，避免把一般电脑高手直接称为入侵者。

etymology.historical_story: DBP records godam as a heavy hammer and menggodam as both striking with that tool and breaking into computer systems. The family therefore connects physical force with digital intrusion. Penggodam names either the implement or the computer actor. This documented contrast supports a memorable metaphor, without establishing when the computing sense first appeared. [Source: DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=godam).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: godam 是大锤；想象有人用“大锤”敲开电脑系统的大门。peng- 构成人或工具名，于是 penggodam 可指黑客，也保留大锤义。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 在此通常是第三人称领属附着语，表示他或她的；为适配给定字段归入 suffix，但不是普通派生后缀。词根不变，ng 表示 /ŋ/，其后的 g 表示 /ɡ/，ny 表示 /ɲ/。音节划分依据构词补出。输入的 Jawi ڤوڠݢوڠ 仅对应词根，完整词形补为 ڤوڠݢوڠڽ。

word_family.gloss: 背向；转过背去（米南加保用法）

senses.zh_definition: 他或她的臀部；坐下时承受身体重量、位于腰部与大腿之间的身体后部。
senses.en_definition: His or her buttocks, the rear part of the body between the waist and thighs.
senses.ms_definition: Bahagian badan di antara pinggang dengan paha yang menjadi tempat duduk, dengan -nya merujuk kepada orang yang berkenaan.
senses.nuances: 这是马来西亚日常语境中最常见的身体部位义。-nya 本身不区分男女；翻译须依照先行词。此马来语释义是依据词根义及领属结构编写的释义，不冒充 DBP 对完整词形的逐字定义。词根义见 [PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=punggung)，附着代词连写规则见 [DBP 拼写指南](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf)。

collocations.en: pain in his or her buttocks
to massage his or her buttocks

senses.zh_definition: 他或她的背部；此义在《Kamus Dewan》中标作印度尼西亚用法。
senses.en_definition: His or her back; an anatomical sense marked as Indonesian usage.
senses.ms_definition: Bahagian belakang tubuhnya; makna punggung sebagai belakang ini ditandai Id dalam Kamus Dewan.
senses.nuances: 在马来西亚一般用 belakang 表示背部，不能把印尼语中的 punggung 疼痛一概译为臀部疼痛。下列是词根层面的词典搭配；buah punggung 是词典所载的肾脏称法，现代实用表达通常用 buah pinggang 或 ginjal。tulang punggung 也有支柱、主要力量的比喻义。[PRPM 词根义及搭配](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=punggung)

senses.zh_definition: 所指山丘或山体的脊背、山脊；由身体后部的形状引申。
senses.en_definition: The ridge or back of a previously mentioned hill or mountain.
senses.ms_definition: Bahagian bukit atau gunung yang menyerupai belakang, dengan rujukan ditentukan oleh konteks.
senses.nuances: 这是词根的地形引申义。完整词形 punggungnya 需要明确的上文指称，不能脱离语境直接理解为山脊。以下为词根搭配。[PRPM 地形义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=punggung)

senses.zh_definition: 所指物体的背面、背部或上部；具体指哪一面取决于物体和语境。
senses.en_definition: The back or upper surface of a previously mentioned object.
senses.ms_definition: Bahagian belakang atau atas sesuatu benda yang telah disebut, mengikut jenis benda dan konteks.
senses.nuances: 这是由身体部位延伸出的物体部位义，例如刀背或脚背。以下为词根搭配；punggung kaki 的现代日常说法也常用 belakang kaki。不可把任何物体的 belakang 都机械替换成 punggung。[PRPM 物体部位义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=punggung)

collocations.en: the upper surface of the foot

句末 ke 表示疑问。
聊天中也常说 punggung dia；punggungnya 可用于口头转述，但通常更偏书面。

etymology.historical_story: Punggung illustrates how a body-part word can extend to landscape and objects: the dictionary records a hill's ridge and the back of a knife alongside anatomical meanings. Punggungnya adds the attached pronoun -nya to that existing noun. These documented meanings explain its present structure, but they do not establish a dated origin or a particular borrowing history. [Dictionary](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=punggung); [spelling guide](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: punggung 想“坐下接触椅子的臀部”；加 -nya 就是“他或她的”。再由背部形状联想山脊和刀背。

morphology.pattern_note: 本条按输入限定为希腊字母及数学术语，DBP 标音为 pai，故读 /pai/。口语中表示 pergi 的同形词读 /pi/，须另行区分。此术语没有常用马来语派生词。

senses.zh_definition: 希腊字母表的第十六个字母，大写为 Π，小写为 π。

senses.nuances: 这是字母名称；大写 Π 与小写 π 在数学中可以承担不同功能，不能一概解释为圆周率。符号已修复输入中的损坏字符。依据：[DBP PRPM：pi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=pi)。

senses.zh_definition: 圆周率：欧几里得平面内圆的周长与直径之比，以 π 表示，约为 3.14159265。
senses.en_definition: The irrational constant π, the ratio of a circle’s circumference to its diameter, approximately 3.14159265.
senses.ms_definition: Pemalar matematik yang merupakan nisbah lilitan bulatan kepada diameternya, dilambangkan dengan π dan bernilai kira-kira 3.14159265.
senses.nuances: 22/7 和 3.142 都只是近似值，不等于 π 的精确值。本释义纠正输入中可能造成精确相等误解的表述。词义参见 [DBP PRPM：pi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=pi)；数学定义参见 [Wolfram MathWorld：Pi](https://mathworld.wolfram.com/Pi.html)。

etymology.historical_story: Pi takes its name from the Greek letter π. William Jones used that letter for the circumference-to-diameter ratio in his 1706 mathematics book, and Euler later helped establish the notation. The modern Malay term participates in this international mathematical vocabulary; the packet does not establish when it first entered Malay. Reference: [MacTutor history of mathematical constants](https://mathshistory.st-andrews.ac.uk/Miller/mathsym/constants/).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 pi /pai/，就想“圆周 ÷ 直径”：π ≈ 3.14159。不要与口语中读 /pi/、表示“去”的同形词混淆。

etymology.historical_story: Pelari turns the action lari into the person performing it through the prefix pe-. Its dictionary meanings preserve two directions of the same action: running as sport and running away. Modern sporting combinations, especially pelari pecut and pelari maraton, usually make the athletic interpretation immediately clear to readers. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=pelari)

senses.zh_definition: 铺路用的焦油状材料；沥青。

etymology.historical_story: The spelling pek brings together two borrowing histories. Kamus Dewan marks the road-surfacing sense as Dutch-derived and colloquial; Dutch pek denotes pitch. The everyday packaging sense is traced to English pack. Consequently, a familiar supermarket word can conceal an unrelated material term in an older dictionary entry. The shared spelling does not mean that a packet somehow developed its meaning from road tar. Sources: [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pek), [Wiktionary: pek](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/pek).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 购物时听到 pek，就联想英语 pack：dua pek＝两包。读道路材料词条时切换画面：黑色黏稠的铺路沥青；两义分别记。

word_family.gloss: 和平；和睦；实际构词词根

senses.zh_definition: 和解；息争后的和平状态；争执或敌对双方恢复和好关系的过程或结果。
senses.en_definition: Reconciliation or peace between parties that have been in conflict; the act or state of making peace.
senses.ms_definition: Perihal atau keadaan berdamai antara pihak yang berselisih atau bermusuhan.
senses.nuances: 重在冲突各方停止敌对或恢复关系，可用于家庭纠纷、社群冲突及国际关系。kedamaian 更常突出安宁平和的状态；perdamaian 不自动表示双方已完全互信。释义据 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=perdamaian) 改写。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Kedua-dua pihak bersetuju untuk meneruskan rundingan perdamaian bagi menamatkan konflik yang berlarutan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 双方同意继续和平谈判，以结束持续已久的冲突。
dual_scenarios.en: Both parties agreed to continue peace talks to end the prolonged conflict.

dual_scenarios.zh: 要是两边都愿意和好，那还是有机会和解的，对吧？
dual_scenarios.en: If both sides want to make up, there's still a chance of reconciliation, right?

nak 表示 mahu 或 hendak，kan 用于寻求认同。
perdamaian 带较正式色彩；朋友谈和好时，berdamai 或 berbaik semula 更自然。

messages.ms_standard: Adakah kamu sudah mendengar berita itu? Kedua-dua pihak mahu bertemu esok untuk membincangkan soal perdamaian.
messages.zh: 你听说了吗？两边明天想见面，谈谈和解的事。
messages.en: Have you heard? Both sides want to meet tomorrow to talk about reconciliation.

messages.en: That's good. I hope it works out this time. They've been fighting for far too long.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 调解时用 usaha perdamaian 或 mencari jalan perdamaian，能把重点放在共同解决问题；避免当众以命令口吻要求某一方认错。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于外交、社群协调和私人和解。促成和解时应给双方表达和保全面子的空间；不可把 perdamaian 理解为受伤害者必须原谅或立即恢复交往。

etymology.historical_story: Perdamaian is built from damai with the Malay circumfix per-...-an, naming the making or condition of peace. DBP also presents a proverb comparing conflict to a wound that is easy to cause but difficult to heal. That image makes reconciliation a demanding repair of relationships, rather than merely a pleasant feeling of calm. Source: [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=perdamaian).

etymology.historical_story: Perhimpunan belongs to the Malay family built around himpun, expressing gathering and collection. The circumfix per-...-an forms a noun associated with people assembling. Kamus Dewan also preserves an older place sense, illustrated by goods coming together for trade. These meanings connect a gathering as an event with the place where things converge. Source: [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=perhimpunan).

etymology.historical_story: Putri and Malaysian puteri descend from Sanskrit putrī, meaning daughter. The World Loanword Database associates the borrowing with early Malay contact involving Indian trade and cultural influence. Malay usage connects the word with both princesses and respectful references to daughters. Adding the Malay possessive clitic -ku produces the intimate meaning my daughter or my princess. See [WOLD](https://wold.clld.org/word/71261839117036542).

etymology.historical_story: Kamus Dewan marks perabot as Javanese in origin and records the broad meaning tools or implements. Its examples include household furnishings and a carpenter's equipment. etymology.historical_story: The word shows two layers of Malay grammar. Main supplies the idea of play; per-...-an forms permainan, naming a game, playing, or related activity. The attached -nya then identifies whose play is meant or refers back to an established game. Its wider dictionary senses extend play toward performance, unserious conduct, and being treated as a plaything. See [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=permainan).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: main＝玩；per-...-an 把“玩”装进名词盒，成为 permainan；再接 -nya，就成为“他／她的玩法、游戏或表现”。

morphology.pattern_note: 此处纠正输入将 pemahaman 标为词根的结果：它是 faham 的派生名词。该固定构形中 peN- 实现为 pem-，词根首字母 f 不保留；不要将这一变化推广到所有以 f 开头的借词。词根及派生关系见 DBP 的 faham 词条。[DBP：faham](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=faham)

etymology.historical_story: Pemahaman illustrates how Malay builds an abstract noun around the established base faham: the idea of understanding becomes something whose process, depth or outcome can be discussed. DBP records it within the faham family alongside memahami and kefahaman. The family offers a useful cultural bridge between everyday expressions of understanding and the language of education or formal explanation. [DBP: faham and its derivatives](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=faham)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 faham＝懂，再套上 peN-...-an：pemahaman 就是“理解这件事”或“理解到的内容”。

etymology.historical_story: Malay makes the predator–prey relationship visible within one word family. Mangsa names the prey or victim, while the prefix peN- produces pemangsa, the animal doing the preying. The same imagery extends into descriptions of human exploitation, including the established term pemangsa seksual. This is a transparent Malay formation. See [DBP: mangsa](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=mangsa).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 mangsa＝猎物，再加表示行为者的 peN-：pemangsa＝捕食猎物的那一方。

morphology.formula: pengikut + -nya → pengikutnya；底词内部：peN- + ikut → pengikut
morphology.pattern_note: 按输入保留直接底词 pengikut；更深层词根是 ikut。peN- 在元音 i 前取 peng-，不删除 i。-nya 是后附代词，此处依字段归入 suffix，读 /ɲa/，不改变底词。音节据完整词形补全；输入爪夷仅含底词，完整词形为 ڤڠيکوتڽ。

etymology.historical_story: Pengikutnya shows how Malay builds a social relationship from an action. Ikut means to follow; peN- forms the person noun pengikut, and -nya connects that person or group to someone already mentioned. The same structure now works naturally for online followers, linking physical following and allegiance with the everyday language of social media.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按三步记：ikut＝跟，pengikut＝跟随的人，pengikutnya＝跟随他或她的人；末尾 nya 像一根回指前文人物的小箭头。

etymology.historical_story: English power developed through French forms associated with being able to act. That background connects its meanings of ability, strength and authority. In Malaysian informal speech, the borrowed form can also praise someone’s skill or an impressive result. This conversational use needs its own register label: it does not make every English meaning a standard Malay meaning. [Historical forms](https://www.anglo-norman.net/entry/povoir), [local usage observation](https://www.reddit.com/r/bahasamelayu/comments/1e3lz3h/).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听见“memang power”，先想到“真厉害”；看见机器上的 POWER，再想到电源或功率。

etymology.historical_story: Pelaut makes a person's relationship with the sea visible in its structure: pe- forms the person word from laut, sea. DBP defines it broadly around regularly going to sea. In contemporary Malaysian maritime administration, the term also names a professional community with training, certification, welfare, and shipboard responsibilities, extending beyond the everyday image of a sailor on deck.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: laut＝海，pe- 在这里把“海”变成“从事海上活动的人”：pe- + laut → 海员。

morphology.pattern_note: pipi 是完整词根；两个 pi 音节不表示现代马来语的重叠构词。berpipi 由 ber- 加词根构成；pipinya 的 -nya 表示第三人称领属。

word_family.gloss: 有着某种脸颊的，常接 tembam 等形容词

senses.zh_definition: 面部两侧、太阳穴下方的柔软部分；脸颊。

senses.ms_definition: Bahagian muka di bawah pelipis.
senses.nuances: 指脸颊，不是整个面部，也不是下巴。可说 pipi kiri、pipi kanan 或 kedua-dua belah pipi。tulang pipi 指颧骨；lesung pipi 指酒窝，亦称 lesung pipit。

tu 对应 itu；sikit 在请求中可缓和语气。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: pipi 本身是中性身体部位词。评论成年人的脸颊胖瘦或外貌可能让人尴尬；pipi tembam 在亲密关系中可带亲昵意味，但须看对方感受。

etymology.historical_story: Pipi belongs to a widespread Austronesian family of words for cheeks and temples. Related forms occur in Iban, Javanese, Sundanese, and several other languages. The comparative dictionary links Malay pipi with reconstructed *piSpiS through a Malayo-Polynesian stage. Its repeated syllables are therefore not evidence of productive reduplication in modern Malay. [Austronesian Comparative Dictionary](https://acd.clld.org/cognatesets/30401)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 念 pi-pi 时，想象左右两边各一块脸颊：pi 在左，pi 在右。这只是记忆画面，不是重叠构词分析。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语整词在口语中使用，不拆成马来语词缀。正式马来语依语境使用pelan、rancangan或merancang；IPA表示英语读法，实际混语发音有差异。

senses.zh_definition: 计划；为某项活动或目标拟定的安排，属英语夹用。
senses.en_definition: A proposed course of action or arrangement, used in English–Malay code-switching.
senses.ms_definition: Rancangan atau susunan tindakan untuk mencapai sesuatu tujuan; bentuk bahasa Inggeris yang digunakan dalam percakapan bercampur.
senses.nuances: 常见于熟人聊天及部分职场口语。标准书面语用rancangan或pelan。DBP明确采用pelan，因此此处不将plan标为official。[DBP拼写说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=Pelan)

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: plan本身不失礼，但英语夹用是否合适取决于对象。面对不熟悉英语的听者，rancangan通常更清楚。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合朋友聊天及允许混语的工作交流。公文、考试和正式马来语报告应使用标准对应词；引用英语原文时可保留plan。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: plan本身不失礼，但英语夹用是否合适取决于对象。面对不熟悉英语的听者，rancangan通常更清楚。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合朋友聊天及允许混语的工作交流。公文、考试和正式马来语报告应使用标准对应词；引用英语原文时可保留plan。

etymology.historical_story: Plan illustrates the contact between English and Malay in Malaysian conversation. Speakers may insert the English noun or verb into a Malay sentence while retaining Malay particles and sentence structure. Formal Malay uses pelan for an organized scheme or drawing, and rancangan or merancang where the meaning concerns intentions or the act of planning.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 英语plan直接认；写正式马来语时，名词想到pelan或rancangan，动词想到merancang。

morphology.formula: ∅ + pasien → pasien（接受医生诊治的病人；整词记忆）
morphology.pattern_note: 不拆成 pa- 与 sien；é 表示 e taling，音标按 pa.sién 的两音节读法推定。pesakit 是同义对应词，不是从 pasien 派生的词，因此不列为同根词。

senses.zh_definition: 接受医生诊治的病人；患者。词典标注为印度尼西亚—荷兰语背景用词，马来西亚正式用语通常采用 pesakit。
senses.en_definition: A sick person receiving medical treatment; a patient. Marked IB in Kamus Dewan.
senses.ms_definition: IB: orang sakit yang dalam rawatan doktor, pesakit.
senses.nuances: official 在这里表示有官方词典收录依据，不表示它是马来西亚正式文本的推荐用词。Kamus Dewan 标注 IB；DBP 建议正式写作避免使用此类带标签词，宜用 pesakit。以下搭配用于识读 pasien，不作为马来西亚公文首选。[DBP: pasien](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=pasien)；[DBP 关于 IB 标签的说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=ib)

dual_scenarios.context: 职场编辑说明；以标准马来语说明地域用词
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam terjemahan laporan ini untuk pembaca Malaysia, istilah pasien digantikan dengan pesakit.
dual_scenarios.zh: 在这份面向马来西亚读者的报告译文中，pasien 一词改用 pesakit。
dual_scenarios.en: In the translation of this report for Malaysian readers, the term pasien is replaced with pesakit.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流；辨认印尼文本中的用词
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Pasien dalam artikel tu maksudnya pesakit je.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Perkataan pasien dalam artikel itu bermaksud pesakit.
dual_scenarios.zh: 那篇文章里的 pasien，就是“患者”的意思。
dual_scenarios.en: Pasien in that article just means patient.
spoken_features: tu 是 itu 的口语缩略形式。
je 对应 sahaja。
maksudnya 在这里用于简洁解释词义。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku baca artikel Indonesia ni. Pasien tu maksudnya apa?
messages.ms_standard: Saya sedang membaca artikel dari Indonesia ini. Apakah maksud perkataan pasien?
messages.zh: 我在看这篇印尼文章。pasien 是什么意思？
messages.en: I'm reading this Indonesian article. What does pasien mean?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Maksudnya pesakit je. Kat Malaysia, kita biasanya sebut pesakit.
messages.ms_standard: Perkataan itu bermaksud pesakit. Di Malaysia, kita biasanya menggunakan perkataan pesakit.
messages.zh: 就是患者啦。在马来西亚，我们一般说 pesakit。
messages.en: It just means patient. In Malaysia, we usually say pesakit.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 与患者本人交流时，宜使用其姓名、适当称谓或 anda，避免把疾病称呼当作人的全部身份。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 阅读印尼材料或讨论地域词汇时可使用 pasien；马来西亚医院告示、公文及本地化医疗说明宜用 pesakit。解释地域差异时保持中性，避免把印尼用法说成错误语言。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 与患者本人交流时，宜使用其姓名、适当称谓或 anda，避免把疾病称呼当作人的全部身份。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 阅读印尼材料或讨论地域词汇时可使用 pasien；马来西亚医院告示、公文及本地化医疗说明宜用 pesakit。解释地域差异时保持中性，避免把印尼用法说成错误语言。

etymology.historical_story: Kamus Dewan marks pasien with IB, identifying an Indonesian–Dutch linguistic background. The label preserves a trace of the region's multilingual vocabulary history, but dictionary inclusion does not make every recorded form suitable for Malaysian official writing. Here, pesakit is the useful Malaysian counterpart. Recognising both forms helps readers move between Indonesian texts and Malaysian usage without confusing their registers. [DBP: pasien](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=pasien), [DBP: IB](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=ib)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 pasien，联想到英语 patient：都是患者；在马来西亚表达时，再接上常用词 pesakit。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 在这里是后附的第三人称领属代词，按本格式归入 suffix；与前词连写，词干不变，ny 读 /ɲ/。headword.jawi 按包保留，但 ڤجابت 只拼出 pejabat；完整 pejabatnya 应写作 ڤجابتڽ。音节字段依包保留 null，完整词可分为 pe.ja.bat.nya。

senses.zh_definition: 他或她的办公室、办公地点；具体所属者由上下文确定。

etymology.historical_story: Pejabatnya illustrates a productive Malay grammatical pattern rather than a separate historical coinage: an office noun takes the attached pronoun -nya. The resulting form identifies an office through its association with someone already mentioned. Dictionary relatives such as berpejabat and sepejabat show how the same office vocabulary supports expressions about having an office and sharing a workplace. etymology.historical_story: Pakaiannya shows how Malay builds meaning in layers: pakai concerns wearing or using, pakaian names clothing, and -nya identifies the possessor. The dictionary also preserves a figurative sense of pakaian as habitual practice. Clothing and customary behaviour therefore meet in one word family, although modern readers will usually encounter the literal clothing sense first. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274404&keyword=pakaian)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: pakai“穿”＋-an → pakaian“衣物”；再加 -nya →“他或她的衣物”。先认出衣服，再找衣服的主人。

morphology.pattern_note: root_word 与 root_jawi 保留数据包原值，但实际构词词根是 bebas（بيبس），本词不是单纯词根。peN- 在 b 前实现为 pem-，原有 b 保留；bé 中的 e 读 /e/。[DBP：bebas 及其派生词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=246792&keyword=bebas)

word_family.gloss: 解放者；释放某物的事物

senses.zh_definition: 使人摆脱拘禁、控制或压迫，或使地区摆脱占领的行为、过程或努力；释放；解放。

senses.ms_definition: Perihal, tindakan atau usaha membebaskan seseorang atau sesuatu daripada tahanan, kongkongan atau penguasaan.
senses.nuances: 重点在促成自由的行动或过程；kebebasan 更侧重自由的状态。既可指释放被拘禁者，也可指解放受占领地区。[DBP：pembebasan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pembebasan)

senses.zh_definition: 解除某人所承担的债务、义务、责任或其他约束。

senses.ms_definition: Tindakan melepaskan seseorang daripada hutang, kewajipan, tanggungjawab atau ikatan tertentu.
senses.nuances: 通常通过 daripada 引出被解除的负担。具体涉及税项或收费豁免时，行政语境也常采用 pengecualian，应依相关文件选词。[DBP：membebaskan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=membebaskan)

senses.zh_definition: 使原本储存、结合或受约束的物质或能量释放出来的过程。

senses.ms_definition: Proses melepaskan bahan atau tenaga yang sebelumnya tersimpan, terikat atau terkandung.
senses.nuances: 属于科学技术语境的释放义；可对应 release，也可依具体过程译为 emission。不能一概理解为政治上的解放。[DBP：相关科学用例](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=penyahtoksikan)

etymology.historical_story: Pembebasan belongs to a transparent Malay word family built on bebas, meaning free. Its circumfix turns freedom into an action or process: making someone or something free. Political writing uses it for liberation, while reporting uses it for release from detention. Remembering this contrast with kebebasan helps distinguish the event of becoming free from the resulting condition of freedom.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先抓住 bebas＝自由：membebaskan 是把人放出来，pembebasan 是这次释放，kebebasan 是获得的自由。

etymology.historical_story: Pentagon belongs to an international mathematical vocabulary whose ancestry reaches Greek pentagōnon, meaning a five-angled figure. Its historical components express five and angle, although Malay treats the borrowed word as a single lexical base. The same shape also explains the name of the American Pentagon building, from which a political and military metonym developed. [Word history](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/pentagon).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 penta- 与“五”联系：五条边、五个角，就是 pentagon；不必画成五角星。

morphology.pattern_note: -lah 是附着并连写的强调语助词，不是派生后缀，因此 affix_type 记为 none；affix 字段仅记录附着成分。pakai 的词干不变，ai 保留双元音。pakailah 不是因派生词缀形成的新词。

senses.zh_definition: 穿上吧；戴上吧。用于劝告、邀请、允许或要求对方穿戴某物。
senses.en_definition: Wear it or put it on, expressed as an encouragement, permission, or instruction.

etymology.historical_story: Pakailah shows how Malay can shape an instruction without creating a new lexical verb. The base pakai supplies the action, while the attached particle -lah adds emphasis and can soften a command. DBP explicitly distinguishes such particles from derivational affixes. This small form connects standard written instructions with the flexible interpersonal tone of everyday Malaysian conversation.

etymology.historical_story: Profil belongs to an international vocabulary associated with outlines and descriptions. English profile traces to Italian profilo, originally an outline drawing. The movement from a visible outline to a written portrait helps explain the modern connection between a person's appearance, biography, and digital identity. This historical comparison does not establish the precise borrowing route into Malay. [Etymology of profile](https://www.etymonline.com/word/profile)

etymology.historical_story: Parking retains its English spelling when used in informal Malaysian Malay. A useful linguistic feature is its flexibility: speakers can use it for the action of leaving a car or for the space they hope to find. Formal Malay expresses those meanings separately through phrases such as meletakkan kereta and tempat letak kereta. [DBP: parking](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=parking)

etymology.historical_story: Paya has a long documented history as a Malay landscape word. John Crawfurd's 1852 dictionary already records it for marshy ground, showing that its present meaning predates modern environmental terminology. The word connects naturally with the watery landscapes described in Malay geographical vocabulary. This historical attestation establishes continuity of use without requiring a speculative account of its ultimate origin. [Historical dictionary](https://wallace-online.org/converted/pdf/1852_Crawfurd_WS5.2.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: pa-ya：想象脚踩进湿地，发出“啪呀”的水声，再把画面锁定为长着植物的沼泽；这是记忆联想，不是词源。

morphology.pattern_note: 加后缀 -kan，词根读音不变。常见于祈使句和第一、第二人称被动结构；完整主动形式为 memusingkan，其中 meN- 与 p 结合，p 脱落。headword.jawi 按数据包保留，但 ڤوسيڠ 仅表示 pusing；含后缀的完整拼写应为 ڤوسيڠکن。音节字段保留数据包的 null；教学分节可作 pu.sing.kan。

etymology.historical_story: Pusingkan is transparently formed within Malay from pusing and the suffix -kan. Its meanings connect physical rotation with changing direction, circulating money, and the mental sensation of being confused. These connections help explain an established family of uses, but they do not establish the chronological order in which those meanings developed. [DBP: pusing](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=pusing)

etymology.historical_story: The revealing story lies in its word family: ajar connects teaching, studying, teachers, and students through different affixes. Pembelajaran names the learning process, while pengajaran names teaching. Their familiar pairing, pengajaran dan pembelajaran, presents education from both sides of the classroom. The longer word therefore carries a compact relationship between guidance and the learner's own activity. [DBP word family](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=273844&keyword=ajar)

etymology.historical_story: The useful story here is morphological rather than a securely dated origin. DBP distinguishes pasang meaning a pair from pasang associated with fitting, lighting, and setting things in place. Adding -kan produces pasangkan, while the full active form is memasangkan. This explains why a classroom matching instruction and a household installation request can share the same written form. [DBP: memasangkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=memasangkan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: pasang 想成“放到合适的位置或配成一对”，加 -kan 后记住请求句 Tolong pasangkan…：帮忙装上、打开或配好；具体意思看宾语。

etymology.historical_story: An early comparative account linked Malay puji with Sanskrit pūjā, meaning worship or reverence, through a Javanese form. This is a historical explanation, not a modern Malay word-building rule. Today, puji covers ordinary appreciation as well as religious praise, while memuji and pujian form part of its established Malay family. [Historical account](https://pure.mpg.de/pubman/item/item_403645_3/component/file_403643/indian2_crawfurd1820.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: pu-ji 两拍，想象拍手称赞：“做得好！”再记 puji → memuji（去掉词首 p）→ pujian（赞美的话）。

senses.ms_definition: Pengalaman kamu merasai sesuatu melalui badan, kulit atau anggota deria.

collocations.en: your perception of the water temperature

senses.zh_definition: 你的感知能力或感觉敏锐度。
senses.en_definition: Your capacity or sensitivity to perceive sensations.
senses.ms_definition: Keupayaan atau kepekaan kamu untuk merasai dan mengesan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 承接 perasaan 的感觉能力义，较少见于现代日常对话。为避免误解为情绪，通常用 kepekaan deriamu 或 keupayaan deriamu。

senses.zh_definition: 你对某事的看法、判断或心中意见。
senses.en_definition: Your opinion, judgment, or assessment of something.
senses.ms_definition: Fikiran, pendapat atau pertimbangan kamu tentang sesuatu perkara.
senses.nuances: 属于 perasaan 的词典义，但语境中容易与情绪义重叠。正式征询意见时，pendapatmu、pandangan anda 或 pertimbangan tuan 更明确。

dual_scenarios.zh: 我想理解你的感受，但也不想逼你说。
dual_scenarios.en: I want to understand how you feel, but I don’t want to pressure you into talking.

nak 和 tak 分别对应 hendak 或 mahu，以及 tidak。
perasaanmu 在此比 perasaan kau 更显认真或抒情；它本身不是口语缩略形式。

etymology.historical_story: Perasaanmu combines the noun perasaan with the bound pronoun -mu. Its structure connects feeling with the person experiencing it: perasaan supplies the experience, while -mu identifies it as yours. Malay spelling joins this pronoun to the preceding word. The form therefore needs no separate historical borrowing story; it is a transparent formation within Malay.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 分两层记：rasa＝感觉，perasaan＝感受；末尾接 -mu＝你的，所以 perasaanmu＝你的感受。注意 perasaan 的双 a，别与 perasan 混淆。

morphology.pattern_note: 实际构词基底为 capai；peN- 在 c 前呈现为 pen-，词根首辅音 c 保留。root_word 与 root_jawi 按词包保留整词索引值，不表示该词在语言学上没有派生结构。

senses.zh_definition: 通过努力取得的成果、成就或表现；也指学习、工作等方面所达到的成绩水平。
senses.en_definition: An achievement or result obtained through effort; the level of performance attained.
senses.ms_definition: Apa yang telah dicapai (dihasilkan atau diperoleh), prestasi.
senses.nuances: 可指单项成就，也可概括整体成绩；本身不保证成绩优异，因此 pencapaian rendah 和 pencapaian merosot 都成立。此义对应《Kamus Dewan》第四版的释义，见 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=103260&keyword=pencapaian)。

senses.zh_definition: 达到目标、标准或预定水平这一行为或过程。
senses.en_definition: The act or process of attaining a goal, standard, or specified level.
senses.ms_definition: Perbuatan (hal, usaha dan sebagainya) mencapai sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 强调“达到”这件事时，后面常接 matlamat、sasaran 等目标名词。此义另见《Kamus Pelajar》第二版，见 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=103260&keyword=pencapaian)。

etymology.historical_story: Pencapaian turns the verb capai, to reach or attain, into a noun naming attainment or its result. Its imagery offers a useful bridge between reaching something physically and reaching a goal. In Malaysian educational and administrative writing, that result can be a student's performance, an institution's achievement, or progress towards a stated target. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=103260&keyword=pencapaian)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: capai＝够到目标；peN-…-an 把“达到”变成名词：够到了，就有 pencapaian——成果或成就。

morphology.pattern_note: 作为独立借词记忆，不按马来语词缀拆分。词首 ps- 可保留两个辅音，也可省去 p；两种起首读法均见词包对应的 DBP 读音记录。

senses.ms_definition: Cabang perubatan yang berkaitan dengan kajian dan rawatan gangguan mental.
