messages.ms_standard: Kita masak di rumah sahaja pada minggu ini supaya dapat berjimat sedikit.
messages.zh: 这周就在家做饭吧，能省一点。
messages.en: Let's just cook at home this week. That'll save us a bit.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 适合家庭理财、商务及公共财政语境。与不熟悉的人谈个人开支时，先说明用途，避免直接追问收入或评价对方消费。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 报销、费用分摊和预算讨论中，应明确金额、项目及付款责任。要求 AA 制可说 Kita kongsi perbelanjaan，语气通常比直接命令对方付款柔和。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 适合家庭理财、商务及公共财政语境。与不熟悉的人谈个人开支时，先说明用途，避免直接追问收入或评价对方消费。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 报销、费用分摊和预算讨论中，应明确金额、项目及付款责任。要求 AA 制可说 Kita kongsi perbelanjaan，语气通常比直接命令对方付款柔和。

etymology.historical_story: Perbelanjaan is built around belanja, a word associated with money used for particular needs. Its circumfix creates a noun covering both the act of spending and the money spent. This distinction links everyday household decisions with institutional accounts: buying groceries and recording departmental expenses belong to the same lexical family, despite their very different scales. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=belanja).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: belanja＝花钱；per-…-an 把动作装进账本，变成开支。注意末尾是 ja.an 两个音节。

morphology.pattern_note: is_root 与 root_word 保留词包的整词基形标记；实际可按 peN- + perhati → pemerhati 分析，peN- 在 p 前呈 pem-，基底首音 p 脱落。perhati 也属于 hati 的相关词族。[DBP 构词讨论](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/soalhati.pdf)

senses.zh_definition: 持续关注、观察某一领域或事态发展的人；观察人士。
senses.en_definition: A person who follows and observes developments in a particular field or situation.
senses.ms_definition: Orang yang mengikuti perkembangan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 常指政治、经济或社会领域的观察人士。称某人为 pemerhati 不自动表示其拥有专家资格、官方职位或独立立场；是否客观须另作说明。

senses.zh_definition: 以观察员身份出席会议等活动、但不参与讨论的人。
senses.en_definition: A person attending a conference or similar meeting as an observer without taking part in its discussions.
senses.ms_definition: Orang yang menghadiri persidangan dan sebagainya tetapi tidak mengambil bahagian dalam perbincangan dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 强调出席身份和参与范围，有别于正式代表 wakil 或代表团成员 perwakilan。实际发言、表决或其他权限须依主办方规则确定。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 会议报告
dual_scenarios.ms: Wakil pertubuhan itu menghadiri persidangan sebagai pemerhati tanpa mengambil bahagian dalam perbincangan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该组织代表以观察员身份出席会议，没有参与讨论。
dual_scenarios.en: The organization's representative attended the conference as an observer without participating in the discussions.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Esok aku ikut sebagai pemerhati je, bukan pembentang.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Esok saya akan hadir sebagai pemerhati sahaja, bukan sebagai pembentang.
dual_scenarios.zh: 明天我只是去旁听观察，不是去做报告。
dual_scenarios.en: I'm only attending as an observer tomorrow, not giving a presentation.
spoken_features: aku 用于熟人之间的非正式自称
ikut 在此口语化地表示一同出席
je 对应 sahaja
口语常省略可由语境判断的 akan 和 sebagai

messages.ms_spoken: Esok aku ikut sebagai pemerhati je, bukan pembentang.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 属于中性、较正式的身份描述。介绍来宾时可使用 beliau 等敬称，并准确说明其代表机构；避免把普通关注者擅自抬高为官方专家。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合新闻评论、会议及机构交流。担任观察员时应先了解主办方规定，不能仅凭此称谓推定自己拥有发言权或表决权。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 属于中性、较正式的身份描述。介绍来宾时可使用 beliau 等敬称，并准确说明其代表机构；避免把普通关注者擅自抬高为官方专家。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合新闻评论、会议及机构交流。担任观察员时应先了解主办方规定，不能仅凭此称谓推定自己拥有发言权或表决权。

etymology.historical_story: DBP discussions connect pemerhati with perhati and the wider hati word family. This family brings attention and observation into the same lexical network as the heart and inner feeling. Pemerhati names the person who observes; pemerhatian names the activity. Its conference sense gives that person a defined role, distinct from someone participating directly in the discussion. [DBP](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/soalhati.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 hati“心”：把心思放在事情发展上的人，就是 pemerhati“观察者”。pemerhati 是人，pemerhatian 是观察活动。

morphology.pattern_note: 后缀 -an 构成表示呈现内容或结果的名词；词根末尾 r 随后接元音重新划入末音节，成为 pa.pa.ran。输入包的整词词根标注已按 DBP 的 papar 派生关系校正。

senses.zh_definition: 向公众呈现的说明、叙述、报道或景象；被展示出来的内容。
senses.en_definition: An account, depiction or explanation presented to an audience.
senses.ms_definition: Kandungan yang dikemukakan untuk dilihat atau diketahui, termasuk cerita, penjelasan, kenyataan dan gambaran sesuatu keadaan.
senses.nuances: 侧重呈现出来的内容或形象；pemaparan 更侧重呈现的行为或过程。与悲惨遭遇等内容连用时可译为‘报道’或‘呈现’，不必译成屏幕显示。[DBP 的 paparan 释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=7120&keyword=paparan)

senses.zh_definition: 在电脑、手机或其他设备屏幕上显示的文字、图像、符号等信息；显示内容。
senses.en_definition: Text, images, symbols or other information shown on an electronic screen; a display.
senses.ms_definition: Maklumat berbentuk tulisan, imej, lambang atau grafik yang ditunjukkan pada skrin sesuatu peranti.
senses.nuances: 可讨论显示的内容、布局或效果。屏幕这个实体通常称 skrin，显示装置可称 pemapar；paparan 不应一概等同于硬件屏幕。[DBP 的显示义及派生词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=papar)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Paparan data pada portal itu telah dikemas kini untuk memudahkan pengguna membandingkan keputusan mengikut negeri.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该网站的数据展示已更新，方便用户按州比较结果。
dual_scenarios.en: The portal's data display has been updated to make it easier for users to compare results by state.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Paparan kat telefon aku kecil sangat, susah nak baca lah.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Paparan pada telefon saya terlalu kecil sehingga sukar dibaca.

messages.ms_standard: Boleh. Saya sudah menghantar fail itu melalui e-mel; bukalah fail tersebut pada komputer.
messages.zh: 可以。我已经把文件发到邮箱了，你直接在电脑上打开就行。
messages.en: Sure. I've emailed you the file, so just open it on your computer.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 属于中性标准词，适合职场、新闻和技术交流。评价同事的展示时，可说 Paparan ini boleh diperjelas lagi，表达‘这里还可以呈现得更清楚’。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 谈媒介描绘时要结合内容判断褒贬；谈设备故障时，应区分显示内容异常与实体屏幕损坏。涉及个人资料的 paparan，应注意是否适合公开展示。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 属于中性标准词，适合职场、新闻和技术交流。评价同事的展示时，可说 Paparan ini boleh diperjelas lagi，表达‘这里还可以呈现得更清楚’。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 谈媒介描绘时要结合内容判断褒贬；谈设备故障时，应区分显示内容异常与实体屏幕损坏。涉及个人资料的 paparan，应注意是否适合公开展示。

etymology.historical_story: Paparan is formed from papar with the noun suffix -an. Its dictionary senses connect public storytelling with electronic information: a newspaper can offer a paparan of hardship, while a computer offers a paparan of text and graphics. This connection makes the modern technical meaning accessible through an existing Malay word family concerned with showing and presenting.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: papar＝‘展示’，加 -an 就把动作变成‘展示出来的东西’：报道内容或屏幕内容都是 paparan。

morphology.pattern_note: per-...-an 构成表示行为或事件的名词；词根 tengkar 的辅音保持不变，两个 e 均读 /ə/。

senses.zh_definition: 双方或多方因意见不合而发生的口头争吵或争执。
senses.en_definition: An angry verbal disagreement between two or more people; a quarrel.
senses.ms_definition: Perihal bertengkar.
senses.nuances: 通常带有情绪对立，比中性的 perbincangan（讨论）更激烈；本身不表示已经发生肢体打斗，后者可用 perkelahian。马来文释义据 [DBP《Kamus Dewan》](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pertengkaran)。

messages.ms_spoken: Pertengkaran tadi dah selesai ke?

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 直接说他人发生 pertengkaran，可能让对方觉得被公开指责。职场上若只是轻微分歧，可按实际情况用 perbezaan pendapat（意见不同）。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于描述家庭、邻里或工作中的口角；不要把平静的讨论称为 pertengkaran，也不要仅凭这个词断定有人动手。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 直接说他人发生 pertengkaran，可能让对方觉得被公开指责。职场上若只是轻微分歧，可按实际情况用 perbezaan pendapat（意见不同）。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于描述家庭、邻里或工作中的口角；不要把平静的讨论称为 pertengkaran，也不要仅凭这个词断定有人动手。

etymology.historical_story: Pertengkaran belongs to the Malay word family built around tengkar. Its structure shows how Malay turns an action into the name of an event: bertengkar describes people quarrelling, while pertengkaran names the quarrel itself. The dictionary distinguishes this verbal conflict from perkelahian, which a quarrel may lead to. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pertengkaran)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 tengkar＝吵架；外面套上 per-...-an，就把“吵”变成“一场争吵”。

morphology.pattern_note: peN- 在 h 前采用 peng- 形式；词根首音 h 保留，ng 表示单一鼻音 /ŋ/。

senses.zh_definition: 在个人、团体或机构之间负责联络、传递信息或建立联系的人。
senses.en_definition: A person who establishes or maintains contact between people, groups, or institutions; a liaison.
senses.ms_definition: Orang yang menghubungkan seseorang atau sesuatu pihak dengan pihak yang lain.
senses.nuances: 强调联络与沟通功能，不必然具有代表任何一方作决定的权限。词根及人与工具两类用法见 [DBP：penghubung](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=penghubung)。

collocations.ms: penghubung antara pihak sekolah dengan ibu bapa
collocations.zh: 校方与家长之间的联络人
collocations.en: a liaison between the school and parents

senses.zh_definition: 连接两个或多个事物、地点或部分的工具、设施或纽带。
senses.en_definition: An object, facility, or means that connects things, places, or parts.
senses.ms_definition: Alat, kemudahan atau unsur yang menyambungkan sesuatu dengan sesuatu yang lain.
senses.nuances: 可指实体连接设施，也可比喻共同语言等联系纽带。作为修饰成分时仍源于名词用法，如 jalan penghubung。

senses.zh_definition: 语言中起连接作用的词语或成分；见于连词、篇章连接语等术语。
senses.en_definition: A linguistic element that links words, clauses, sentences, or stretches of discourse.
senses.ms_definition: Unsur bahasa yang menghubungkan perkataan, klausa, ayat atau bahagian wacana.
senses.nuances: kata penghubung 可指 kata hubung，即连词；penghubung wacana 的范围更广。penghubung 本身是术语中的名词，不因其含义而自动属于 conjunction 词类。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Pihak sekolah melantik seorang guru sebagai penghubung antara pihak pentadbiran dengan ibu bapa.
dual_scenarios.zh: 校方委任一名教师担任行政部门与家长之间的联络人。

dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Jika mahu menghubungi pihak sekolah, mintalah bantuan Cikgu Farah sahaja kerana beliau ialah penghubung kita.

口语可省略判断词 ialah。
Cikgu 保留对教师的尊称。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 称某人为 penghubung 通常中性且专业。提及教师或资深人员时，可搭配 Cikgu、Encik、Puan 等合适称谓。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 称某人为 penghubung 通常中性且专业。提及教师或资深人员时，可搭配 Cikgu、Encik、Puan 等合适称谓。

etymology.historical_story: Penghubung illustrates Malay's productive habit of naming people and instruments through the same prefix. Starting with hubung, associated with connection, peN- forms a noun for whoever or whatever connects. A liaison, a connecting road, and a grammatical connective therefore share one understandable image: something that brings otherwise separate sides into contact.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: hubung＝连接；peng- 帮你寻找执行连接的人或物：人是联络人，物是连接工具。

etymology.historical_story: Payahlah combines the established Malay adjective payah with the attached emphasis particle -lah. Its interest lies in conversational culture: the same description of difficulty can become a sigh, a complaint, or a sympathetic observation through intonation. Adding tak changes the construction again, producing the familiar reassurance or refusal tak payahlah, meaning there is no need.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 payah 想成“难呀”，再接 lah 的“啦”：payahlah＝“难办啦”；前加 tak，意思就变成“不必啦”。

etymology.historical_story: Peyton illustrates how a place name can become a surname and later a personal name. etymology.historical_story: Pengunjung belongs to the Malay family built around kunjung, the base found in berkunjung and mengunjungi. Its person-denoting prefix turns the visiting action into the person who visits. The same family appears in the expression kunjung-mengunjungi, describing reciprocal visits. Remembering that connection links a modern museum visitor with the familiar social practice of visiting one another. [DBP word family](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=kunjung)

etymology.historical_story: Paha belongs to an inherited Austronesian body-part vocabulary. Comparative evidence connects Malay paha with reconstructed *paqa, meaning thigh, and with related forms across several island languages. Malay proverbs then turn this familiar body part into social imagery: the calf and thigh represent escalating demands, while pain in both thighs evokes shared family consequences. [Austronesian Comparative Dictionary](https://ling.lll.hawaii.edu/dicts/ACD/acd-w_p.htm), [PRPM: paha](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=paha).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 念 pa-ha，轻拍大腿两下：pa、ha。用动作记身体部位，拼写牢牢记 paha。

senses.zh_definition: 为作出决定而对某件事的利弊、条件或后果进行的考虑与权衡。
senses.en_definition: Careful consideration of a matter and its merits or consequences before a decision.
senses.ms_definition: Pemikiran atau penelitian tentang baik buruk sesuatu perkara sebagai asas untuk membuat keputusan atau mengambil tindakan.
senses.nuances: 常用于申请、建议和决策程序。untuk pertimbangan 表示提交考虑，不表示已经批准。释义依据 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=109300&keyword=pertimbangan)。

senses.zh_definition: 经过思考而形成的判断、意见或评估。
senses.en_definition: A judgment, opinion, or assessment formed through reflection.
senses.ms_definition: Pendapat atau penilaian yang terhasil daripada proses mempertimbangkan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 强调思考所得的判断；pertimbangan profesional 指依据专业知识作出的判断，不一定是最终决定。

etymology.historical_story: Pertimbangan belongs to the family of timbang, meaning to weigh. Its semantic image connects weighing objects with weighing reasons before a decision. The per-…-an formation turns that activity into an abstract noun. This explains its natural place in applications, committee discussions, and professional judgment. The family relationship is recorded in [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=109300&keyword=pertimbangan).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 timbang 的“称重”：把赞成和反对的理由放上心中的秤，就是 pertimbangan。

etymology.historical_story: Praktikal closely corresponds to English practical and belongs to the international vocabulary of practice and application. Its Malaysian uses connect knowledge with real activity: training develops practical skills, while a proposal is practical when it can work. In student conversation, the word also shortens the expression for an internship, a usage illustrated in [DBP language consultations](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=praktikal).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 praktikal 和英语 practical 一起记：能动手操作、能实际用上，就很 praktikal。

morphology.formula: per- + juang + -kan → perjuangkan; meN- + perjuangkan → memperjuangkan
morphology.pattern_note: 词根为 juang；输入将 perjuangkan 标为词根有误。此形式保留 per- 和 -kan，常作祈使形式，亦见于第一、第二人称被动结构；对应完整主动形式为 memperjuangkan。词根 j 保留，ng 表示 /ŋ/。

senses.zh_definition: 把某项权利、利益、理想或事业作为奋斗目标，努力争取实现或加以维护。
senses.en_definition: To strive, campaign, or fight for a right, interest, ideal, or cause.
senses.ms_definition: Berusaha dengan bersungguh-sungguh untuk memperoleh, mencapai atau mempertahankan sesuatu yang dijadikan tujuan perjuangan.
senses.nuances: 及物形式，后接所争取或捍卫的对象，如 hak、keadilan、nasib pekerja。Berjuang 可不带直接宾语；perjuangkan 强调为某个明确对象奋斗，不必涉及武力。正式主动陈述使用 memperjuangkan，如 Persatuan itu memperjuangkan hak pekerja。词义及词族据 [PRPM：juang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=juang) 改写。

etymology.historical_story: Juang has dictionary senses involving struggle and contest; its derivatives also describe efforts to secure independence, better wages, or women's rights. This semantic range connects physical confrontation with organised advocacy. Perjuangkan identifies the cause being pursued, allowing the language of collective struggle to express both national aspirations and everyday demands for fair treatment.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: juang＝奋斗；perjuangkan 后面接“奋斗要争取什么”：perjuangkan hak，把力气用在争取权益上。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 姓名保持原有拼写并大写首字母。正式马来语中，若本意是“聪明、擅长”，应使用 pandai；未经上下文核实，不宜把所有 pandey 自动替换为 pandai。

etymology.historical_story: As a surname, Pandey belongs to a South Asian naming tradition. The Dictionary of American Family Names connects it with Hindi pāṇḍe, associated with learning and traditional occupations. This history explains the surname, but does not establish the meaning of an isolated lowercase token in a Malay corpus. [Source](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/pandey)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先辨身份再记词义：Pandey 大写可能是姓氏；若上下文表达“聪明、擅长”，再核对是否应为 pandai。

etymology.historical_story: Malay pupus connects the disappearance of living species with the loss of traditions, possessions, and affection. An archivist can preserve materials before they disappear, just as conservationists protect species before extinction. Dictionaries also record a separate Javanese-derived pupus meaning a young leaf or shoot; that botanical homonym should not be confused with disappearance.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pu.pus 的两拍想成“两次清点，最后一个也没有了”，记住“彻底消失”；嫩叶义另记。

etymology.historical_story: Pretty has an English history reaching back to Old English prættig, associated with cunning or cleverness. Its meanings later developed toward attractiveness, while an adverbial use came to express degree. In a Malay conversation, the English word may appear through code-switching; this does not by itself establish its acceptance as a standard Malay headword.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读作近似“普里提”，首音节重读。pretty dress 想“漂亮衣服”；pretty good 整块记“相当不错”，别把所有 pretty 都译成漂亮。

senses.zh_definition: 预测者；对未来事件或发展趋势作出判断的人。
senses.en_definition: A person who predicts future events or developments; a forecaster.
senses.ms_definition: Orang yang meramal atau meramalkan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 可指依据资料、经验或判断进行预测的人，不必涉及占卜。专业场合宜加上领域，如 peramal ekonomi。此义与占卜义同属 DBP 的宽泛释义，按使用情境分列。[DBP：ramal](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=ramal)

senses.zh_definition: 占卜者；声称能通过占星、算命等方式预知未来或个人命运的人。
senses.en_definition: A person who claims to foretell the future or someone's fortune through divination.
senses.ms_definition: Orang yang menilik nasib atau menelah perkara yang akan berlaku melalui amalan tilikan.
senses.nuances: 涉及命运、星象或神秘力量时通常取此义；tukang ramal 是常见近义表达。这个称呼本身不证明其预测可靠。

senses.zh_definition: 预测因子；统计模型中用于预测另一变量的变量或因素。
senses.en_definition: A variable or factor used to predict another variable in a statistical model.
senses.ms_definition: Pemboleh ubah atau faktor yang digunakan untuk meramalkan nilai atau hasil pemboleh ubah lain dalam model statistik.
senses.nuances: 统计学专门用法，通常出现在 pemboleh ubah peramal 等术语中；预测关系本身不等于因果关系。[马来亚大学数学与统计术语表](https://ism.um.edu.my/Image/Research/Links/MATHEMATICAL%20%26%20STATISTICAL%20TERMS/english_to_bm.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: Peramal is formed in Malay from ramal with an agent-forming prefix. DBP marks ramal as Arabic in origin and records both sand and sand used for divination among its meanings. That connection links an older fortune-telling vocabulary with today's broader language of prediction, including economic forecasting. [DBP: ramal](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=ramal)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: ramal 是“预测”，前面加表示“做这件事的人”的 pe-：peramal 就是“预测的人”。

morphology.formula: penyebab + -nya → penyebabnya；内部派生：peN- + sebab → penyebab
morphology.pattern_note: 按词包保留直接基词 penyebab；更深层词根是 sebab。peN- 与 sebab 结合时实现为 peny-，词根首音 /s/ 脱落。-nya 是附着成分，通常分析为代词附着语素，本字段按后接形式归入 suffix。两个 e 均读 /ə/。词包的 ڤڽبب 只拼出 penyebab，完整形式需加 ڽ，成为 ڤڽببڽ；音节划分为本条补足。

senses.zh_definition: 所谈事情的起因、成因或致因因素；其中 -nya 回指前文或语境中的事情。
senses.en_definition: Its cause; the factor responsible for the situation under discussion.
senses.ms_definition: Sesuatu yang menjadi sebab atau punca kepada perkara yang telah disebut atau difahami daripada konteks.
senses.nuances: 不是表示“因为”的连接词。其含义建立在名词 penyebab 上，-nya 把原因与已知事件联系起来。正式报告也常用 puncanya 或 sebabnya。这里的马来语定义是依据词典基词释义对完整形式作出的说明，并非独立词条的逐字引文。[DBP：penyebab](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=tindakan+nya)

senses.zh_definition: 造成所谈事情的人或有关方面；肇因者。
senses.en_definition: The person or party responsible for the event under discussion.
senses.ms_definition: Orang atau pihak yang menjadi sebab atau punca kepada kejadian atau perbuatan yang dimaksudkan.
senses.nuances: 通常在上下文明确谈论某个人或某个组织时成立。-nya 本身不指明肇因者的性别；是否带有责备意味取决于事件及语境。

collocations.en: he or she is the one responsible

etymology.historical_story: Penyebabnya illustrates productive Malay word formation rather than a separate inherited root. Sebab supplies the idea of a cause; peN- forms penyebab, the person or thing causing something; and attached -nya links that noun to an understood referent. The resulting form can identify either a causal factor or a responsible person, depending on the surrounding conversation.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: sebab 是“原因”，penyebab 是“造成事情的人或因素”，再接 -nya：把原因扣回“刚才那件事”。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合早餐、食谱、菜单及日常点餐。若对厚薄、配料或甜度有要求，应直接说明；penkek 本身不保证某一种固定配方。

etymology.historical_story: The spelling penkek suggests an adaptation of English pancake, although the supplied packet gives no borrowing history or date. Its place in Malaysian food vocabulary is documented by Ministry of Health menus pairing penkek with foods such as bananas. The useful cultural connection is breakfast: a familiar international dish expressed through a locally adapted spelling.

etymology.historical_story: Penjarakan brings two unrelated formations into the same spelling. The distancing noun belongs to jarak, while the imprisonment command belongs to penjara. A September 2020 Dewan Bahasa article addressed this confusion explicitly, explaining the sequence jarak, menjarakkan, penjarakan. The distinction shows why a familiar written shape can conceal different roots and grammatical functions. [DBP explanation](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/majalah/2020/db92020/files/basic-html/page15.html)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看见 penjarakan，先找语境：有 fizikal、sosial、baris，就想到 jarak＝距离；后面直接接被关押的人，才想到 penjara＝监狱。

etymology.historical_story: Peluru is associated with Portuguese pelouro, reflecting vocabulary exchange during Portuguese contact with the Malay world. An official Indonesian terminology guide lists this borrowing, while an older English–Malay vocabulary also marks peluru as Portuguese. Pelurunya then combines that established loanword with the Malay enclitic -nya, expressing possession or a relationship recoverable from context. [Terminology guide](https://repositori.kemendikdasmen.go.id/2351/1/BAHAN%20PENYULUHAN%20BAHASA%20INDONESIA-TATA%20ISTILAH.pdf) [Historical vocabulary](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/32/A_vocabulary_of_the_English_and_Malay_languages%3B_%28IA_anr0813.0001.001.umich.edu%29.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: Pemadam brings two familiar settings together: the classroom and fire protection. Its root padam concerns going out or disappearing, while the prefix peN- forms the name of an instrument. Something that removes pencil marks and something that extinguishes flames therefore share a word, with context or a following noun identifying the tool. [DBP root entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=113780&keyword=padam).

messages.en: Okay, I've read them. I'm heading in now.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 单独说 Patuhi! 带命令感。公共告示中 Sila patuhi… 很自然；对长辈、客户或上级提出要求时，可用 Mohon kerjasama untuk mematuhi…。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合安全规定、学校纪律、活动须知和工作程序。谈朋友间的普通建议时，用 ikut nasihat 或 dengar nasihat 往往更亲切。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 单独说 Patuhi! 带命令感。公共告示中 Sila patuhi… 很自然；对长辈、客户或上级提出要求时，可用 Mohon kerjasama untuk mematuhi…。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合安全规定、学校纪律、活动须知和工作程序。谈朋友间的普通建议时，用 ikut nasihat 或 dengar nasihat 往往更亲切。

etymology.historical_story: Patuhi illustrates a productive Malay pattern rather than a separate borrowed expression. The base patuh describes obedience or compliance; adding -i supplies a verb stem directed at an object. Public notices make this relationship especially visible: patuhi peraturan asks readers to act, while pematuhan names the act of compliance and kepatuhan describes the quality.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: patuh 是“服从”，加 -i 就把动作对准对象：patuhi arahan＝遵从指示。看到 -i，马上追问“遵守什么？”

morphology.formula: ∅ + pembicaraan → pembicaraan（按输入整词索引）；peN- + bicara + -an → pembicaraan（实际构词）
morphology.pattern_note: is_root 与 root_word 保留输入索引信息；从语言学构词看，本词是 bicara 的派生名词。peN- 在词首 b 前实现为 pem-，b 保留，后接 -an；末尾 ra.an 分属两个音节。

senses.zh_definition: 谈话；围绕某个话题进行的讨论。
senses.en_definition: Conversation or discussion about a subject.
senses.ms_definition: Percakapan atau perbincangan tentang sesuatu perkara.
senses.nuances: 马来西亚马来语可用，但在一般会议和工作交流中，perbincangan 往往更自然；不能把所有 pembicaraan 都理解为法庭听证。[DBP：bicara 及其派生词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=150348&keyword=bicara)

senses.zh_definition: 案件在法官面前接受审理；庭审。
senses.en_definition: The judicial hearing or trial of a case before a judge.
senses.ms_definition: Pengadilan sesuatu perkara di hadapan hakim; penggunaan berlabel Indonesia.
senses.nuances: 《Kamus Dewan》将此义标为 Id，即印度尼西亚用法。马来西亚司法语境通常使用 perbicaraan；本义本身不限定是否有陪审团。

dual_scenarios.ms: Pembicaraan antara kedua-dua wakil itu tertumpu pada usaha memperkukuh kerjasama pendidikan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 两位代表的讨论集中在加强教育合作的工作上。
dual_scenarios.en: The discussion between the two representatives focused on strengthening educational cooperation.

dual_scenarios.zh: 刚才已经聊到预算了吗？
dual_scenarios.en: Did the discussion get around to the budget?

句末 ke 表示疑问。
masuk bab 表示谈到某个方面；目标词本身仍带书面语色彩，日常也常说 perbincangan 或 sembang。

messages.ms_spoken: Pembicaraan tadi dah masuk bab bajet ke?

messages.ms_standard: Belum lagi. Kita mahu membincangkan jadual dahulu sahaja.

messages.en: Not yet. We just want to go over the schedule first.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 该词本身中性而偏书面。向上级提出讨论时，可说 Mohon kita lanjutkan perbincangan ini，以请求式表达保持礼貌。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合报道、叙述和较正式的讨论场景。撰写马来西亚法院文件时，庭审通常写 perbicaraan；一般同事聊天则优先考虑 perbincangan 或 bincang。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 该词本身中性而偏书面。向上级提出讨论时，可说 Mohon kita lanjutkan perbincangan ini，以请求式表达保持礼貌。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合报道、叙述和较正式的讨论场景。撰写马来西亚法院文件时，庭审通常写 perbicaraan；一般同事聊天则优先考虑 perbincangan 或 bincang。

etymology.historical_story: The lexical base bicara is traced to Sanskrit vicāra, associated with deliberation and investigation. Malay developed a family of words around speaking, discussion, and judicial proceedings. Pembicaraan names an activity of discussing, while Malaysian legal usage generally favours perbicaraan for a trial. This shared history explains the overlap between conversation and courtroom meanings. [Historical linguistic study](https://sealang.net/archives/nusa/pdf/nusa-v19-p1-38.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住中间的 bicara“谈论”：在它外面加上 pem- 和 -an，把“谈”装成名词“谈话、讨论”。

morphology.formula: pada → pd（书写缩略，不属于加词缀构词）
morphology.pattern_note: 按输入保留整词索引，但 pd 是缩写形式。此处按常见展开 pada 释读，IPA 对应展开词，不表示 pd 有独立词音；无独立音节划分，亦不补造 Jawi。其他展开须由上下文确定。

senses.zh_definition: pada 的书写缩写，用在时间表达之前，表示“在……时候”。
senses.en_definition: Written abbreviation of pada, introducing a time expression: at, on, or in.
senses.ms_definition: Singkatan bertulis bagi pada yang digunakan sebelum keterangan waktu.
senses.nuances: 这是缩写用法，而非独立的标准完整词。DBP 的短信指南也指出 pd 可能有不同展开，须结合语境；本条采用常见的 pada 解读。status 按指定格式填写，不表示该缩写适合正式行文。[DBP：短信语言指南](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/khidmatsms.pdf)

senses.zh_definition: pada 的书写缩写，用于表示看法的持有者，或某事所依赖、依据的对象。
senses.en_definition: Written abbreviation of pada, marking a viewpoint or the basis on which something depends.
senses.ms_definition: Singkatan bertulis bagi pada yang menandai sudut pandangan atau sandaran sesuatu perkara.
senses.nuances: 如 pada pendapat saya“依我看”、bergantung pada keadaan“视情况而定”。不能把 pd 无条件展开成 kepada；正式文本应写出完整形式。[DBP：pada 与 kepada 的用法](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pada+benda)

senses.zh_definition: pada 的书写缩写，表示物品由某人持有，或某种特点存在于某人或某物身上。
senses.en_definition: Written abbreviation of pada, marking a holder or the bearer of a quality.
senses.ms_definition: Singkatan bertulis bagi pada yang menunjukkan pemegang sesuatu atau tempat terdapatnya sesuatu sifat.
senses.nuances: 例如 Kunci ada pada Amir 表示钥匙在 Amir 手里。表达一般地理位置仍通常用 di，而不是把所有“在”都写成 pada。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam surat rasmi, singkatan 'pd' hendaklah ditulis penuh sebagai 'pada'.
dual_scenarios.zh: 在正式公函中，缩写 pd 应完整写作 pada。
dual_scenarios.en: In official correspondence, the abbreviation 'pd' should be written out as 'pada'.

spoken_features: pd 是聊天中的书写缩略；朗读时在本语境中展开为 pada。
je 对应 sahaja，表示“就、而已”。
句末 boleh 表示征询对方是否方便。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 朋友之间的简短讯息通常可以使用。给老师、客户或初次联系的人写信时，完整写 pada 更清楚，也更显认真。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于私人聊天、速记和明确允许缩写的资料。正式公函、考试及公开说明一般写 pada；大写 PD 还可能指专名或其他缩略语，不能直接套用本条。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 朋友之间的简短讯息通常可以使用。给老师、客户或初次联系的人写信时，完整写 pada 更清楚，也更显认真。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于私人聊天、速记和明确允许缩写的资料。正式公函、考试及公开说明一般写 pada；大写 PD 还可能指专名或其他缩略语，不能直接套用本条。

etymology.historical_story: Pd is a graphic shortening rather than an independently inherited word. It preserves the consonants of pada while omitting its vowels. DBP's guide to SMS language discusses pd as an abbreviation whose interpretation depends on context, including possible readings as pada or padu. Its history belongs to writing practices, not to a new spoken root.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: pada 去掉两个 a，留下 pd；看到 pd，先用上下文把元音补回来。

morphology.pattern_note: peN- 遇词首 t 时形成 pen-，t 脱落。root_word 与 root_jawi 按输入保留词条形式；实际构词词根是 tinggal，输入中的 is_root: true 已纠正。

word_family.gloss: 在某人离开或去世之后

senses.zh_definition: 某人留下的物品、财产或传承；常指逝者遗物、遗产。
senses.en_definition: Something left behind, especially an inheritance, heirloom or personal legacy.
senses.ms_definition: Sesuatu yang ditinggalkan oleh seseorang, termasuk pusaka atau warisan.
senses.nuances: 可指有经济价值或仅有纪念价值的东西，不必然表示法律意义上的遗产。完整义项参见：[DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=peninggalan)。

senses.zh_definition: 某人离去或去世之后；词典关联形式为 sepeninggalan。
senses.en_definition: After someone's departure or death; equivalent to sepeninggalan.
senses.ms_definition: Sesudah seseorang berangkat, pergi atau meninggal dunia; sepeninggalan.
senses.nuances: 这是词典保留的时间义，现代学习者宜掌握较明确的 sepeninggalan 或 selepas pemergian。以下搭配展示该关联形式。

senses.zh_definition: 古代或过去时代遗留下来的遗迹、遗物或残存事物。
senses.en_definition: A relic, remnant or surviving trace of an earlier period.
senses.ms_definition: Sisa atau bekas yang masih ada daripada zaman dahulu.
senses.nuances: 常见于历史、考古和文物保护；不一定涉及某个具体逝者。

dual_scenarios.ms: Pihak muzium sedang mendokumentasikan peninggalan sejarah yang ditemukan di tapak tersebut.
dual_scenarios.zh: 博物馆方面正在为该遗址发现的历史遗存建立档案。
dual_scenarios.en: The museum is documenting the historical remains discovered at the site.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Jam ni peninggalan arwah datuk. Aku nak simpan.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Jam ini ialah peninggalan arwah datuk. Saya mahu menyimpannya.
dual_scenarios.zh: 这块表是已故爷爷留下的，我想留着。
dual_scenarios.en: This watch belonged to my late grandfather. I want to keep it.
spoken_features: ni 对应 ini，tu 对应 itu。
nak 对应 mahu。
dah 对应 sudah。
口语可省略名词谓语前的 ialah。

messages.ms_spoken: Jam peninggalan arwah datuk tu kau dah jumpa?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah kamu sudah menemukan jam peninggalan arwah datuk itu?
messages.zh: 爷爷留下的那块表，你找到了吗？
messages.en: Have you found the watch our late grandfather left behind?

messages.zh: 找到了，我想好好留着作纪念。
messages.en: Yes. I want to take good care of it as a keepsake.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 谈逝者遗物时可用 arwah 表示追念；王室语境常用 almarhum 或 almarhumah。介绍具体人物时尊重其家庭惯用称谓。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于家庭纪念、遗产讨论和历史保护。对方谈有感情价值的遗物时，避免直接当作可出售的旧物评价。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 谈逝者遗物时可用 arwah 表示追念；王室语境常用 almarhum 或 almarhumah。介绍具体人物时尊重其家庭惯用称谓。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于家庭纪念、遗产讨论和历史保护。对方谈有感情价值的遗物时，避免直接当作可出售的旧物评价。

etymology.historical_story: The word belongs to the Malay family built on tinggal, meaning to stay or remain. Its noun formation brings together what survives a person's departure and what survives an earlier age. A family keepsake and an archaeological ruin therefore share the same central idea: something remains when its original owner or world has gone. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=peninggalan).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 tinggal“留下”：人走了，留下来的遗物或遗迹就是 peninggalan。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语整词，不拆作马来语词根与词缀。所列音标采用英语英式读音；规范马来语对应拼写为 parti。以下词族形式属于英语。

word_family.gloss: 英语复数：多个派对；拼写由 y 变为 ies
英语形式：参加派对、聚会玩乐

senses.zh_definition: 派对；以庆祝、娱乐或社交为目的的聚会。
senses.en_definition: A social gathering for celebration or entertainment.
senses.ms_definition: Perjumpaan sosial untuk meraikan sesuatu atau untuk bersuka-suka; parti.
senses.nuances: party 是英语拼写，在马来语聊天中属于夹用英语；规范马来语使用 parti，也可依场合使用 majlis。英语 party 另有“政党”“当事方”等义，马来语分别依语境使用 parti、pihak 等词，不能一概译为派对。参见 [DBP：parti](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=parti)。

collocations.zh: 生日派对（规范拼写：parti hari jadi）

senses.zh_definition: 参加派对；聚会玩乐。
senses.en_definition: To attend parties or celebrate socially.
senses.ms_definition: Bersuka-suka atau berhibur dalam sesuatu parti.
senses.nuances: 这是夹用的英语动词用法，适合熟人聊天；正式马来语应按意思改用 menghadiri parti 或 bersuka-suka。参见 [Merriam-Webster：party](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/party)。

collocations.zh: 一起去聚会吧（夹用英语）
聚会玩到天亮（夹用英语）

dual_scenarios.ms: Penganjur menggunakan perkataan Inggeris 'party' dalam iklan, manakala surat jemputan rasmi menyebut acara itu sebagai majlis sambutan.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 熟人聊天可夹用 party；正式邀请、学校作文或公文宜用 parti 或具体的 majlis 名称。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: party 本身不必然表示饮酒或夜店活动。邀请别人时，应说明活动性质、时间与餐饮安排，尊重对方的宗教和个人习惯。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 熟人聊天可夹用 party；正式邀请、学校作文或公文宜用 parti 或具体的 majlis 名称。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: party 本身不必然表示饮酒或夜店活动。邀请别人时，应说明活动性质、时间与餐饮安排，尊重对方的宗教和个人习惯。

etymology.historical_story: English party came through Middle English partie from Anglo-French, with an earlier connection to dividing or forming a part. Its meanings encompass a side, an organised group, and a social gathering. Malaysian usage distinguishes the English spelling party from the standard Malay spelling parti, which also covers political organisations. Sources: [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/party), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=parti).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听到英语 party，就想象朋友举杯开派对；写规范马来语时，把词尾 y 换成 i：parti。

morphology.pattern_note: 以上根词字段按词包保留；实际构词可分析为 pe- + ronda → peronda，表示巡逻者或巡逻工具。r 保留，pe- 读 /pə/；不应因为输入的根词标签而将这一构词关系忽略。

senses.zh_definition: 巡逻人员；为维护安全而在一定区域巡视的人，包括警员、军人或社区巡逻员。
senses.en_definition: A person who patrols an area, especially to maintain security.
senses.ms_definition: Orang yang meronda, seperti anggota polis atau askar.
senses.nuances: 不必然指警察，也可指其他履行巡逻职责的人；pasukan peronda 指巡逻队。此义及工具义均见 [DBP：peronda](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=peronda)。

senses.zh_definition: 用于巡逻的交通工具或设备；常置于车辆、船只等名称之后，说明其巡逻用途。
senses.en_definition: Something used for patrolling, especially a patrol vehicle or vessel.
senses.ms_definition: Sesuatu yang digunakan untuk meronda, seperti kereta peronda.
senses.nuances: 在 kereta peronda、kapal peronda 等结构中，peronda 是说明用途的名词修饰语；不能把 kereta peronda 理解成“巡逻员的车”。

etymology.historical_story: Peronda connects ronda, patrolling, with pe-, which can identify a person or an instrument. Its two dictionary senses therefore fit the same practical scene: people make their rounds, sometimes using a patrol vehicle. In Malaysia, neighbourhood volunteer patrols also give the word a community setting beyond police and military work. See [Malaysia’s community patrol programme](https://www.jpnin.gov.my/web/skim-rondaan-sukarela).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 ronda＝巡逻；前面加 pe-，就想到“执行巡逻的人或工具”：人是 anggota peronda，车是 kereta peronda。

morphology.pattern_note: -mu 是 kamu 的后附着形式，表示“你的”，直接连写，词根不发生音变；严格说属于代词附着语，而非派生后缀。读音分节为 pa.car.mu。输入的 Jawi ڤاچر 仅对应词根 pacar，未包含 -mu。[DBP：代词缩略形式的连写](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kau)

word_family.gloss: 恋人；另有植物名称用法

etymology.historical_story: Pacarmu is transparently built from pacar and the attached second-person form -mu. Its romantic reading belongs to the pacar sense that DBP labels as Jakarta usage. The same dictionary also records botanical uses of pacar and regional henna-related berpacar. These entries establish separate usage histories, but do not establish that the romantic meaning developed from henna customs. [DBP: pacar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=pacar)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 pacar“恋人”，再把 -mu 当作“你的”标签：pacarmu＝你的恋人。植物语境则另行判断。

senses.zh_definition: 通过足迹、踪迹或其他线索追寻人或动物的追踪者。

senses.ms_definition: Orang yang mengikuti jejak atau tanda lain untuk mengesan seseorang atau sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 强调循迹追寻，常见于搜救、森林活动及军事语境；不等同于泛指调查人员的 penyiasat。马来语释义为综合转述。用例依据：[DBP scout 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=scout)。

senses.zh_definition: 用于持续追踪目标位置、移动情况或其他指定信息的装置或软件。

senses.ms_definition: Alat atau perisian yang mengesan dan mengikuti kedudukan, pergerakan atau maklumat tertentu tentang sesuatu sasaran.
senses.nuances: 通常与所追踪的对象或技术名称连用；penjejak mata 追踪眼球运动，penjejak GPS 追踪位置。马来语释义为术语概括，参见：[DBP tracker 术语表](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=tracker)。

etymology.historical_story: Penjejak belongs to the Malay family built on jejak, a footprint or trace. Its formation makes the connection between a trace and the person following it transparent. Contemporary technical usage also applies the word to instruments that follow targets, including eyes and stars. This illustrates semantic continuity between physical tracking and technological measurement. See [DBP terminology](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=tracker).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: jejak 是踪迹；peN- 加上去，就是循迹的人或追踪工具。想象追踪器沿着一串脚印前进。

morphology.pattern_note: per-...-an 构成表示敌对状态或关系的名词，词根 musuh 保留。输入将 permusuhan 标为词根，现依据其实际派生关系修正。加后缀后按 per.mu.su.han 分音节。

senses.zh_definition: 个人、群体或国家之间相互为敌的状态或关系；敌意；仇怨。
senses.en_definition: Enmity or hostility between individuals, groups, or states.
senses.ms_definition: Perihal bermusuh; perseteruan.
senses.nuances: 比一般意见分歧或竞争更强，表示关系中存在敌意；不必已经发生武装冲突，也不等同于战争。可指敌对关系，也可指敌视的态度。释义及词族见 [DBP：permusuhan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=132444&keyword=permusuhan)。

etymology.historical_story: The family built around musuh connects an enemy, the act of treating someone as an enemy, and the resulting relationship. Permusuhan names that relationship rather than the person. This distinction lets Malay describe hostility at very different scales, from a personal feud to conflict between states, without making warfare part of the word's essential meaning.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: musuh 是敌人；per-...-an 给敌对关系装上名词外框：从敌人想到敌对状态，就是 permusuhan。

morphology.formula: penyembuh + -an → penyembuhan；整体构词：peN- + sembuh + -an → penyembuhan
morphology.pattern_note: 保留输入包的直接词基penyembuh；基础词根为sembuh。整体构词时，peN-在s前变为peny-，词根首音s脱落；ny表示单一鼻音/ɲ/。

word_family.gloss: 具有疗愈作用的人或事物

senses.nuances: 强调恢复的过程或促成恢复的作用；rawatan侧重治疗措施，kesembuhan侧重康复状态。也可用于情绪创伤，但不表示某种治疗必然有效。[DBP词义与用法](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=penyembuhan)

etymology.historical_story: Penyembuhan belongs to the Malay family built around sembuh, meaning to become well again. Its morphology turns recovery into a process that can be discussed, supported, or studied. DBP also accepts penyembuhan as a contextual equivalent of English healing, showing how the same word can connect physical recovery with contemporary discussions of emotional restoration. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=penyembuhan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住中间的sembuh“痊愈”：sembuh是“好了”，penyembuhan是“慢慢好起来的过程”；ny读/ɲ/，不要拆成/n/和/j/。

etymology.historical_story: The Malay rasa family connects physical sensation with inner experience. Perasaan names feelings or perception, while the attached pronoun -ku makes that experience personal: mine. This movement between body and heart helps explain the word's range. In poetry and intimate writing, the compact form can bring the speaker's emotional voice into focus.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先抓住 rasa“感觉”，再记 -ku“我的”：perasaan + ku，就是“我的感受”。

etymology.historical_story: Petrus is the Latin form of Greek Petros, a name associated with stone or rock. Christian tradition connects it with Simon, also called Cephas, whose name carries a corresponding Aramaic meaning. Malay Christian texts use Petrus as a personal name; the historical meaning does not make it the ordinary Malay word for stone. [Biblical name reference](https://alkitab.sabda.org/dictionary.php?word=petrus)

etymology.historical_story: Indonesian proyek is recorded as a borrowing from Dutch project, ultimately connected with Latin prōiectum, something put forward. That image suits a plan proposed for future action. Its Malaysian counterpart is projek, illustrating how related regional languages adapt international vocabulary differently. See [the etymological entry](https://ms.wiktionary.org/wiki/proyek) and [DBP's regional terminology table](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=project).

etymology.historical_story: Pemburuan belongs to the Malay buru family, linking the hunter, pemburu, with the act of hunting, memburu. The noun brings attention to the activity itself. In conservation reporting, pemburuan haram names poaching, giving this established hunting vocabulary a prominent protective role. That usage appears in [Royal Malaysia Police reporting](https://www.rmp.gov.my/news-detail/2020/11/07/posting-pilihan-op-khazanah-perhilitan-pdrm-tumpaskan-aktiviti-pemburuan-haram).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 buru 的“追猎”画面：pemburu 是追猎的人，pemburuan 是整场追猎活动；听到词尾 -an，就把注意力转向过程。

etymology.historical_story: Pertanian belongs to a transparent Malay word family built around tani. Bertani names the work, petani names the person, and pertanian names the activity or industry. Together, these forms connect the farmer, the field and the wider agricultural economy without requiring an unverified story about the root's distant origins. etymology.historical_story: The Malay root tubuh denotes a body, while its derivational family also expresses establishing an organization. Pertubuhan names the resulting collective body; penubuhan names the act of establishing it. This connection offers a useful cultural image: people become an organized body through shared activities. It explains the modern word family without claiming a documented date for the semantic development. [Source](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?keyword=tubuh)

etymology.historical_story: English pirate traces through French and Latin to Greek peiratēs, associated with raiding and hostile attempts. Its familiar maritime meaning later supplied an image for unauthorized copying: someone takes another person's work as a raider takes cargo. DBP distinguishes the Malay equivalents lanun, pencetak rompak, and mencetak rompak. [English etymology](https://www.etymonline.com/word/pirate); [DBP equivalents](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=rompak).

etymology.historical_story: English put has a history reaching back to Old English, although its deeper derivation remains uncertain. The Oxford English Dictionary discusses several possible ancestral forms rather than one fully secure origin. etymology.historical_story: Perseus carries a Greek hero's name into modern astronomy. In the myth, the son of Zeus and Danaë kills Medusa; in traditional constellation pictures, he holds her severed head. The name therefore links a character in an ancient story with a recognizable region of the northern sky, rather than with a Malay word root. etymology.historical_story: Pacarku combines pacar with the first-person possessive clitic -ku. Kamus Dewan records the romantic sense of pacar with a Jakarta usage label, alongside separate homonyms concerning plants and ceremonial mats. This distinction matters: the supplied plant definition does not explain the romantic expression, and it provides no basis for a story deriving courtship from henna. etymology.historical_story: DBP identifies muzik as an English-origin word. Malay then uses its own person-forming prefix pe- to produce pemuzik, showing how a borrowed base can participate in local word formation. The result names a person associated with making music, rather than an instrument or musical work. Its structure is transparent without requiring a speculative historical story. See [DBP：muzik](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1.aspx?d=123312&keyword=muzik).

etymology.historical_story: Malay builds this expression around tanya, meaning to ask. The formation pertanyaan turns asking into an inquiry or question, while -nya connects it to a person or something already mentioned. Its dictionary meanings extend from requests for information to broader issues, linking everyday questioning with the language of correspondence and public discussion.

etymology.historical_story: PBB condenses the Malay institutional name Pertubuhan Bangsa-Bangsa Bersatu into three letter names. The organization was established in 1945, and Malaya joined in 1957. Its abbreviation became familiar through diplomacy, school history lessons and news reporting. It follows Malay conventions for capitalized institutional initialisms. [Malaysia's Ministry of Foreign Affairs](https://www.kln.gov.my/web/guest/press-releases/-/asset_publisher/pyl8kLodVZrv/content/malaysia-sambut-hari-pertubuhan-bangsa-bangsa-bersatu-pbb-2023-24-oktober-2023?inheritRedirect=true)

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于摔跤运动员及职业摔跤表演者；具体是否为竞技比赛或娱乐表演，应由上下文交代。不要仅因一个人身材壮硕就随意称其为摔跤手。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 称呼运动员时宜使用 penggusti、姓名或适当称谓。纠正他人拼写可以说 Ejaan bakunya penggusti，以平和方式说明规范形式。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于摔跤运动员及职业摔跤表演者；具体是否为竞技比赛或娱乐表演，应由上下文交代。不要仅因一个人身材壮硕就随意称其为摔跤手。

etymology.historical_story: The useful history here is morphological rather than a separate origin story for pengusti. Malay gusti names wrestling, while the agent prefix peN- forms penggusti, a person who wrestles. DBP examples preserve both the prefix's final ng and the root's initial g. Pengusti should therefore be taught through its corrected form. [DBP usage](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=mengukuhkan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 peng + gusti：前缀的 ng 抓住词根的 g，像两名摔跤手抱在一起；penggusti 中两个 g 都不能丢。

morphology.pattern_note: root_word 与 root_jawi 按数据包保留；实际构词词根为 kampung（کامڤوڠ）。per-...-an 构成表示村落群体、相关事务或聚集场所的词；词根首音 k 保留，词尾 ng /ŋ/ 在 -an 前不改变音值。数据包的 is_root: true 不符合这一构词分析。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=perkampungan)。

senses.zh_definition: 与村庄、乡村或村落事务有关的。
senses.en_definition: Relating to villages or village affairs.
senses.ms_definition: Mengenai atau berkaitan dengan kampung.
senses.nuances: 这是关系性修饰用法，见于行政职称或事务名称；并非表示“落后”或“土气”。日常使用中，表示村落聚居区的名词义更常见。

senses.zh_definition: 村落群；村落式聚居区；由一群居民、住宅或若干村庄构成的聚居整体。
senses.en_definition: A village settlement or a group of villages or dwellings forming a community.
senses.ms_definition: Kelompok atau kumpulan kampung; kawasan penempatan yang membentuk suatu kelompok.
senses.nuances: 强调聚居形成的整体或区域，不必指行政上独立的一个 kampung。DBP 另列 sekelompok、sekumpulan 的群体义，可从“聚为一群”的核心理解；现代常用搭配主要指具体聚居区。[DBP 释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=perkampungan)。

senses.zh_definition: 供某一群体集中居留、驻扎或集合的场所。
senses.en_definition: A place where a group gathers, stays, or is quartered.
senses.ms_definition: Tempat orang berkampung, berkumpul atau berhimpun.
senses.nuances: 不限于世代居住的乡村，也可用于运动员集中住宿区或军队驻地。具体是临时住宿、营地还是长期聚居区，需要根据所指群体和上下文判断。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Pihak berkuasa tempatan akan menaik taraf sistem saliran di kawasan perkampungan nelayan itu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 地方政府将提升该渔村聚居区的排水系统。
dual_scenarios.en: The local authority will upgrade the drainage system in the fishing village.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kat hujung jalan tu ada perkampungan nelayan, jom singgah kejap.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Di hujung jalan itu terdapat sebuah perkampungan nelayan; marilah kita singgah sebentar.
dual_scenarios.zh: 那条路尽头有个渔村，我们顺路去一下吧。
dual_scenarios.en: There’s a fishing village at the end of that road. Let’s stop by for a bit.
spoken_features: kat 对应地点介词 di。
tu 是 itu 的口语缩略形式。
jom 用于自然地邀请同伴一起行动。
kejap 在这里对应 sebentar。
perkampungan 可以自然用于口语，但比 kampung 更突出聚居区域的整体。

messages.speaker: Mei (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kau dah sampai kat perkampungan nelayan tu?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah awak sudah sampai di perkampungan nelayan itu?
messages.zh: 你到那个渔村了吗？
messages.en: Have you reached that fishing village yet?

messages.speaker: Farid (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah. Aku tunggu kat kedai depan jeti je.
messages.ms_standard: Saya sudah sampai. Saya sedang menunggu di kedai di hadapan jeti.
messages.zh: 到了，我就在码头前面那家店等。
messages.en: Yes. I’m waiting at the shop in front of the jetty.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: perkampungan 是中性地理或行政称呼。描述居民时可说 penduduk perkampungan tersebut，避免把居住地点当作教育程度或社会地位的判断。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于社区发展、旅游、地理及赛事住宿语境。perkampungan Orang Asli 指原住民聚居地时，应尊重当地社区名称和访问安排；不要与带贬义可能的 kekampungan 混用。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: perkampungan 是中性地理或行政称呼。描述居民时可说 penduduk perkampungan tersebut，避免把居住地点当作教育程度或社会地位的判断。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于社区发展、旅游、地理及赛事住宿语境。perkampungan Orang Asli 指原住民聚居地时，应尊重当地社区名称和访问安排；不要与带贬义可能的 kekampungan 混用。

etymology.historical_story: Perkampungan grows transparently from kampung through per-...-an. Its dictionary meanings connect villages with the broader act of gathering: it can denote a cluster of settlements or a place where people assemble. An athletes’ village therefore fits the same conceptual pattern as a village community: people occupy a shared place as a group. [DBP dictionary entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=perkampungan).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先抓住中间的 kampung“村庄”：per-...-an 把视野拉大，看到整片村落，或一群人集中居留的地方。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根以元音 u 开头，peN- 实现为 peng-，词根保留；整体构成表示驱逐行为或过程的名词。输入包将 pengusiran 标为词根有误，实际词根为 usir。

senses.zh_definition: 驱逐；强行赶走某人或某物的行为或过程。
senses.en_definition: The act or process of forcibly making someone or something leave; expulsion.
senses.ms_definition: Perbuatan mengusir atau menghalau seseorang atau sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 强调迫使离开，可用于住所、地区或国家等语境。涉及租户时可译为 eviction，涉及出境时可译为 expulsion 或 deportation，具体译法取决于事件性质；本词本身不说明程序是否合法。[DBP：usir 及其派生词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1.aspx?d=73980&keyword=pengusir)。

collocations.zh: 驱逐非法入境者或无合法居留身份者

dual_scenarios.context: 新闻 / 居民事务汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Persatuan penduduk membantah pengusiran paksa keluarga yang masih tinggal di kawasan tersebut.
dual_scenarios.zh: 居民协会反对强行驱逐仍居住在该地区的家庭。
dual_scenarios.en: The residents’ association opposed the forcible eviction of families still living in the area.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 朋友讨论邻里消息
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kau dah baca berita pasal pengusiran penduduk kat situ?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah kamu sudah membaca berita tentang pengusiran penduduk di situ?
dual_scenarios.zh: 你看了那边居民被赶走的新闻没？
dual_scenarios.en: Have you read the news about the residents being evicted there?
spoken_features: dah 是 sudah 的口语缩略形式。
pasal 在这里表示 tentang；kat 对应表示地点的 di。
kau 用于熟悉的朋友之间；pengusiran 保留新闻用语色彩。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kau dah baca berita pasal pengusiran penduduk kat situ?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah kamu sudah membaca berita tentang pengusiran penduduk di situ?
messages.zh: 你看了那边居民被赶走的新闻没？
messages.en: Have you read the news about the residents being evicted there?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah. Kesian mereka, nak pindah ke mana pun belum tahu lagi.
messages.ms_standard: Sudah. Kasihan mereka kerana mereka masih belum tahu ke mana hendak berpindah.
messages.zh: 看了。真可怜，他们连要搬去哪儿都还不知道。
messages.en: Yes. I feel sorry for them—they still don’t know where they’ll move.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 这是语气较重的正式词。讨论当事人时宜使用中性称呼，避免把驱逐说成值得庆祝的事情。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合新闻、行政说明和社会议题讨论。日常描述有人被赶走，常说 kena halau；不要把普通搬迁自动称作 pengusiran。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 这是语气较重的正式词。讨论当事人时宜使用中性称呼，避免把驱逐说成值得庆祝的事情。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合新闻、行政说明和社会议题讨论。日常描述有人被赶走，常说 kena halau；不要把普通搬迁自动称作 pengusiran。

etymology.historical_story: Kamus Dewan records usir with meanings involving pursuit as well as forcing someone away. Pengusiran packages the latter action into a noun through peN-...-an. Its dictionary illustration concerns a stepchild driven from home, showing that the word belongs to storytelling as well as administrative language. The common thread is compelled departure, whether the setting is a household or a country.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 usir“赶走”：peng- 把动作装进名词，-an 封口，pengusiran 就是“驱逐这件事”。

morphology.pattern_note: -mu 是表示第二人称领属关系的附着代词，直接连写在 pendapat 后，不引起词干音变；本结构中的直接基词为 pendapat，更深层可分析为 peN- + dapat → pendapat，d 保留，peN- 采用 pen- 形式。suffix 为本字段的结构分类，严格语法身份是附着代词。输入提供的 ڤنداڤت 是 pendapat 的爪夷文；完整 pendapatmu 可写作 ڤنداڤتمو。连写规则见 [DBP《Pedoman Umum Ejaan Bahasa Melayu》](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf)。

senses.zh_definition: 你对某件事经过思考后形成的意见、看法或判断。
senses.en_definition: Your opinion, view, or judgment about something.
senses.ms_definition: Pandangan, fikiran atau kesimpulan kamu tentang sesuatu perkara yang terbentuk melalui pemikiran.
senses.nuances: 核心是“你的看法”，其中 -mu 指向受话者，通常为一个人；具体人数仍取决于上下文。它表达个人判断，不自动等于事实、正式决定或建议。pendapatmu 是 pendapat 的规则领属形式，并非必须单独收录的独立词条。DBP 还为基词 pendapat 收录“最初构思、发现或创造某物的人”这一罕用义；当代交流中的 pendapatmu 通常采用意见义，不宜将罕用义套入日常会话。基词释义见 [DBP PRPM：pendapat](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=pendapat)。

dual_scenarios.context: 职场书面反馈（熟悉的同事之间）
dual_scenarios.ms: Saya menghargai pendapatmu tentang cadangan tersebut dan akan mengemukakannya dalam mesyuarat jawatankuasa.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我重视你对这项提议的意见，并会在委员会会议上提出。
dual_scenarios.en: I value your opinion on the proposal and will present it at the committee meeting.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 朋友讨论活动海报
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku nak dengar pendapatmu pasal poster ni dulu lah.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya mahu mendengar pendapatmu tentang poster ini terlebih dahulu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我想先听听你对这张海报的看法啦。
dual_scenarios.en: I'd like to hear what you think of this poster first.
spoken_features: aku 是熟人之间使用的第一人称代词，对应较中性的 saya。
nak 对应 mahu；ni 对应 ini；pasal 在此对应 tentang。
lah 在此使表达带有熟人之间商量的语气。
pendapatmu 合乎语法，但在不少马来西亚朋友聊天中，pendapat kau 或 pendapat awak 更口语化；具体选择取决于双方习惯。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku dah siap buat poster ni. Apa pendapatmu?
messages.ms_standard: Saya sudah menyiapkan poster ini. Apakah pendapatmu?
messages.zh: 我把这张海报做好了。你觉得怎么样？
messages.en: I've finished the poster. What do you think?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Cantik dah! Besarkan tajuk sikit je, baru senang orang nak baca.
messages.ms_standard: Poster ini sudah cantik. Besarkan tajuknya sedikit sahaja supaya orang lebih mudah membacanya.
messages.zh: 已经很好看啦！把标题再放大一点，大家就更容易看清了。
messages.en: It looks great! Just make the heading a little bigger so it's easier to read.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: -mu 带有熟悉、亲近或文学化的色彩，礼貌程度取决于双方关系。它常见于亲密交流、歌词、文学及长辈对晚辈的话语。向陌生客户、上司或需要尊称的人征询意见时，通常用 pendapat anda、pendapat tuan、pendapat puan 或对方的合适称谓。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 征求意见可说 Apakah pendapatmu?，但应确保双方接受这种称呼。表达分歧时，Saya faham pendapatmu, tetapi saya melihatnya dari sudut yang berbeza.（我理解你的看法，不过我的观察角度不同。）能先承认对方观点，再提出自己的立场。普通人称领属写作小写 -mu，并与前词连写。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: -mu 带有熟悉、亲近或文学化的色彩，礼貌程度取决于双方关系。它常见于亲密交流、歌词、文学及长辈对晚辈的话语。向陌生客户、上司或需要尊称的人征询意见时，通常用 pendapat anda、pendapat tuan、pendapat puan 或对方的合适称谓。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 征求意见可说 Apakah pendapatmu?，但应确保双方接受这种称呼。表达分歧时，Saya faham pendapatmu, tetapi saya melihatnya dari sudut yang berbeza.（我理解你的看法，不过我的观察角度不同。）能先承认对方观点，再提出自己的立场。普通人称领属写作小写 -mu，并与前词连写。

etymology.historical_story: Pendapat belongs to the Malay word family built on dapat, associated with obtaining or finding. Its familiar meaning connects thinking with arriving at a view. The dictionary also preserves a less familiar meaning: a person who first conceives or discovers something. Adding the bound pronoun -mu makes the opinion yours, illustrating how Malay expresses possession within a single written word.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pen-da-pat-mu 分成 pendapat｜mu：前面是“看法”，后面的 mu 把它交给“你”。看到 pada pendapatmu，就整块记成“依你看”。

morphology.pattern_note: 实际词根为 potong（ڤوتوڠ）；peN- 遇首音 p 时变为 pem-，p 脱落，形成表示施事者或工具的名词。ng 表示单一鼻音 /ŋ/。root_word 和 root_jawi 保留输入包记录。

senses.zh_definition: 从事切、割、砍等工作的人；切割工。
senses.en_definition: A person who cuts, especially as an occupation.
senses.ms_definition: Orang yang memotong.
senses.nuances: 后接材料或工作对象时，可表示特定工种；须结合语境区分工人与工具。pemotong getah 在传统用法中指割胶工，常见的明确称呼是 penoreh getah。参见 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=pemotong)。

senses.zh_definition: 用于切、割、剪或截断物体的工具或机器。
senses.en_definition: A tool or machine used for cutting.
senses.ms_definition: Alat untuk memotong.
senses.nuances: 常与被切对象组合成工具名称，如 pemotong kertas。mesin pemotong 强调机器，alat pemotong 泛指切割工具；不可把 pemotong 与表示切割过程的 pemotongan 混用。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Unit pentadbiran akan menggantikan pemotong kertas yang rosak bagi melancarkan urusan penyediaan dokumen.
dual_scenarios.zh: 行政部门将更换损坏的裁纸器，以确保文件准备工作顺利进行。
dual_scenarios.en: The administration unit will replace the broken paper cutter to keep document preparation running smoothly.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Pemotong kertas tu ada kat mana? Aku nak guna kejap.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Pemotong kertas itu ada di mana? Saya mahu menggunakannya sebentar.
dual_scenarios.zh: 那个裁纸器放哪儿了？我想用一下。
dual_scenarios.en: Where's the paper cutter? I need it for a minute.
spoken_features: kat 对应 di。
nak 对应 mahu。
kejap 对应 sekejap 或 sebentar。
tu 对应 itu；熟人对话中常省略可由语境补出的成分。

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Pemotong kertas tu ada kat mana? Aku nak guna kejap.
messages.ms_standard: Pemotong kertas itu ada di mana? Saya mahu menggunakannya sebentar.
messages.zh: 那个裁纸器放哪儿了？我想用一下。
messages.en: Where's the paper cutter? I need it for a minute.

messages.ms_spoken: Ada kat sebelah pencetak je. Aku dah letak situ tadi.
messages.ms_standard: Pemotong kertas itu ada di sebelah pencetak. Saya sudah meletakkannya di situ tadi.
messages.zh: 就在打印机旁边。我刚才放那儿了。
messages.en: It's right next to the printer. I put it there earlier.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 职业称谓本身中性；当面称呼工作人员宜用姓名、Encik 或 Puan，避免直接把工种当作呼喊称呼。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 采购、维修和借用工具时，补出用途最清楚，如 pemotong kertas。谈职业时应尊重劳动者；割胶工通常称 penoreh getah。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 职业称谓本身中性；当面称呼工作人员宜用姓名、Encik 或 Puan，避免直接把工种当作呼喊称呼。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 采购、维修和借用工具时，补出用途最清楚，如 pemotong kertas。谈职业时应尊重劳动者；割胶工通常称 penoreh getah。

etymology.historical_story: Pemotong illustrates a productive Malay naming pattern rather than a separate imported title. From potong, meaning cut, peN- forms a noun for either the person doing the work or the implement performing it. The dictionary preserves both meanings, including the traditional rubber tapper, so a single form connects human skill with the tools that extend it. See [DBP's word family](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=potong).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: potong＝切；peN- 标记“做这件事的人或工具”：pemotong 就是“切的人”或“切的工具”。

morphology.pattern_note: is_root、root_word 和 root_jawi 沿用资料包的检索根标记；实际构词基础是 buka，pembuka 是派生名词。peN- 在 b 前实现为 pem-，b 保留，表示执行开启动作的人、工具或起开启作用的事物。[马来西亚师范教育学院构词教材](https://ipkent.edu.my/document/pskent/pskent18/modul/bmm/BMM3093.pdf)

senses.zh_definition: 打开某物、开辟道路或率先开展某项事业的人；开辟者。
senses.en_definition: A person who opens something or pioneers a route or undertaking.
senses.ms_definition: Individu yang membuka sesuatu atau merintis jalan dan usaha.

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于工具名称、开场表达及先驱比喻。称某人为 pembuka jalan 通常带赞许意味，但具体职衔应使用其正式名称。

etymology.historical_story: Pembuka illustrates a productive Malay naming pattern: the prefix peN- attaches to buka, meaning to open, and identifies an opener. The same concrete image extends to beginnings and opportunities. A bottle opener opens a container; a pembuka kata opens a speech; a pembuka jalan opens a route or makes progress possible. [DBP](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=membuka)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 buka＝打开：加上 pem-，就想到负责打开的人、工具或开场事物。

morphology.pattern_note: peN- 遇词根起首 t 时实现为 pen-，同时 t 脱落，因此不是 penterima。该前缀在这里构成表示接收者或接收装置的名词。

senses.ms_definition: Orang atau alat yang menerima sesuatu.

senses.zh_definition: 容易领会教导或所学内容的；理解力强的。

etymology.historical_story: Penerima shows how Malay builds vocabulary through productive morphology: terima concerns receiving, while peN- identifies the receiving person or instrument. The same noun therefore works in postal services, award ceremonies and radio technology. Kamus Dewan also preserves less familiar senses concerning readiness to understand and acceptance of fate. Source: [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=penerima).

senses.zh_definition: 使人承受身体或精神痛苦的折磨、虐待行为。

senses.ms_definition: Secara kiasan, pengalaman atau keadaan yang mendatangkan penderitaan jiwa yang berat.

etymology.historical_story: The root seksa is traced to Sanskrit śikṣā, associated with instruction and discipline. In Malay, the word acquired established meanings involving painful punishment and suffering. Malay affixation produces penyeksaan, naming the act of inflicting suffering. Its physical and figurative uses connect descriptions of cruelty with descriptions of unbearable inner distress. [Etymological reference](https://www.wisdomlib.org/history/book/sanskrit-words-in-southeast-asian-languages/d/doc1595748.html).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 seksa＝折磨，再把 peny-…-an 想成装进行为名词的框：penyeksaan＝折磨这一行为。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 是附着代词，按本字段的类别归入 suffix，并非派生出新词义的普通后缀；词干不变，ny 读 /ɲ/。输入爪夷文 ڤڠݢيل 仅对应 panggil，完整词形补为 ڤڠݢيلڽ。

etymology.historical_story: Panggilnya combines panggil, meaning to call, with the attached third-person pronoun -nya. The same written ending can identify the person called or, in narrative dialogue tags, the person doing the calling. Malay also uses the root for invitations and forms of address, linking the practical act of getting attention with the social act of recognizing someone's name or status.

senses.zh_definition: 该问题的解决办法、答案或出路；具体所指由上文确定。

senses.ms_definition: Cara, kaedah atau jawapan untuk mengatasi masalah yang dimaksudkan.
senses.nuances: -nya 常回指前述问题，不必机械译成“他的”。例如 Masalah ini rumit, tetapi penyelesaiannya mudah 表示“这个问题复杂，但解决办法很简单”。词基义项依据 [DBP：penyelesaian](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=penyelesaian)，本词释义已结合 -nya 调整。

senses.zh_definition: 对前述争议、冲突或事项的解决、处理或了结。
senses.en_definition: The resolution or settlement of the previously mentioned dispute or matter.
senses.ms_definition: Perbuatan atau proses menyelesaikan pertikaian, konflik atau perkara yang telah disebut.
senses.nuances: 侧重解决的过程或结果，而非某个具体答案。用于争议时常与谈判、协商及和平方式搭配。依据 [DBP：penyelesaian](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=penyelesaian) 的词基释义编写。

senses.zh_definition: 前述工作、事务的完成，或前述债务、款项的结清。
senses.en_definition: The completion of the specified work or the settlement of the specified debt or payment.
senses.ms_definition: Perbuatan menyiapkan kerja atau membereskan urusan yang dimaksudkan, termasuk menjelaskan hutang atau bayaran.
senses.nuances: 须由上下文确定是“完成”还是“结清”；不能把所有 penyelesaiannya 都译为“解决方案”。这些用法对应 menyelesaikan 的完成及偿清义，参见 [DBP：selesai 词族](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?d=1&k=berakhir)。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 适合正式讨论，也可用于日常交流。提出意见时说 Pada pandangan saya, penyelesaiannya ialah…，语气比直接断言更缓和。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 使用 -nya 前应让听者知道所指事项。涉及纠纷时，讨论 penyelesaiannya secara damai 可表达协商意愿；避免未经协商就把个人意见说成双方已接受的方案。

etymology.historical_story: This form shows Malay's productive word-building system rather than a separate borrowed word. Selesai supplies the idea of completion; peN-...-an creates a noun for resolving or completing something. Attached -nya then links that noun to a person, thing or previously mentioned matter. The same construction supports everyday problem-solving and formal negotiation. See [DBP: penyelesaian](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=penyelesaian).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 从 selesai“完成”往外搭：penyelesaian“解决／办法”，再加 -nya“这件事的”——penyelesaiannya 就是“它的解决办法／它的解决”。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根加 -an，词根辅音不变；末尾 n 在语音分节中进入后一音节，形成 pim.pi.nan。

etymology.historical_story: Pimpinan combines pimpin with the suffix -an. The root connects leading with guidance, while the derived noun names that guidance or its results. The dictionary also records a written guide as pimpinan, linking a person's direction with instructions on a page. This connection helps explain why leadership, followers, and guidebooks appear within the same entry without requiring an invented origin story.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 沿词族记：pimpin＝带领，pemimpin＝带领的人，pimpinan＝所给予的领导或指导；看到 di bawah pimpinan 就读作“在……领导下”。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 是附着于名词后的代词性成分，可表示他／她／它的，或回指已知对象；不引起词干音变，ny 读 /ɲ/。输入 Jawi ڤيستا 是词基形式；加 -nya 后为 ڤيستاڽ。

senses.zh_definition: 他／她举办或与其相关的庆宴、聚会；也可指前文提到的那场庆宴。

senses.zh_definition: 与某人、机构或地方相关，或前文已提到的专题节会、展销会或系列推广活动。
senses.en_definition: Its or the previously mentioned themed festival, fair, or recurring promotional event.

etymology.historical_story: Pesta comes from Portuguese festa, meaning a celebration or festival. A study hosted by UNESCO lists this borrowing among Portuguese words in Malay. In Malaysian usage, pesta covers parties, themed fairs, and cultural celebrations. Pestanya adds the Malay enclitic -nya, showing how a borrowed word can participate naturally in Malay grammar and refer back to a person or event. Source: [Portuguese Words in the Malay Language](https://en.unesco.org/silkroad/sites/default/files/knowledge-bank-article/portuguese_words_in_the_malay_language.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: pesta 联想 festa／festival＝庆典；再接 -nya＝“他／她的”或“前面说的那个”：pestanya＝那场庆典。

morphology.pattern_note: 本条按输入将 penawar 作为直接词基；进一步可分析为 peN- + tawar → penawar，其中词首 t 经鼻音替换成为 n。-nya 是后附代词性成分，ny 读 /ɲ/。输入 Jawi ڤناور 是词基形式；完整形式为 ڤناورڽ。

senses.zh_definition: 与所指交易、拍卖或申请事项相关的出价者、竞标者；特定语境中也可指申请者或求婚者。
senses.en_definition: The bidder or offeror associated with the matter in question; in some contexts, its applicant or suitor.
senses.ms_definition: Orang yang membuat tawaran, mengemukakan permohonan atau melamar dalam urusan yang dirujuk.
senses.nuances: 这是输入释义对应的义项。-nya 可回指交易或其他已知事项，不一定指某人的所有物。penawarnya 指人，tawarannya 才指其报价或提议。申请者、求婚者的意思须有明确语境；现代表达通常分别用 pemohon、pelamar。基本义参见 [DBP：penawar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=penawar)。

senses.ms_definition: Ubat atau bahan untuk menghilangkan atau mengurangkan kesan racun, bisa, penyakit atau kesakitan yang dirujuk.

senses.ms_definition: Mantera atau jampi yang dipercayai dapat menawar penyakit, bisa atau gangguan yang dirujuk.

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 拍卖语境要区分 penawarnya（其出价者）与 tawarannya（其报价）。民俗语境中的 jampi 和临床语境中的解毒剂属于不同概念；使用时把具体所指说清楚。

etymology.historical_story: Penawar illustrates how Malay word formation can produce identical forms with different meanings. In the bargaining family, it names someone who makes an offer. In another tawar family, it names something that counteracts harm, including a remedy or traditional charm. The emotional sense extends this relief to sadness and longing. Adding -nya supplies a reference that the surrounding sentence must clarify. Source: [DBP: penawar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=penawar).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先抓 tawar 的两条线：谈价→penawar 出价者；消解伤害→penawar 解药／慰藉。再看 -nya 回指谁或什么。

morphology.pattern_note: 实际词根为 gambar；peN- 在 g 前实现为 peng-，词根 g 保留，形成 /ŋɡ/。root_word 与 root_jawi 按输入包保留词条级节点，不表示该词不可再分析。

senses.zh_definition: 通过绘画、摄影、文字或想象对事物进行描绘、表现或呈现的过程。

etymology.historical_story: Peradaban belongs to the Malay family built around adab, a word associated with manners and cultivated conduct. Malay derivation turns that foundation into a term for civilization: development encompassing society's material and spiritual life. The connection offers a cultural perspective on civilization as more than buildings or technology, while the modern dictionary meaning remains broader than individual politeness.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: adab 是个人的礼仪修养；加上 per-...-an，把视野扩大到整个社会的“文明”。

etymology.historical_story: Peribadinya is explained by a productive Malay construction rather than a separate borrowing event. The base peribadi refers to the individual or to personal character, while attached -nya identifies a third-person referent. This creates a useful distinction: peribadinya can mean someone's character, whereas maklumat peribadinya means that person's personal information. Context determines the interpretation and the referent's gender.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: peribadi＝个人／品格；-nya＝他或她的。单独看可指“其人格”，跟在资料、生活等名词后则指“其个人的”。

etymology.historical_story: The root layar means a sail, making pelayaran easy to picture through the image of a vessel moving across water. Its dictionary meaning reaches beyond the physical sail to voyages by ships and boats generally. Expressions such as ilmu pelayaran and sekolah pelayaran also preserve the connection between travelling at sea and learning the skills needed to do it.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住中间的 layar“帆”：pe- 把船推出港，-an 把整个过程收成名词，pelayaran 就是“一段航程／航海活动”。

etymology.historical_story: In Malaysian usage, Portugis carries a historical association with Melaka as well as its ordinary reference to Portuguese people and language. Portuguese forces captured Melaka in 1511. Today, the name also appears in descriptions of a local heritage community, showing why ancestry, nationality, and cultural identity require separate attention. senses.zh_definition: 视角；看待、理解或解释事物的角度，尤其指结合各部分与整体关系形成的看法。

etymology.historical_story: Penahanan belongs to the Malay family built around tahan, a base connecting resistance, restraint, and holding something back. The peN-…-an construction turns these actions into a noun. Its range explains why the same form can describe restraining desire, withholding an application, or keeping someone in custody: the context identifies what is being held back. [DBP: penahanan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=penahanan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 tahan 的画面：一只手把东西“挡住、扣住”。peN-…-an 把动作名词化，penahanan 就是“挡住或扣住这件事”。

etymology.historical_story: DBP marks kendali as Javanese in origin and records its concrete meaning as a bridle or reins. That image connects physical steering with the broader meanings of controlling and managing. Pengendali adds the Malay agent prefix peN-, naming whoever handles the reins of an operation, from a machine operator to an administrator. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=150324&keyword=kendali)

etymology.historical_story: The curi family distinguishes the act, the person, the stolen property, and the experience of loss: pencurian, pencuri, curian, and kecurian. DBP records these related forms together. Their contrasting meanings offer a useful glimpse of Malay word formation, where affixes let one lexical base describe several participants and perspectives within the same event. [DBP：curi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=43968&keyword=curi)。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: curi 是“偷”；pencuri 是“偷的人”；pencurian 是“偷窃这件事”。用“动作—人物—事件”串起来记。

etymology.historical_story: Malay turns the act of wrapping into the name of a useful object through a productive prefix. Balut supplies the wrapping idea, while peN- forms pembalut, something used for wrapping. DBP records wound cloth as an example. The same word therefore connects practical objects through their shared function: enclosing, covering and protecting. [DBP: balut](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=balut)

etymology.historical_story: The dance name pogo comes from pogo stick: dancers jump vertically in a way that recalls someone bouncing on the spring-loaded toy. Merriam-Webster records the English dancing verb from 1977. This explains the movement behind the name without establishing when, or how widely, the term entered Malaysian Malay usage. etymology.historical_story: Pemalas is transparently formed within Malay: pe- combines with malas to name a person associated with laziness. The same base appears in kemalasan and bermalas-malas. This family offers a useful cultural distinction: naming someone a pemalas judges the person, whereas describing a period of resting or reluctance need not assign a lasting character trait.

senses.zh_definition: 污染；使环境、物质或某一区域变脏、受到有害物质或其他不良因素影响的行为或过程。
senses.en_definition: Pollution or contamination of an environment, substance, or place.
senses.ms_definition: Perbuatan mencemarkan atau mengotorkan sesuatu; pengotoran.
senses.nuances: 可指空气、水、土地及噪声等污染，并不限于肉眼可见的污垢。pencemaran 指污染过程或现象；pencemar 指污染者或污染物。[DBP：pencemaran](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=382696&keyword=pencemaran)

senses.zh_definition: 比喻玷污或损害语言规范、名誉等原有的良好状态。

etymology.historical_story: Cemar describes something dirty and, figuratively, a damaged name. Malay builds pencemaran from this root to name the act or process of making something polluted. The connection explains why the same noun appears in discussions of rivers and air, but also in debates about language standards and reputation. [DBP: cemar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=cemar)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: cemar＝脏、受玷污；peN-…-an 把它变成一件事：pencemaran＝污染这一过程。

etymology.historical_story: The word belongs to the ingat family, which connects remembering with paying attention. Its fuller active form, memperingatkan, turns that mental activity toward another person: helping someone remember a duty or notice a danger. This explains why the same family serves both friendly reminders and serious cautions. See [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=memperingatkan).

etymology.historical_story: Pasha represents the Ottoman Turkish title paşa, associated with senior civil and military office. Its deeper origin remains disputed, so a neat derivation from a single Persian or Turkish expression would overstate the evidence. In historical writing, the title often follows a person's name, helping readers distinguish an honorific from a personal name. [Historical source](https://islamansiklopedisi.org.tr/pasa).

etymology.historical_story: Piatu preserves more than a description of bereavement. Older Malay literature also uses it for someone without relatives, especially the outsider called dagang piatu. This wider meaning links family loss with the vulnerability of living far from kin. The consulted dictionary documents these meanings, but does not establish a definite earlier source language. [Historical usage source](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=246792&keyword=piatu).

etymology.historical_story: DBP groups perunding with runding, berunding, rundingan and perundingan. The family connects discussion with the people who conduct it. Its two dictionary senses capture distinct social roles: negotiating an agreement and supplying specialist advice. That relationship makes the word memorable across diplomacy and professional services, without requiring an unsupported claim about its earliest historical origin. [Source: PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=runding).

senses.zh_definition: 器具、设施或方法等极其简单、简陋或陈旧，仿佛仍处于早期发展阶段。
senses.en_definition: Very basic, rudimentary, or outdated in equipment, facilities, or methods.
senses.ms_definition: Sangat sederhana, seolah-olah dari zaman purbakala; kuno.
senses.nuances: 依据输入的《Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat》第二义整理。常含负面评价，强于普通的 mudah；简单而有效的设计未必适合称作 primitif。

dual_scenarios.ms: Pameran itu memperlihatkan alat primitif yang digunakan untuk memotong dan mengikis bahan sebelum penggunaan logam.

etymology.historical_story: Primitif belongs to a European word family ultimately traced to Latin primitivus, referring to what came first. Related forms include French primitif and English primitive. The movement from 'earliest' to 'rudimentary' helps explain its Malay meanings. This relationship does not, by itself, establish the precise route by which Malay borrowed the word. [Oxford](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/primitive_1).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 pri-mi-tif 时，想象一把最早期的石制工具：年代早是“原始”，今天还用同样粗陋的办法则是“简陋”。

etymology.historical_story: Pesalah illustrates Malay word formation within the vocabulary of rules and responsibility. The base salah expresses wrongness or fault; pe- forms a noun identifying the person concerned. Modern usage extends across criminal offences and traffic violations. The connection makes the word transparent to learners without requiring an invented story about its first appearance.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: salah 是“错”，pe- 指向“人”：pe- + salah → 被认定犯错或违法的人。

senses.en_definition: The chief minister of the Maratha state in India, an office that became hereditary and acquired effective ruling power.
senses.ms_definition: Gelaran ketua menteri kerajaan Maratha di India yang kemudiannya menjadi jawatan turun-temurun dan memegang kuasa pemerintahan sebenar.
senses.nuances: 限于印度历史语境，不是马来西亚现代官职的通称。通常用小写表示职位，用于具体人物姓名前时可写作Peshwa。此处official沿用指定词条状态，不代表DBP已核定其为通用马来语词。下列为历史语境搭配，不宣称具有日常高频性。[马哈拉施特拉邦政府历史资料](https://gazetteers.maharashtra.gov.in/cultural.maharashtra.gov.in/english/gazetteer/Language%20and%20Literature/chapter_iii.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: Peshwa is a Persian-derived title associated with leadership. In Maratha history, it designated the chief minister serving the ruler. The office subsequently became hereditary, and Pune developed into its political centre. The word therefore carries a history of ministerial authority growing into effective sovereignty, rather than simply naming a king. [Historical reference](https://en.wikisource.org/wiki/1911_Encyclop%C3%A6dia_Britannica/Peshwa)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听到peshwa，就想起马拉塔王座旁掌权的首席大臣：先是辅政者，后来成为实际掌权者。

morphology.pattern_note: peN- 在 g 前实现为 peng-；词根首音 g 保留，形成 /ŋɡ/，不是长辅音。数据包将 penggemar 标为词根，此处依据 gemar 的派生关系修正。参见 [DBP PRPM：gemar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=132088&keyword=gemar)。

etymology.historical_story: Penggemar illustrates a productive Malay way of naming people through their interests. The base gemar expresses strong liking; the prefix peN- forms a noun referring to the person associated with that liking. Related forms connect the enthusiast, penggemar, with the act of liking, menggemari, and the favourite thing or pastime, kegemaran. No specific ancient borrowing is established here.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: gemar 是“很喜欢”；前面加表示人的 peN-，penggemar 就是“很喜欢某事的人”。

morphology.pattern_note: 作为外来名称或术语组成部分整体处理，不拆成马来语词根与词缀。地名应写 Portland；输入的小写形式不改变这一规范。音标采用英语英式读音，不表示已核实独立的马来语标准读音。

senses.zh_definition: 波特兰；波特兰岛：多个地点使用的专有名称，具体所指须由国家、州或上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: Portland, a place name used for several locations, including cities in Oregon and Maine and the Isle of Portland in England.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas bagi beberapa tempat, termasuk bandar di Oregon dan Maine, Amerika Syarikat, serta Isle of Portland di England.
senses.nuances: 作为地名必须大写 Portland；不能仅凭输入 token 判定它一定指俄勒冈州城市。pos 的 noun 在此包括专有名词。headword.status 的 official 适用于规范名称及已收录术语的使用范围，不表示小写 portland 是独立的马来语普通名词。读音参见 [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/pronunciation/english/portland)。

senses.zh_definition: 用于 simen portland，指波特兰水泥，即硅酸盐水泥；此处是水泥类别名称的组成部分。
senses.en_definition: The name element in simen portland, meaning Portland cement, a hydraulic cement used in concrete and mortar.
senses.ms_definition: Unsur nama dalam istilah simen portland, iaitu simen hidraulik yang digunakan sebagai bahan pengikat dalam konkrit dan mortar.
senses.nuances: 实际词义由整个术语 simen portland 承担，不宜把 portland 单独教成“水泥”。DBP 术语资料可见小写 portland，百科名称也可见 Portland；应遵循所采用的术语表或文体规范。参见 [PRPM：水泥术语](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=mengeset)。

etymology.historical_story: Portland cement takes its name from the Isle of Portland in England. Joseph Aspdin patented a cement product in 1824 and named it for its resemblance, when hardened, to Portland limestone. The technical name therefore has a different naming history from the American cities called Portland; it does not identify the cement's manufacturing location. [American Cement Association](https://members.cement.org/EBiz55/Bookstore/EB001.16-Ch.1-Intro-to-Concrete-LR.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 见到 Portland 先想“地点名称”；前面有 simen，就把 simen portland 整块记成“硅酸盐水泥”。
