etymology.historical_story: Pelayar grows from layar, the sail that catches wind, and the associated activity belayar. Malay computing vocabulary extends this sailing imagery through melayari Internet. Pelayar consequently names both the person navigating online and the software used for that navigation. The dictionary records all three senses, making the word a useful bridge between maritime experience and digital life. [DBP：layar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=layar+1)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: layar 是“帆”：海上的 pelayar 是航海者；网上的 pelayar 可以是带你“航行”的浏览器，也可以是上网浏览的人。

morphology.formula: penamat + -nya → penamatnya；底层构词：peN- + tamat → penamat
morphology.pattern_note: 按数据包保留直接基词 penamat；底层词根 tamat 接 peN- 时，词首 t 脱落，形成 penamat。-nya 在名词后表示第三人称领属或回指已知事物。数据包中的 Jawi 对应 penamat，未包含 -nya。

word_family.gloss: 终止；结束的过程或行为

senses.zh_definition: 其结尾、结局、终点或收尾部分；所指事物的最后阶段或使其结束的部分。
senses.en_definition: Its ending, conclusion, endpoint, or final part.
senses.ms_definition: Yang terakhir; yang penghabisan; penutup.
senses.nuances: -nya 通常回指前文的故事、活动、历程或事件，不必译成某个人的“他的／她的”。penamat 强调结尾或终点；penamatan 更强调终止这一行为或过程。常见基础搭配 garisan penamat 表示终点线，不能因词条带 -nya 就在所有搭配后机械添加它。[DBP 释义及搭配](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=penamat)

collocations.zh: 成为其终结；为其画上句号

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Persidangan itu berlangsung selama tiga hari, dengan pembentangan resolusi bersama sebagai penamatnya.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该会议为期三天，以提呈共同决议作为收尾。
dual_scenarios.en: The conference lasted three days and concluded with the presentation of a joint resolution.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku dah habis tengok drama tu. Penamatnya sedih betullah.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya sudah selesai menonton drama itu. Penamatnya benar-benar menyedihkan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 那部剧我看完了，结局真让人难过。
dual_scenarios.en: I've finished that series. The ending is really sad.
spoken_features: aku 是熟人之间常用的第一人称代词。
dah 对应 sudah，tu 对应 itu。
tengok 在此对应较正式的 menonton。
betullah 加强感受；penamatnya 中的 -nya 回指 drama tu。

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku dah habis tengok drama tu. Penamatnya sedih betullah.
messages.ms_standard: Saya sudah selesai menonton drama itu. Penamatnya benar-benar menyedihkan.

messages.zh: 诶，先别剧透！我今晚才准备看呢。
messages.en: Hey, no spoilers! I'm only going to watch it tonight.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 讨论影视或小说的 penamatnya 前，宜先确认对方是否已看完，或提醒有剧透。正式汇报中可用来描述活动的收尾。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于故事结局、活动结尾及某段历程的终点。涉及死亡、关系破裂等敏感话题时，直接称作 penamatnya 可能显得冷淡，应根据关系和场合选择更体贴的措辞。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 讨论影视或小说的 penamatnya 前，宜先确认对方是否已看完，或提醒有剧透。正式汇报中可用来描述活动的收尾。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于故事结局、活动结尾及某段历程的终点。涉及死亡、关系破裂等敏感话题时，直接称作 penamatnya 可能显得冷淡，应根据关系和场合选择更体贴的措辞。

etymology.historical_story: Penamatnya grows from tamat, a word of completion generally traced to Arabic tamma, meaning to be completed. Malay adds peN- to create penamat, then attaches -nya to refer back to a known story, event, or journey. The same family connects the closing of a narrative with the finish line of a race. [Tamat etymology](https://kaikki.org/dictionary/Malay/meaning/t/ta/tamat.html); [DBP word family](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=penamat)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 tamat 就想到片尾“完”：penamat 是“结尾”，再加 -nya，就是“它的结尾／这件事的结局”。

morphology.pattern_note: 作为完整借词记忆，不把开头的 pen- 误析为马来语前缀 peN-；首音节 é 读 /e/。下列词族成员为词组，没有附加词缀。

senses.zh_definition: 因违反法律、规则或合同而受到的处罚或罚款。
senses.en_definition: A punishment or fine imposed for breaking a law, rule or contract.
senses.ms_definition: Hukuman atau denda yang dikenakan kerana melanggar undang-undang, peraturan atau kontrak.
senses.nuances: 常用于行政、合同及财务语境。penalti 的范围可涵盖非金钱处罚；denda 则通常明确指罚款。具体处罚须依相关规定判断。[DBP PRPM：penalti](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=penalti)

senses.zh_definition: 足球比赛中的罚点球：从距球门十二码、约十一米的罚球点踢出的罚球。
senses.en_definition: A football penalty kick taken from the penalty mark, twelve yards from the goal.
senses.ms_definition: Tendangan percuma dalam permainan bola sepak yang dibuat dari jarak 12 ela, lebih kurang 11 meter, dari gol lawan yang dipertahankan oleh seorang penjaga gol.
senses.nuances: penalti 可单独表示 tendangan penalti。它与一般的 tendangan percuma 有区别；sepak mula 是开球，sepakan sudut 是角球。

dual_scenarios.context: 合同说明 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Kontrak tersebut memperuntukkan penalti bagi kelewatan menyiapkan kerja.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该合同规定了延迟完工的处罚。
dual_scenarios.en: The contract provides for a penalty for late completion of the work.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 朋友讨论足球比赛
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Pasukan kita dah dapat penalti, tapi tak masuk pula!
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Pasukan kita telah mendapat tendangan penalti, tetapi tendangan itu tidak menghasilkan gol.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我们队都拿到点球了，结果却没罚进！
dual_scenarios.en: We got a penalty, but we didn't score!
spoken_features: dah 是 sudah 的口语形式，此处标准语可用 telah
tak 是 tidak 的口语形式
tak masuk 省略了可由比赛语境推知的主语
pula 在此表达意外或失望

messages.speaker: Hakim (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Pasukan kita dah dapat penalti, tapi tak masuk pula!
messages.ms_standard: Pasukan kita telah mendapat tendangan penalti, tetapi tendangan itu tidak menghasilkan gol.
messages.zh: 我们队拿到点球了，结果却没罚进！
messages.en: We got a penalty, but we didn't score!

messages.ms_standard: Ya, penjaga gol pasukan lawan memang hebat. Saya berharap pasukan kita dapat menjaringkan gol selepas ini.
messages.zh: 是啊，对方门将真厉害。希望接下来我们能进球。
messages.en: Yeah, their keeper's really good. Hopefully we'll score soon.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 正式通知中，须准确说明处罚依据、适用条件和金额；向客户说明时可用 penalti yang dikenakan，避免威吓语气。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于正式规定及体育讨论。日常交通罚单常说 saman，罚款常说 denda；应依据具体事项选择用词。足球聊天中单说 penalti 通常即可理解为点球。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 正式通知中，须准确说明处罚依据、适用条件和金额；向客户说明时可用 penalti yang dikenakan，避免威吓语气。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于正式规定及体育讨论。日常交通罚单常说 saman，罚款常说 denda；应依据具体事项选择用词。足球聊天中单说 penalti 通常即可理解为点球。

etymology.historical_story: Penalti is the Malay adaptation of English penalty, retained as a complete borrowed word. Its dictionary meanings connect institutional punishment with a familiar football situation: a rule breach can lead to a special kick at goal. The opening letters pen therefore belong to the borrowed word, rather than a Malay prefix.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: penalti 对应英语 penalty：合同里可能是罚金，球场上可能是点球；两者都与违规后的处罚有关。

morphology.pattern_note: 本条按输入包处理为 pelékat 的纺织品义：第一音节 e 为 /ə/，第二音节 é 为 /e/。整词记忆，不拆为 pe- + lekat；表示胶黏剂或贴纸的同形词须另作分析。word_family 所列为相关复合词组。

senses.zh_definition: 一种带条纹或格纹图案的沙笼布，亦指用这种布制成的沙笼，通常由男性穿着。
senses.en_definition: A striped or checked sarong cloth, or a sarong made from it, commonly worn by men.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis kain sarung yang bercorak jalur-jalur atau petak-petak, lazimnya dipakai oleh lelaki.
senses.nuances: 常见完整说法是 kain pelekat。输入包指定的是读作 pelékat 的纺织品义；胶黏剂、贴纸等同形词义不纳入本条。该词条的词根判断只适用于此纺织品义。[DBP：pelekat](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=pelekat)。

collocations.en: to wear a checked or striped sarong

dual_scenarios.context: 文化展览 / 新闻介绍
dual_scenarios.ms: Pameran tersebut menampilkan koleksi kain pelekat yang bercorak jalur dan petak.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该展览展出了多款条纹和格纹沙笼布。
dual_scenarios.en: The exhibition features a collection of striped and checked sarong cloths.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 家人准备去祈祷室
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Abang dah pakai kain pelekat, nak pergi surau kejap.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Abang sudah memakai kain pelekat dan hendak pergi ke surau sebentar.
dual_scenarios.zh: 哥哥已经穿好沙笼，准备去祈祷室一趟。
dual_scenarios.en: My older brother has put on his sarong and is heading to the prayer hall for a while.
spoken_features: dah 对应 sudah。
nak 对应 hendak。
kejap 对应 sekejap 或 sebentar。
口语去向表达 pergi surau 可省略标准语中的 ke。

messages.speaker: Aina (妹妹)
messages.ms_spoken: Abang dah pakai kain pelekat ke? Nak pergi surau sekarang?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah abang sudah memakai kain pelekat? Adakah abang hendak pergi ke surau sekarang?
messages.zh: 哥，你穿好沙笼了吗？现在要去祈祷室？
messages.en: Have you put your sarong on? Are you heading to the prayer hall now?

messages.speaker: Hakim (哥哥)

messages.ms_standard: Sudah. Abang memakai kain pelekat biru itu. Abang hendak keluar sebentar lagi.
messages.zh: 穿好了，我穿的是那条蓝色沙笼。再过一会儿就出门。
messages.en: Yes, I'm wearing the blue one. I'll head out in a little while.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 中性服饰名称。谈长辈衣着时可自然称 kain pelekat；避免把穿沙笼的人一概描述为懒散或衣着不体面。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合居家、服饰、文化和部分宗教活动语境。是否适合某个正式场合，应依据活动着装要求；沙笼并非只供宗教用途。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 中性服饰名称。谈长辈衣着时可自然称 kain pelekat；避免把穿沙笼的人一概描述为懒散或衣着不体面。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合居家、服饰、文化和部分宗教活动语境。是否适合某个正式场合，应依据活动着装要求；沙笼并非只供宗教用途。

etymology.historical_story: The textile name pelekat is commonly connected with Pulicat, a trading town on India's Coromandel Coast. A nineteenth-century account explicitly equates the place-name Pelekat with Pulicat, supporting that association without establishing every stage of the textile word's transmission. The name recalls maritime connections through which place names and cloth names travelled together. [Historical account](https://www.sabrizain.org/malaya/library/jsbras20.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pe-lé-kat 分成三拍，同时想象沙笼上三道条纹：听到 pelekat，就想到条纹、格纹 kain sarung；此处别联想到胶水。

morphology.formula: ∅ + president → president（英语）；马来语规范对应词：presiden
morphology.pattern_note: 作为英语输入整词处理，不能将末尾 t 当作马来语词缀。所列 IPA 是英语读音；规范马来语词 presiden 的 Jawi 为 ڤريسيدن，不能冒充 president 原始包中缺失的 Jawi。

senses.zh_definition: 【英语词；马来语用 presiden】总统：共和国的国家元首，在某些制度下也兼任政府首脑。
senses.en_definition: The head of state of a republic, sometimes also its head of government.
senses.ms_definition: Padanan bahasa Melayu ialah presiden: ketua negara sesebuah republik yang dalam sesetengah sistem turut menjadi ketua kerajaan.
senses.nuances: president 是英语形式，不应标记为已核实的规范马来语词头。正式马来语通常使用 presiden；总统是否兼任政府首脑取决于该国制度。以下马来语搭配采用规范形式。[DBP：presiden](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=presiden)。

senses.zh_definition: 【英语词；马来语用 presiden】机构、公司、协会或组织的最高负责人；具体可译为总裁、会长或主席。
senses.en_definition: The chief officer or head of a company, institution, association, or other organization.
senses.ms_definition: Padanan bahasa Melayu ialah presiden: ketua eksekutif sesebuah syarikat atau ketua sesuatu persatuan, pertubuhan atau institusi.
senses.nuances: 中文译名须依机构而定，不能一律译为“总统”。公司中的 president 与 chief executive officer 是否为同一职位，也须核对机构架构。[DBP：presiden](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=presiden)。

dual_scenarios.context: 职场翻译 / 双语报告
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam laporan bahasa Melayu ini, jawatan “president” diterjemahkan sebagai “presiden persatuan”.
dual_scenarios.zh: 在这份马来语报告中，“president”这一职称译为“协会会长”。
dual_scenarios.en: In this Malay-language report, the title “president” is translated as “presiden persatuan”.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 同事核对双语职称
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kat versi Inggeris tulis “president”; versi Melayu guna “presiden” je.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Dalam versi bahasa Inggeris, gunakan “president”; dalam versi bahasa Melayu, gunakan “presiden”.
dual_scenarios.zh: 英文版写“president”，马来文版用“presiden”就行。
dual_scenarios.en: Use “president” in the English version and “presiden” in the Malay version.
spoken_features: kat 在此口语语境中对应 dalam。
je 对应 sahaja。
president 作为英语文字被引用；标准马来语对应词是 presiden。

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Kat poster Melayu ni, nak tulis “president” jugak ke?
messages.ms_standard: Dalam poster bahasa Melayu ini, adakah kita hendak menggunakan perkataan “president” juga?
messages.zh: 这张马来文海报，也要写“president”吗？
messages.en: Should we use “president” on the Malay poster too?

messages.speaker: Amir (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Guna “presiden” je. “President” tu untuk versi Inggeris.
messages.ms_standard: Gunakan “presiden” sahaja. Perkataan “president” itu digunakan dalam versi bahasa Inggeris.
messages.zh: 用“presiden”就行。“President”留给英文版。
messages.en: Just use “presiden”. “President” is for the English version.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 称呼机构负责人时依其正式职衔及场合使用 Tuan Presiden、Puan Presiden 或姓名与职衔；外交称谓须遵循具体礼宾格式。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 正式马来语文本通常写 presiden；英语原文、正式英文职称或双语对照中可保留 president。马来西亚国家元首的职衔为 Yang di-Pertuan Agong，不称总统。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 称呼机构负责人时依其正式职衔及场合使用 Tuan Presiden、Puan Presiden 或姓名与职衔；外交称谓须遵循具体礼宾格式。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 正式马来语文本通常写 presiden；英语原文、正式英文职称或双语对照中可保留 president。马来西亚国家元首的职衔为 Yang di-Pertuan Agong，不称总统。

etymology.historical_story: English president comes through French and Latin from a word for someone who presides or acts as head. Its older institutional meaning helps explain why the same title can identify a national leader, an association head, or a company officer. Malay uses the adapted spelling presiden, which DBP identifies as originating in English. [English history](https://www.etymonline.com/word/president), [Malay source](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=presiden).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 认准两种拼写：英语 president 有末尾 t，马来语 presiden 没有；先看国家还是机构，再决定译“总统”“总裁”或“会长”。

morphology.pattern_note: root_word与root_jawi依要求保留输入包值，但该包把派生词自身误列为词根。实际构词基词是keluar（کلوار）：peN-在词首k前取peng-形式，k脱落，形成pengeluar；因此is_root标为false。DBP将pengeluar列为keluar的派生词。

senses.zh_definition: 生产者；生产商：生产或制造某种产品的个人、企业或国家，也可置于名词后表示生产某物的主体。
senses.en_definition: A person, company, or country that produces something; a producer or manufacturer.
senses.ms_definition: Orang, syarikat atau negara yang mengeluarkan atau menghasilkan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 释义据DBP编写。negara pengeluar中的pengeluar仍表示生产主体，不必另立形容词义。pengeluar侧重生产或出品，pembekal侧重供应，penjual侧重销售；同一企业可以兼具这些身份。应依具体搭配选择producer或manufacturer。参见[DBP：pengeluar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=378040&keyword=pengeluar)。

dual_scenarios.context: 新闻 / 企业产品安全通告
dual_scenarios.ms: Pengeluar itu telah menarik balik produk berkenaan selepas menerima aduan tentang keselamatannya.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该生产商收到有关产品安全的投诉后，已召回相关产品。
dual_scenarios.en: The manufacturer recalled the product after receiving complaints about its safety.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 朋友讨论产品保修
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku dah tanya kedai, dia suruh hubungi pengeluar terus.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya sudah bertanya kepada pihak kedai, dan mereka meminta saya menghubungi pengeluar secara langsung.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我问过店家了，他们叫我直接联系生产商。
dual_scenarios.en: I've asked the shop, and they told me to contact the manufacturer directly.
spoken_features: aku用于熟人交流，dah对应sudah。
dia可在口语中指店员；标准改述明确为pihak kedai和mereka。
pengeluar可自然用于日常对话，词形本身无需口语缩略。

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku dah tanya kedai, dia suruh hubungi pengeluar terus.

etymology.historical_story: Pengeluar connects production with the familiar Malay idea of bringing something out. Its base keluar also supports words for products and production, creating a useful network of related meanings. DBP explicitly lists pengeluar among the derivatives of keluar. The modern word identifies whoever brings goods or other output into circulation. [Source: DBP, keluar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=246792&keyword=keluar).

etymology.historical_story: Penutupan shows how Malay builds an event noun from the everyday verb tutup, meaning close. The peN-…-an pattern names the act or process, while penutup can name a cover or concluding element. Public notices use penutupan for roads and facilities; programme schedules use it for the concluding stage of an event.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: tutup＝关；peN-…-an 把动作装进“事件盒子”：penutupan＝关闭、结束这件事。

etymology.historical_story: Perginya combines pergi with the bound element -nya. Malay uses this element in several grammatical roles, including turning an action into something that can be discussed as an event. The movement meaning also supports a familiar cultural metaphor: a person's final departure can signify death. Context, rather than the ending alone, tells readers whether someone travelled away or passed away. [DBP](https://dewanbahasa.jendeladbp.my/2022/03/16/2777/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: pergi 是“去”，加上 -nya，常把镜头转向“这一去”；ke mana perginya 就是“这一去，去了哪里？”

etymology.historical_story: Penderma is formed in Malay from derma with the agent-forming prefix peN-. Derma belongs to the language's Sanskrit-derived vocabulary and is historically connected with dharma. The modern donor word shows how inherited cultural vocabulary supports new institutions: the same familiar base now describes charitable giving as well as people who donate blood or organs. [Malay Language Centre of Singapore](https://mlcs.moe.edu.sg/files/dian_bahasa_6.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: Peroleh belongs to the Malay word family built around oleh, alongside beroleh, memperoleh, and perolehan. Its acquisition meaning is established within that family rather than calculated from the modern preposition oleh alone. Administrative writing makes the family especially visible: people obtain information, organisations acquire resources, and procurement is discussed as perolehan.

etymology.historical_story: Pemberani belongs to the family built around berani, alongside keberanian and memberanikan. Kamus Dewan records both an adjectival meaning, very brave, and a noun meaning, a very brave person. This pairing lets the same form describe courage or identify its bearer. It provides no evidence for a particular historical first use. [DBP entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=378040&keyword=berani).

etymology.historical_story: In Malaysian Malay, Poland functions as an established foreign country name. Malaysia’s foreign ministry uses Republik Poland in diplomatic announcements, while Poland also appears independently in official usage. etymology.historical_story: Pertamaku is a transparent combination of pertama and the bound pronoun -ku, meaning my. It does not require a separate borrowing story. The attachment places the speaker inside a sequence of personal experiences: a first car, first journey, or first love. The similarly spelled organizational acronym PERTAMA has no role in this formation.

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries place pusaran in the pusar family of turning and swirling. Their examples connect the word with sailors avoiding dangerous water and with the turning of older telephone dials. These contrasting images reveal its semantic range: the same circular movement can describe a threatening whirlpool or an ordinary mechanical action. [DBP: pusar and pusaran](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=pusaran+1).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pu.sa.ran 分三拍念，同时用手画圈：看到水绕中心转，就想到 pusaran。

etymology.historical_story: Panggilannya is a transparent Malay formation: panggil supplies the idea of calling, -an creates the noun panggilan, and -nya links it to a previously mentioned person. The noun covers several connected domains, from a voice calling someone to an invitation, a familiar name, or a telephone call. Context determines which connection is intended. [DBP entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=109300&keyword=panggilan)

etymology.historical_story: DBP places pendirian in the diri II family alongside berdiri and mendirikan. Its recorded meanings range from setting something upright and construction to convictions and positions. Standing firmly provides a useful conceptual bridge between the physical and abstract senses, although this is a learning interpretation rather than a documented chronology of semantic change. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=pendiri)

etymology.historical_story: Pakatan is transparently formed from pakat, associated with consultation and agreement, plus the noun-forming suffix -an. Its meanings connect two social possibilities: people can agree to cooperate, or agree to harm someone else. DBP records both agreements and conspiracies, so the surrounding words determine whether a pakatan is constructive, neutral or sinister. [Source: DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=150348&keyword=pakat)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: pakat 是“商量好”，加 -an 把商量的结果变成“协议或联盟”：先看共同目标，再判断是合作还是串通。

etymology.historical_story: Peru preserves a regional agricultural meaning: scattering seed. A 2024 study proposes a connection between Malay peru and Thai โปรย, meaning to scatter, alongside Malay peroi. The authors present the shared origin as an inference, so it should remain a proposal. The comparison places this small farming word within the wider history of Malay–Thai language contact. [Study](https://ejournal.ukm.my/jmelayu/article/download/80714/16486)

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: Panasnya! 是自然的感叹。初次到别人家或参加主人安排的活动时，反复抱怨可能让对方感到被责备；提出具体请求通常更得体。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合日常谈天气、食物或环境温度。正式报告描述客观情况时可用 suhu tinggi 或 keadaan panas；panasnya 仍可用于引述或指称具体热度。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: Panasnya! 是自然的感叹。初次到别人家或参加主人安排的活动时，反复抱怨可能让对方感到被责备；提出具体请求通常更得体。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合日常谈天气、食物或环境温度。正式报告描述客观情况时可用 suhu tinggi 或 keadaan panas；panasnya 仍可用于引述或指称具体热度。

etymology.historical_story: Panasnya is transparently formed from panas and -nya, rather than being a separate historical root. Malay uses heat vocabulary for physical temperature, anger, and tense situations. Adding -nya can turn a description into an immediate exclamation or make the quality itself the topic. Its story therefore illustrates productive grammar and metaphor rather than a documented borrowing.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: panas＝热；句末仿佛加一句“呀”：Panasnya!＝“热呀！”这是记忆联想，-nya 在其他句子里也可能表示“其热度”。

morphology.pattern_note: 动词词根。meN- + pimpin → memimpin，peN- + pimpin → pemimpin：鼻音成分为 m，词根首音 p 脱落。植物同形词不参与这一领导义词族。

senses.zh_definition: 牵着某人的手引路，带着对方行走。
senses.en_definition: To lead someone by the hand and guide them along.
senses.ms_definition: Membawa seseorang berjalan dengan memegang tangannya untuk menunjukkan arah atau membantunya bergerak.
senses.nuances: 强调身体上的牵引，通常涉及握手或扶引。正式主动陈述常用 memimpin；命令句可直接用 pimpin。不是单纯用语言指路。[DBP：pimpin I](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=pimpin+I)。

collocations.en: lead a child by the hand
guide an elderly person by the hand

senses.zh_definition: 领导、率领或主持团体、组织、活动或国家，并负责其方向与运作。
senses.en_definition: To lead, head or direct a group, organisation, activity or country.
senses.ms_definition: Mengetuai dan mengendalikan sesuatu kumpulan, pertubuhan, kegiatan atau negara.
senses.nuances: 重在领导责任和方向引导。正式主动句一般用 memimpin；关系从句可用 pasukan yang beliau pimpin。不能把所有“管理物品”都译为 pimpin。

senses.zh_definition: 通过教育、训练和引导，培养某人独立思考或独立工作的能力。
senses.en_definition: To mentor or train someone towards independent thought or work.
senses.ms_definition: Memberikan didikan, latihan dan bimbingan agar seseorang mampu berfikir atau bekerja secara berdikari.
senses.nuances: 强调培养成长，与单次发号施令有别；常见于教育和指导语境，日常也常用 membimbing。

senses.zh_definition: 一种攀缘植物，亦称 lada hitam hutan；DBP 所列学名为 Piper malaccense。
senses.en_definition: A climbing plant also called lada hitam hutan, listed by DBP as Piper malaccense.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis tumbuhan memanjat yang juga disebut lada hitam hutan, dengan nama saintifik Piper malaccense.
senses.nuances: 这是 DBP 单列的 pimpin II，与领导义动词为同形异义词。属于少见植物名；下列为说明性短语，不宣称是高频搭配。学名按 DBP 记录保留。[DBP：pimpin II](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=pimpin+II)。

collocations.zh: 名为 pimpin 的攀缘植物

etymology.historical_story: DBP groups three verbal meanings under pimpin: leading someone by the hand, leading an organisation, and developing another person's independence. Together they offer a memorable image of guidance, from physical assistance to social responsibility. This connection explains the senses for learning; it does not establish their historical order. The climbing-plant name is a separate homonym. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=pimpin).

morphology.pattern_note: 整词作为独立词根记忆。e 读 é /e/，不是 /ə/；ng 表示一个鼻音 /ŋ/。加 meN- 或 peN- 时，词首 p 脱落，前缀分别变为 mem-、pem-：memonteng、pemonteng。

word_family.gloss: 逃学；旷工；擅离职责；另有欺骗义

senses.zh_definition: 未经许可而逃避应到的学校、课堂、工作或其他职责；逃学、逃课、旷工。
senses.en_definition: To skip school, classes, work, or other duties without permission; to play truant or shirk attendance.
senses.ms_definition: Lari daripada tugas atau tanggungjawab; tidak menghadiri sekolah, kelas atau tempat kerja tanpa kebenaran.
senses.nuances: 现代马来西亚语境中的主要用法，通常含有擅自缺席、逃避责任的负面评价。ponteng sekolah 指没有到校；ponteng kelas 也可指已经到校却擅自不上某堂课。获准请假或因病合理缺席不应直接称为 ponteng。DBP 将词条标为 bp（口语），但 ponteng sekolah、gejala ponteng 等表达也常见于教育报道与行政讨论。[DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=ponteng)

senses.zh_definition: 以欺诈或蒙骗手段使人上当。
senses.en_definition: To cheat, deceive, or swindle someone.
senses.ms_definition: Mengecoh atau menipu seseorang.
senses.nuances: 这是《Kamus Dewan》保留的词义，派生动词 memonteng 也有此义。现代日常交流中，听到 ponteng 通常先理解为逃学或旷工；表达欺骗时，menipu 更清楚。下列搭配展示较少见的欺骗义，不宜作为现代高频搭配教授。[DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=ponteng)

etymology.historical_story: Ponteng has a linguistic life beyond the empty classroom: Malay dictionaries preserve both deception and unauthorized absence among its meanings. Some scholars have proposed a Hokkien origin, but the connection remains uncertain. Its cultural familiarity comes from Malaysian conversations about school attendance and workplace responsibility, where a short everyday verb carries a strong judgment about failing to turn up. [Hoogervorst, Malay youth language in West Malaysia](https://tufs.repo.nii.ac.jp/record/1384/files/nusa5803.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pon-teng 的两拍配上画面：上课铃响，人却溜走，座位空着——ponteng，就是逃学或旷工。画面联想仅用于记忆。

senses.ms_definition: Pencen; wang sara yang diterima selepas bersara.
senses.nuances: 《Kamus Dewan》标为 IB，即印度尼西亚荷兰语背景的用语。马来西亚通常使用 pencen；词典收录不代表它是马来西亚公文的首选词。以下搭配属于印尼语域。在印尼语中，pensiun 还可作动词表示退休，但不应直接将该用法当作马来西亚标准用法。[词源与地域说明](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/pensiun)

etymology.historical_story: Pensiun belongs to the Dutch-linked vocabulary of the Indonesian archipelago. Its source is Dutch pensioen, a word Dutch itself borrowed from French centuries earlier. Malay dictionaries preserve pensiun, while Malaysian usage generally favours pencen. The pair illustrates how neighbouring language communities can retain different forms for the same institution: financial support after working life. [Sources](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/pensiun), [Dutch word history](https://onzetaal.nl/taalloket/pensioen-pensionering).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pensiun 和英语 pension 联在一起记：工作结束，退休金继续到账；马来西亚常用词是 pencen。

senses.nuances: 可指退休安排、退休事件及退休后的阶段；本身不表示退休金，也不保证退休者享有养老金。与 pencen（退休金）及 peletakan jawatan（辞职）有别。马来文释义据 DBP 改写。[DBP：persaraan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=persaraan)

etymology.historical_story: Persaraan belongs to the sara family, which connects livelihood with leaving active service. Malay uses bersara for retiring and persaraan for the event or resulting state. This family offers a useful cultural connection: earning a living and preparing for life after employment share vocabulary, while pesara names the person who has retired.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bersara“退休”装进 per-…-an 名词框架：persaraan 就是“退休这件事、这种状态”。

senses.zh_definition: 与人的心灵、精神或心理活动有关的。
senses.en_definition: Relating to the human mind or psyche; mental.
senses.ms_definition: Berkaitan dengan jiwa atau fikiran manusia.

senses.zh_definition: 与被认为超出普通感官或常规解释的心灵能力有关的，或具有此类能力的，如心灵感应。

senses.ms_definition: Berkaitan dengan atau mempunyai kekuatan dalaman yang luar biasa, seperti telepati.
senses.nuances: 常用于超常能力的叙述及虚构作品。词义收录本身不证明所述能力真实存在；报道中可用 mendakwa mempunyai kuasa psikik 表明这是当事人的声称。

senses.zh_definition: 被认为或自称具有心灵感应、预知等超常能力的人。
senses.en_definition: A person believed or claiming to possess extraordinary mental or extrasensory abilities.
senses.ms_definition: Orang yang mempunyai kekuatan dalaman yang luar biasa.
senses.nuances: 指人时可由 seorang 标示。不是 ahli psikologi（心理学家）或 pakar psikiatri（精神科医生）的同义词。

etymology.historical_story: Psikik belongs to an international vocabulary ultimately associated with Greek psykhē, meaning soul or mind, and psykhikos, relating to it. Malay preserves both the mental sense and the extraordinary-ability sense. This semantic pairing explains why a theoretical discussion of the mind and a fictional account of telepathy can use the same word. [American Heritage: psychic](https://ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=psychic)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 psikik 与 psikologi 的 psi- 联系起来：先想到“心灵”，再由上下文判断是心理活动还是超感知能力。

senses.zh_definition: 用于固定搭配 pasta gigi，指清洁牙齿的牙膏；属于带有印度尼西亚／荷兰语来源标签的用法。

senses.ms_definition: Bahan berbentuk pes yang digunakan untuk membersihkan gigi dalam ungkapan pasta gigi.
senses.nuances: 对应 Kamus Dewan 的 pasta I，标注 IB。此义不应泛化为所有膏状物，也不宜作为马来西亚日常“牙膏”的首选说法；当地通常说 ubat gigi。马来语释义为依据词典编写的释义，并非逐字引文。[PRPM：pasta](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=168608&keyword=pasta)

senses.zh_definition: 意式面食的统称，以面粉和水制成面团，有时加入鸡蛋，再加工成意大利长面、通心粉等形状；可为干制或新鲜产品。
senses.en_definition: Food made from flour and water, sometimes with eggs, shaped into forms such as spaghetti or macaroni, and sold dried or fresh.
senses.ms_definition: Makanan daripada adunan tepung dan air, kadangkala dicampur telur, yang dibentuk seperti spageti atau makaroni dan disediakan dalam bentuk kering atau segar.
senses.nuances: 对应 pasta II 及食品术语用法。在马来西亚餐饮语境中通常理解为意式面食；范围不限于长条面，也包括管状、片状和带馅品种。鸡蛋并非所有产品的必要成分。[PRPM：食品术语 pasta](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=pasta-)

etymology.historical_story: Italian pasta descends from Late Latin pasta, ultimately from Greek, referring to a mixture of flour and liquid. Malay dictionaries record both an IB-labelled toothpaste expression and a separate food sense. These neighbouring meanings offer a memorable connection through consistency and dough, although their coexistence does not establish the precise borrowing route into Malay. [Treccani: pasta](https://www.treccani.it/vocabolario/pasta/), [PRPM: pasta](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=168608&keyword=pasta)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 pas-ta，联想“一盘意面”；遇到 gigi（牙齿）就切换为“牙膏”。用搭配区分两义，避免只凭词形判断。

etymology.historical_story: Perbatasan belongs to the Malay word family built around batas, meaning a boundary or limit. Its concrete geographical meaning provides a useful cultural connection: the boundary separating neighbouring places also defines where communities meet. Modern dictionary usage includes territorial borders and border regions, linking an abstract dividing line with an inhabited landscape.

etymology.historical_story: The root apit evokes being between things or held from either side. With the productive Malay prefix peN-, pengapit names a person or implement associated with that action. Wedding attendants make the image especially memorable: they accompany the couple at their sides. This is a semantic connection within Malay, rather than evidence for a particular ancient wedding origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: apit 想成“两边夹着、陪着”；加 peN-，便是夹东西的工具，或陪在新人身边的人。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 讨论征兆时用词中性；谈及死亡、疾病或丧事时，直接称某事为 pertanda buruk 可能使当事人不安，应顾及语气。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: “刽子手”义适合历史、文学或词义讨论，用来称呼现实中的人会带有强烈贬义。“订婚信物”义限于有依据的巨港旧俗语境。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: “刽子手”义适合历史、文学或词义讨论，用来称呼现实中的人会带有强烈贬义。“订婚信物”义限于有依据的巨港旧俗语境。

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries preserve several distinct uses of pertanda: a sign, an archaic Palembang engagement gift, and an executioner in classical writing. This makes the word a useful reminder that familiar spelling can carry different cultural histories. These documented meanings do not, by themselves, establish a historical chain linking engagement tokens with executioners. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=pertanda)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 tanda 先想到“标志”；遇到古典故事，再看上下文是否指“刽子手”。

morphology.formula: ∅ + poskad → poskad；语义上可联系 pos + kad
morphology.pattern_note: 无派生词缀，作为固定词形记忆；pos 与 kad 可帮助理解其意义，不能当作前后缀。马来西亚常见实际发音中，词尾 d 可清化为 [t̚]。

senses.zh_definition: 明信片；通常一面印有图画，另一面可填写简短消息及地址、供邮寄的卡片。
senses.en_definition: A card for sending a short message by post, usually with a picture on one side and space for a message and address on the other.
senses.ms_definition: Kad untuk dikirim melalui pos, lazimnya mempunyai gambar pada satu permukaan serta ruang untuk pesanan dan alamat pada permukaan yang lain.
senses.nuances: 常用量词为 sekeping。马来西亚标准词形为 poskad；kad ucapan 是贺卡，范围与用途有所不同。词义依据 [DBP PRPM：poskad](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=poskad)。

etymology.historical_story: Poskad belongs to the vocabulary of postal communication and closely matches English postcard, with pos and kad providing familiar Malay associations. Picture postcards also preserve visual history: Malaysia's National Archives lists images of Malayan communities and Penang villages around 1900. A brief greeting can therefore become evidence of how an earlier landscape looked. [Arkib Negara Malaysia](https://ofa.arkib.gov.my/ofa/list/material?G=&OfaMetadata_page=97&pageSize=30)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: pos＝邮寄，kad＝卡片：能寄出去、写几句旅途见闻的卡片，就是 poskad。

etymology.historical_story: Persegi is built on segi, a word for a side, corner, or aspect. Its dictionary meanings connect a geometric figure with the measurement of surfaces. A square provides a convenient unit for counting area, so the same word appears after length units. Meter persegi describes area even when the measured room is rectangular rather than square.

etymology.historical_story: PR illustrates how identical initials can enter Malay through different naming systems. In professional communication, the letters represent the English expression public relations. In the supplied dictionary record, they also represent Parti Rakyat. These are separate abbreviations sharing a written form, rather than meanings derived from a common Malay root. [DBP entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=378040&keyword=pr)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 办公室里先想到 Public Relations；政治文献里先找全称。同样的 P、R，靠上下文认义。

etymology.historical_story: English pinky, also spelled pinkie, has a history associated with smallness and Dutch finger terminology. Oxford traces the finger word partly to Dutch pink, meaning little finger, with reinforcement from the colour word. Its presence in a Malay conversation should therefore be distinguished from an established Malay derivation. [Oxford entry](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/pinky)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 说 pinky 时伸出最小的手指，把词音和动作绑定；标准马来语名称是 jari kelingking。

etymology.historical_story: The root puja belongs to the Sanskrit-derived vocabulary of worship and reverence, comparable with Sanskrit pūjā. Malay gives this borrowed root its own productive morphology: memuja names the action, pemuja the worshipper, and pemujaan the practice. This word family illustrates how inherited cultural vocabulary becomes integrated into Malay grammar. See [Sanskrit pūjā](https://sanskritdictionary.com/?action=Search&iencoding=iast&lang=sans&q=p%C5%ABj%C4%81%22).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 puja＝敬奉：memuja 是去崇拜，pemuja 是崇拜者，pemujaan 是崇拜这件事。

etymology.historical_story: English puss has more than one history. Merriam-Webster records the cat word from 1598 but leaves its origin uncertain. The slang word for a face is treated separately and traced to Irish pus, meaning mouth. Their matching spelling therefore does not justify inventing a shared Malay root or a Malay derivational history. [Merriam-Webster: puss](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/puss)

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries preserve both an older sense of peluang involving a lull in wind or activity and the familiar sense of an opportunity. These meanings offer a useful image: a pause leaves room for action. Peluangnya adds a contextual link through -nya; it is a grammatical combination, not a separate historical root. [DBP meanings](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=259120&keyword=peluang)

etymology.historical_story: Pramugari belongs to a Javanese word history rather than a transparent modern Malay prefix construction. The official Javanese–Indonesian dictionary records an older sense of leader or guide alongside the modern passenger attendant sense. In Malaysian Malay, DBP defines it specifically as a female aircraft attendant, showing how a borrowed occupational term can acquire a narrower local meaning. [Javanese dictionary](https://kbji.kemendikdasmen.go.id/kata/pramugari), [DBP definition](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pramugari).

etymology.historical_story: Paulie belongs to an English naming tradition in which familiar endings make personal names sound affectionate. It is commonly associated with Paul, whose ancestry leads to Latin Paulus. Its appearance in Malay conversation usually identifies a person or character; that appearance alone does not establish a Malay common noun. [Name history](https://www.ancestry.com/first-name-meaning/paulie?geo-lang=en)

etymology.historical_story: Pemetik illustrates how Malay builds nouns around an action. Its base, petik, covers picking, plucking, and related movements; the prefix peN- produces a noun associated with performing them. Dictionary uses range from a person picking tea leaves to a trigger or switch. Pemetik api identifies a familiar ignition device. [DBP word family](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=pemetik)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: petik 是“摘、拨、扣”的手指动作；加 peN- 成 pemetik，就是做这动作的人或相关器具。看到 api 想打火机，看到 daun teh 想采茶工。

etymology.historical_story: Malay borrows porter as a complete occupational noun from English. Interestingly, English brings together two historical strands: the baggage carrier traces through French to Latin portare, meaning to carry, while the doorkeeper traces to Latin porta, meaning gate. The two Malay dictionary senses therefore preserve a distinction hidden behind the same modern spelling. [Etymological account](https://www.etymonline.com/word/porter)

etymology.historical_story: Panaji is documented as a place name rather than established here as a Malay common noun. Goa’s government describes its beginnings as a fishing village and records its elevation to a city and capital in 1843, under the name Nova Goa. It notes several explanations for the name’s origin, so no single derivation should be presented as certain. [Source](https://www.goa.gov.in/places/panaji-also-known-as-panjim/)

senses.nuances: 通常带宾语，观看者可用 kepada 引出。祈使句用 Perlihatkan gambar itu；正式主动陈述通常用 Dia memperlihatkan gambar itu。第一人称被动结构可用 Gambar itu saya perlihatkan。释义依据 [DBP：lihat 词条中的 memperlihatkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=399108&keyword=lihat)。

senses.ms_definition: Menampakkan, menunjukkan, mendedahkan kepada pandangan atau tanggapan orang.
senses.nuances: 用于抽象事物时，重点是让人察觉或理解，不限于肉眼观看。perlihatkan 本身不表示炫耀；是否带有夸耀意味取决于宾语与语境。参见 [DBP：memperlihatkan 的第二义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=399108&keyword=lihat)。

etymology.historical_story: The revealing connection is within the lihat family: melihat describes seeing, while memperlihatkan turns attention outward by showing something to another person. Perlihatkan retains that meaning in commands and certain passive constructions. DBP records both physical display and the revelation of qualities, illustrating how visual language also expresses understanding. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=399108&keyword=lihat)

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 正式信函直接感谢对方时，使用 Terima kasih atas perhatian tuan/puan 更清楚得体；perhatiannya 通常是在谈第三者。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于学习专注、工作关注及人际关怀。说某人 mencari perhatian 可带批评或嘲讽意味；单独说 perhatiannya 则没有这种负面评价。

etymology.historical_story: Perhatian belongs to the Malay hati family, which connects the inner self with feeling and thought. Its structure makes attention something associated with directing that inner engagement. Adding -nya identifies whose attention or concern is involved. This relationship offers a useful cultural bridge between mental concentration and caring about another person. [TUFS Malay grammar](https://www.tufs.ac.jp/common/fs/ase/mal/tatabahasa_web/src/html/per--an.html).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 hati，想到把心放在某件事上；perhatian 是注意与关心，加 -nya 就把这份心思连到前文那个人。

morphology.formula: per- + ikatan → perikatan；完整词根分析：per- + ikat + -an → perikatan

senses.zh_definition: 使人、群体或事物彼此相连的关系、联系或纽带。
senses.en_definition: A relationship, connection, or bond linking people, groups, or things.
senses.ms_definition: Perhubungan; pertalian.

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 属于中性、正式用词，适合会议、报告和新闻。讨论政治联盟时，准确使用组织全名，避免把一般合作关系直接说成政治归属。

etymology.historical_story: Perikatan belongs to the Malay word family of ikat, meaning to tie or bind. The family provides a concrete image for an abstract relationship: separate participants are bound together. In public affairs, perikatan names an alliance or coalition; the same dictionary entry also preserves the broader meaning of a relationship or connection. [DBP word family and meanings](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=83916&keyword=perikatan).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 ikat“绑在一起”：把几个组织用共同目标绑在一起，就是 perikatan“联盟”。

morphology.pattern_note: 外来人名，整词记忆，不按马来语词缀拆分；正常书写须大写首字母。所列 IPA 为常见英语读音，实际读音以本人使用为准。

etymology.historical_story: Patricia comes from Latin and is the feminine counterpart of Patricius, associated with the patrician or noble class. The name carries that historical association across languages, but modern speakers normally use it simply to identify a person. Its etymological meaning does not describe the social standing of someone named Patricia. See [Online Etymology Dictionary](https://www.etymonline.com/word/Patricia).

morphology.pattern_note: peN- 接以 t 开头的本族词根时通常发生鼻音替代：t 脱落，形成 pen- + ahan。输入中的 penah 是错误切分；正确词根为 tahan。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 本词语体中性，适合工程、产品说明和日常交流。请别人操作物件时可加 tolong，使语气更客气。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 必须说明阻挡或支撑的对象，避免只说 penahan 而造成歧义。谈论被拘留者应使用 tahanan，不用 penahan。

etymology.historical_story: Penahan belongs to the productive Malay family built on tahan. The prefix peN- names an agent or instrument, while nasal substitution removes the root’s initial t. The resulting noun can describe something that holds a door or retains earth. Its structure shows how Malay builds practical vocabulary from familiar roots.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: tahan 是“挡住、撑住”，peN- 把动作变成“负责挡住的人或东西”；t 被鼻音替代，就得到 penahan。

morphology.pattern_note: peN- 遇词首 k 时，鼻音实现为 ng，原来的 k 脱落；复合词 kuat kuasa 加上前后缀后连写。

senses.zh_definition: 执行法律、规章或命令，使其得到实际遵守的行为或过程；执法。

senses.nuances: 重在使规定得到落实，不专指处罚或突击检查。须区别 penguat kuasa（执法者）与 penguatkuasaan（执法行为）；也不同于表示某项规定已经生效的 berkuat kuasa。[DBP 构词与用法说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=penguatkuasa)

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合政府公告、新闻、合规报告和投诉说明。描述执法争议时应明确具体措施，避免把这个表示行为的名词当作执法人员的称呼。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 这是中性、正式的行政用语。向执法人员询问时可用 Encik、Puan 或适当职衔称呼对方，例如：Puan, boleh jelaskan prosedur penguatkuasaan ini?
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合政府公告、新闻、合规报告和投诉说明。描述执法争议时应明确具体措施，避免把这个表示行为的名词当作执法人员的称呼。

etymology.historical_story: Malay expresses legal force through the compound kuat kuasa. Its derivatives distinguish a rule being in force, someone enforcing it, and the process of enforcement itself. Penguatkuasaan names that process. Its joined spelling also illustrates a productive Malay convention: a compound receiving a circumfix is written as one word. [DBP spelling guidance](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=penguatkuasa)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 kuat kuasa 的“法律效力”：menguatkuasakan 是“执行”，penguatkuasaan 就是“执行这件事”。

morphology.pattern_note: 现代马来语中作为完整借词词基处理；按 po.pu.la.si 读，不把末尾 -asi 单独当作本词的马来语派生后缀。

word_family.gloss: 具有一定人口或种群数量

senses.zh_definition: 居住在某一国家、地区或地方的全体居民；人口。
senses.en_definition: All the people living in a particular country, region, or locality.
senses.ms_definition: Jumlah semua orang yang mendiami sesuatu tempat, seperti negara, negeri atau daerah; penduduk.
senses.nuances: 偏人口学、统计和新闻语体。penduduk 在日常表达中更常见；populasi 可指居民整体，jumlah populasi 则明确强调人数。

senses.zh_definition: 在特定地理区域或栖息地内生活的同一物种的个体群体；种群。
senses.en_definition: A group of organisms of the same species living in a particular geographical area or habitat.
senses.ms_definition: Kumpulan individu sesuatu spesies haiwan atau tumbuhan yang terdapat di sesuatu kawasan geografi atau habitat tertentu.
senses.nuances: 生态学义要求属于同一物种；同一区域内不同物种组成的整体通常称 komuniti。此处中文应译“种群”，不能一律译成“人口”。[DBP 生物学术语](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=206468&keyword=populasi)

senses.zh_definition: 统计研究中符合既定研究条件的全部个体、对象或观测单位；总体。
senses.en_definition: The entire set of individuals, objects, or units about which a statistical study seeks information.
senses.ms_definition: Keseluruhan individu, objek atau unit yang memenuhi kriteria sesuatu kajian dan menjadi sasaran kesimpulan kajian tersebut.
senses.nuances: 这是统计学专业义，可包括人以外的对象；sampel 是从总体中选取的部分。此项为专业释写，补充所给 DBP 普通词典的两个义项。[UKM 统计学用法](https://www.ukm.my/personalia/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Artikel-10_Chen-Yee-Liang_FPend.pdf)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Pertumbuhan populasi di daerah tersebut meningkatkan keperluan terhadap kemudahan pengangkutan awam.

etymology.historical_story: Populasi belongs to the international scientific vocabulary represented in English by population. etymology.historical_story: Ponsel compresses the Indonesian expression telepon seluler into a compact everyday noun: pon comes from telepon, and sel from seluler. The result illustrates how technological vocabulary can become shorter through blending. Malaysian Malay generally names the same device telefon bimbit, making this a useful example of regional vocabulary differences within closely related languages. Sources: [BPS](https://sirusa.web.bps.go.id/metadata/variabel/42951518-9281-6faf-bc4d-a374b44ce296), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=telefon).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: telePON + SELuler → PONSEL：截取“电话”的尾巴和“蜂窝式”的开头，拼成“手机”。

morphology.pattern_note: 本词是 tadbir 的派生名词。peN- 在这里表现为 pen-，tadbir 的首辅音 t 保留，不变成 penadbiran；同族词 mentadbir 也保留 t。DBP 将 tadbir 列为保留首字母的借词实例。参见 [DBP 构词说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=men+tadbir)。

word_family.gloss: 管理、经办某机构或事务

senses.zh_definition: 行政；行政管理；治理。指组织、机构或国家事务的管理、协调与执行。
senses.en_definition: The administration, management, or governance of an organization, institution, or state.
senses.ms_definition: Perbuatan mentadbirkan, pengelolaan, pengurusan atau pemerintahan.
senses.nuances: 常见于政府、学校、办公室及机构运作，强调制度、程序与事务管理。与 pengurusan 的意义有重叠，不宜硬性规定两者完全互斥；也不能一律译为“前台”。马来语定义依据 [DBP《Kamus Dewan》](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=pentadbiran)。

senses.zh_definition: 行政当局；执政团队；管理层。借指在某一时期负责治理或管理的领导班子。
senses.en_definition: The government or leadership responsible for administration during a particular period.
senses.ms_definition: Pihak atau kepimpinan yang menjalankan pemerintahan atau pengurusan dalam sesuatu tempoh.
senses.nuances: 这是由“行政管理”引申出的借代用法，例如 pentadbiran baharu 可指新任政府或管理班子；具体所指取决于上下文。官方讲话中的 pentadbiran saya 即可指讲话者领导的行政团队。参见 [马来西亚联邦直辖区部门官方声明](https://jwp.gov.my/storage/media/MEMPERKUKUH-TADBIR-URUS-MELALUI-SUARA-PENDUDUK.pdf)。

etymology.historical_story: At the heart of pentadbiran is tadbir, an Arabic term associated with administration and considering the outcomes of affairs. Malay adds its own peN-...-an pattern to form an administrative noun. The word therefore combines an Arabic lexical inheritance with Malay grammar, connecting the management of institutions with the broader idea of directing affairs thoughtfully. Sources: [IKIM](https://www.ikim.gov.my/en/tadbir-and-tadabbur-as-outcome-oriented-thinking/), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=pentadbiran).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: tadbir 是“管理”，pentadbir 是“管理的人”，pentadbiran 是“管理这件事”：把人和事务分开记。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根起首的 s 在鼻音同化中脱落，peN- 实现为 peny-。资料包将本词判为词根，此处依据 DBP 的 siar 派生词系列校正。[DBP：siar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=siar)

senses.nuances: 广义的传播或发布行为，不限于广播电视；涉及宗教传播时，常带历史或学术语体色彩。马来语释义为依据 DBP 所作的概括。[DBP：penyiaran](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=360836&keyword=penyiaran)

senses.nuances: 现代常用义，着重播送活动、行业或制度；siaran 更常指某次播出或播出的内容。网络直播通常称 siaran langsung，具体技术过程可称 penstriman。[DBP：penyiaran](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=360836&keyword=penyiaran)

etymology.historical_story: Penyiaran belongs to the siar family, whose meanings connect public announcement, publication, and the spreading of teachings. Its broadcasting sense places those activities within organised radio and television communication. A useful cultural connection is the movement from sharing a message with a community to transmitting programmes to a dispersed audience. [DBP: siar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=siar)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 siar 的“传出去”：siaran 是播出的内容，penyiaran 是把内容传播出去的活动。

etymology.historical_story: Pastor ultimately comes from Latin pastor, meaning shepherd. Christian tradition applied the image of caring for a flock to guiding a congregation, giving the word its religious meaning. Malay uses pastor as a church title. The shepherd image helps explain why the role includes personal guidance and care alongside preaching and leading worship. [Etymology](https://www.etymonline.com/word/pastor)

etymology.historical_story: Pub entered Malay from English, where it developed as a shortening of public house. The English expression came to designate an inn or tavern serving alcoholic drinks. Malay borrowed the shortened word as a complete noun, rather than translating its components. DBP records a drinking establishment with musical entertainment. [English word history](https://www.etymonline.com/word/pub), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=pub).

etymology.historical_story: Penciptaan illustrates how Malay builds a process noun around cipta using peN- and -an. The same family distinguishes the creator, pencipta, from the created work, ciptaan. This contrast is useful across artistic and technical settings: composing a song involves penciptaan, its composer is the pencipta, and the finished song is a ciptaan.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 围绕 cipta 记三角色：pencipta＝创造的人，ciptaan＝创造的成果，penciptaan＝创造的过程。

etymology.historical_story: Pautan connects physical attachment with digital navigation. Its dictionary senses include a grip, a holding place, a relationship, and an animal's tethering place. Modern computing uses the same noun for a hyperlink. This provides a useful semantic bridge: something that connects or anchors becomes something that takes a reader to connected information. [Source](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=pautan)

etymology.historical_story: Purnama belongs to Malay's Sanskrit-derived vocabulary and is associated with Sanskrit pūrṇamā, meaning the full moon or its day. Its Malay meanings connect a visible celestial event with a unit of passing time: a round moon in the sky, or a month in a literary account. [Sanskrit lexical evidence](https://www.wisdomlib.org/definition/purnama); [DBP meanings](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=purnama).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 purnama 和 sempurna 的圆满感联系起来：月亮圆满了，就是 bulan purnama；数过两轮月圆，就可在文学叙述中说 dua purnama。

etymology.historical_story: Pedalaman tergolong dalam keluarga kata dalam, yang merangkumi gagasan kedalaman dan bahagian di sebelah dalam. Makna geografinya mengalihkan perhatian daripada permukaan atau pinggir kepada wilayah yang jauh di tengah daratan. Kamus Dewan turut mengaitkannya dengan hulu negeri. Hubungan makna ini membantu menjelaskan mengapa pedalaman sering muncul bersama kawasan, kampung dan sekolah dalam perbincangan geografi serta kemudahan awam. [Keluarga kata dalam](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=259120&keyword=Dalam).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 dalam“里面、深处”：往陆地深处走，就是 pedalaman“内陆腹地”；中间没有 n，别读成 pendalaman。

etymology.historical_story: Pembela is formed from bela with the agent prefix peN-, which appears as pem- before b. Malay dictionaries distinguish bela meaning protection or defence from bela meaning care or animal keeping. Their shared spelling creates a useful lesson in vowel contrasts: the defender sense has e taling, while the keeper sense has e pepet. Context and pronunciation work together.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: peN- 常标记“做事的人”：bela 是维护，pembela 就是维护者。再听第二音节：béla 的 /e/ 对应辩护、捍卫；饲养义用 /ə/。

morphology.pattern_note: 现代回报及退回物义由 pulang 加 -an 构成名词；ng 表示单一鼻音 /ŋ/。划船座位义另列同形词，不凭拼写强推其历史来源。

etymology.historical_story: Pulang expresses returning, and the suffix -an forms pulangan in modern vocabulary for what comes back: investment benefits or returned goods. Commercial usage makes this connection particularly visible. Dictionaries also preserve a separate boating word for the rower's seat. Its identical spelling does not establish that the seat meaning developed from financial returns or from the same historical derivation.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: pulang 是“回来”，pulangan 就想成“回来的东西”：投入资金回来的是回报，卖出的货回来的是退货；船座义另配一幅划船图记忆。

etymology.historical_story: The base terbit connects several vivid Malay meanings: the sun appears, an idea arises, and a book comes into circulation. Penerbit names the agent associated with that emergence. This semantic connection offers a cultural way to understand publishing: a work moves from private creation into public view. It explains the relationship between the words without assigning an undocumented date of origin. [DBP semantic evidence](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=penerbitan+novel)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 terbit 想成作品“面世”；peN- 标出促成它面世的人或机构：penerbit＝出版者、制作人。

etymology.historical_story: Penangkap illustrates a productive Malay connection between an action and its agent or instrument. Starting from tangkap, it can name a person catching fish or a device receiving sound. These dictionary examples connect familiar livelihoods with technical equipment. The shared idea is capture; context tells the listener whether a human being or an apparatus performs it. [DBP examples](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=penangkap)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: tangkap＝抓住；peN- 加上去，变成“负责抓住的人或工具”。看到 penangkap，先问：抓什么？人抓，还是工具抓？

etymology.historical_story: Petak connects several familiar ways of dividing space: a ship's compartment, a bounded rice plot, and a marked parking bay. An early English–Malay vocabulary already records the shipboard meaning. This historical example helps explain its spatial range without assuming that the word originally meant a geometrically exact square. [Historical vocabulary](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/7/78/A_vocabulary_of_the_English_and_Malay_languages%3B_%28IA_anr0813.0002.001.umich.edu%29.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 petak 想成“划出一格”：柜子里是一格，田里是一块，停车场里就是一个车位。

etymology.historical_story: English princess came through Old French princesse, related to prince and ultimately Latin princeps, a chief or foremost person. In Malaysian multilingual conversation, the English word can appear inside a Malay sentence, especially in talk about costumes, stories, or affectionate nicknames. Its appearance there reflects code-switching; the established Malay equivalent for the familiar royal sense is puteri. [Oxford](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/princess) [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=princess)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 用英语 prince 联想 princess，再接上马来语 puteri：王子旁的公主。英语联想用于记忆，不当作马来语构词规则。

etymology.historical_story: Penyeludup grows from seludup, whose dictionary family includes entering secretly, moving goods illegally and even diving headfirst. The prefix peN- names the person associated with an action. An intriguing regional expression, pesawat penyeludup, refers to an aircraft attacking in a dive. That expression preserves a less familiar branch of the family alongside the everyday meaning smuggler.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: seludup＝偷偷进入或运送；peN-＝做这件事的人。s 被鼻音替换后，penyeludup 就是“走私的人”。

morphology.pattern_note: 构词核心为 gunung（山）；加 pe-...-an 后表示多山地区，词首 g 保留。root_word 按资料包保留其检索回退值 pegunungan，但该词在构词上并非不可再分的词根。资料包未提供音节及爪夷文，相关字段保留 null。

etymology.historical_story: This word illustrates how closely related Malay and Indonesian vocabulary can develop different preferred forms. Its transparent base is gunung, meaning mountain, while the surrounding affixes describe a mountainous area. Malaysian dictionaries generally present pergunungan for that landscape. Technical forest terminology also records hutan pegunungan, showing why regional context matters when choosing an equivalent.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住中间的 gunung（山）：一座山是 gunung，一整片群山地区可理解为 pegunungan；在马来西亚通常说 pergunungan。

etymology.historical_story: Pura preserves several distinct lexical histories. Its city sense comes from Sanskrit pura and survives visibly in Singapura, the Lion City. Separately, Malay dictionaries record a Minangkabau money-pouch sense and archaic financial meanings. The familiar expression pura-pura belongs to another lexical grouping; identical spelling does not establish a common origin for all these meanings. [National Library Singapore](https://biblioasia.nlb.gov.sg/all-sections/vol-16-issue-2-jul-sep-2020-sang-nila/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 分三格记：单个 pura 可是旧钱袋；地名里的 -pura 是“城”；重复成 pura-pura 才联想到“假装”。这是辨义口诀，不是共同词源。

senses.zh_definition: 去；前往另一地点。pergi 的非正式口语拼写。

senses.ms_definition: Bentuk percakapan bagi pergi dengan maksud meninggalkan sesuatu tempat atau bertolak.
senses.nuances: 与前往义通过语境区分：pegi dulu 常用于告辞，dah pegi 可表示已经离开。对外公函、考试作文和正式记录应写 pergi。[DBP pergi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=pergi)

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: pegi 带随意口语色彩，本身不是脏话；礼貌程度还取决于称呼和语气。对长辈、客户或上司，可说 Saya pergi dahulu, ya。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合朋友聊天、WhatsApp 和忠实记录口语。正式邮件、公文和作文用 pergi。直接命令 Pegi! 可能显得赶人，提出请求时宜补充礼貌措辞。

etymology.historical_story: Pegi illustrates how everyday pronunciation can become informal spelling. It represents pergi without the written r, matching speech in which that consonant is absent. DBP dialect examples record pegi in conversation alongside standard equivalents using pergi. The contrast concerns pronunciation and register, rather than a new meaning or a detachable prefix. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=169476&keyword=pergi)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: pergi 的 r 在口语里“先走一步”，就剩 pegi，意思仍是“去”。只作记忆口诀，正式写作把 r 请回来。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语借词，现代马来语中作为完整词基使用，不能拆成 per- + mit。输入中的 mit 属于误切分；首音节 e 读 /ə/。

word_family.gloss: 多份许可证；整词重叠形式

senses.zh_definition: 主管机关签发的正式许可证或书面许可，准许持有人从事指定活动。
senses.en_definition: An official document or written authorization allowing its holder to carry out a specified activity.
senses.ms_definition: Dokumen atau kebenaran bertulis yang dikeluarkan oleh pihak berkuasa untuk membolehkan pemegangnya menjalankan sesuatu kegiatan.
senses.nuances: 强调主管机关给予的正式许可，不泛指朋友或上司的口头同意。马来语中通常用作名词；英语动词 permit 的意思应根据语境译为 membenarkan 或 mengizinkan。permit 与 lesen 的适用范围取决于具体制度，不能一概互换。

etymology.historical_story: Malay permit belongs to the international vocabulary of official authorization and is borrowed as a whole word. Its English counterpart ultimately traces to Latin permittere, associated with letting something pass or allowing it. The apparent beginning per- is therefore misleading for Malay learners: it is part of the borrowed word, not a Malay prefix. [Oxford](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/permit_2)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 permit 和英语 permission 联想：有正式许可，才有 permit；记住整词，不拆出 mit。

morphology.formula: per- + betulkan → perbetulkan（实际出现的非规范构形）；规范表达：betul + -kan → betulkan
morphology.pattern_note: 按输入保留直接基底 betulkan，深层词根为 betul。表面添加 per- 时首音 b 不变。此分析描述实际词形，不表示该组合符合规范；宜依句式选用 betulkan、membetulkan 或 memperbetul。

senses.zh_definition: 纠正错误；把内容、说法或位置改正。属于实际使用中出现的非规范形式，规范表达通常用 betulkan 或 membetulkan。
senses.en_definition: To correct or put something right; a nonstandard form corresponding to betulkan or membetulkan.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk tidak baku yang digunakan dengan maksud membetulkan sesuatu atau menjadikan sesuatu betul.
senses.nuances: 不能将此词作为正式写作的推荐形式。请求或命令通常用 Tolong betulkan ayat ini；主动陈述可用 Dia membetulkan ayat ini。DBP 对相关形式 memperbetulkan 的例句采用 memperbetul 进行修正；本条定义是对非规范用法的说明，并非 DBP 收录释义。见 [DBP 语法咨询](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=memperbetulkan)。

collocations.zh: 纠正错误；规范形式：betulkan kesilapan
collocations.en: correct a mistake; standard Malay: betulkan kesilapan

collocations.zh: 修改句子；规范形式：betulkan ayat
collocations.en: correct a sentence; standard Malay: betulkan ayat

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 请别人纠错时，用 Boleh tolong betulkan bahagian ini? 比直接命令更委婉。指出同事用词问题时，可说 Bentuk yang lebih sesuai ialah…。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 可用于识别聊天或草稿中的实际表达；公文、考试和正式报告应换成符合句式的规范形式。纠错宜针对内容，避免当众让对方难堪。

etymology.historical_story: This form is best understood through Malay word formation rather than an invented ancient origin. Betul supplies the meaning of correctness, while betulkan expresses making something right. Perbetulkan adds per- to that existing form. For learners, its useful cultural lesson is that an understandable expression may still require editing in formal Malaysian Malay.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: betul 是“对”，betulkan 是“改对”；看到 perbetulkan，先记意思，再把规范请求说成 Tolong betulkan。

morphology.pattern_note: is_root、root_word及词缀字段保留数据包标记；实际构词为施事前缀 peN- + buli，peN- 在 b 前变为 pem-，b 保留。pembuli 在语言学上是派生词。

etymology.historical_story: Pembuli illustrates how Malay names the person responsible for an action: the agent prefix peN- attaches to buli and appears as pem- before b. The dictionary’s example places a pembuli on the road, reminding learners that the word extends beyond school playgrounds into wider social life. See [DBP: buli](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=buli).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: buli 的声音接近英语 bully；加上表示行为者的 pem-，就记成“实施霸凌的人”。

etymology.historical_story: Parlimen belongs to the international vocabulary of parliamentary government and corresponds to English parliament. Its Malaysian institutional story is particularly concrete: the first Parliament of the independent Federation of Malaya met in September 1959. The name later became Parlimen Malaysia following Malaysia's formation in 1963. Learn the borrowed word as a whole, alongside the local names Dewan Rakyat and Dewan Negara.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 parlimen 与英语 parliament 配对记忆，再把画面定在国会两院；不要把 par- 当作马来语前缀。

senses.en_definition: A difference, distinction, or disparity between things; the standard Indonesian form corresponding to Malaysian Malay perbezaan.
senses.ms_definition: Perihal tidak sama atau adanya kelainan dan selisih antara dua perkara atau lebih; padanan yang lazim dalam bahasa Melayu baku Malaysia ialah perbezaan.
senses.nuances: 这里的 official 仅指其作为印尼语规范形式的地位，不表示 DBP 推荐将它用于马来西亚公文。DBP 收录 beda 为 beza 的同义词，但语言咨询推荐使用 beza；本条马来语释义为释义性转述，并非声称存在对应的 DBP 原文定义。IPA 表示印尼语宽式读音。词根及规范选择参见 [DBP beda 词条与语言咨询](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=beda)。

etymology.historical_story: DBP traces beda to Sanskrit bheda and records beda alongside beza. Perbedaan adds the noun-forming circumfix per-…-an to beda. The useful cultural lesson is regional: Indonesian normally uses perbedaan, whereas Malaysian formal writing normally uses perbezaan. Recognizing the shared meaning helps readers cross national language boundaries without treating the two preferred forms as interchangeable in every setting.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: beda 表示“不同”，per-…-an 把它变成“差异”；跨到马来西亚语境，记住对应形式 perbezaan。

etymology.historical_story: Oxford dates English prim to the late seventeenth century, initially as a verb. It tentatively connects the word with French and Provençal forms meaning excellent or delicate, ultimately linked to Latin primus, meaning first. That proposed ancestry remains qualified. Modern usage centres on restrained manners or neat, conservative appearance; it provides no evidence that prim is an established Malay word. [Oxford word origin](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/prim)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 /prɪm/ 时想象嘴唇抿紧、坐得笔直的人：规矩得有点拘谨。这个画面是记忆法，不是词源。

etymology.historical_story: Peserah belongs to the Malay serah family, which connects handing something over with yielding or entrusting oneself. Its adjectival use focuses on a person's disposition to yield. DBP's bilingual dictionary records sifat peserah as an equivalent of submissiveness. This establishes dictionary attestation, but does not establish when the word first appeared or justify assigning it a specific foreign origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 serah 想成“交出去”：peserah 描写容易把决定权交给别人、顺着别人意愿的性情。

etymology.historical_story: Poochi is documented as a romanized Tamil word meaning insect in the [Chennai Mathematical Institute annual report](https://www.cmi.ac.in/about/reports/cmi-annual-report-2017-2018). That establishes a Tamil association, but does not establish borrowing into Malay. The supplied packet contains no historical citation or DBP definition. Its route into this Malay word list therefore remains unknown; assigning a Malay origin, borrowing date, or cultural history would require additional evidence.

senses.ms_definition: Meminta wang daripada seseorang, dalam penggunaan slanga.
senses.nuances: 可在熟人间带打趣意味；是否涉及纠缠、施压或强索，须由语境判断，不能一律译成“勒索”。此义有研究记录，但并非已确认的 DBP 官方词条。来源：[UKM《Jurnal Wacana Sarjana》2018 年俚语研究](https://spaj.ukm.my/jws/index.php/jws/article/download/174/133/)。下列搭配为依据该义编写的自然示例，未宣称经过频率统计。不要与英语大写缩写 POW 或完整表达 ang pow 混同。

etymology.historical_story: Pembelian is a Malay formation built around beli, meaning to buy. Its relationship with membeli and pembeli shows how Malay distinguishes an action, its participant, and the transaction itself. The dictionary also records a concrete meaning: the thing bought. These related meanings connect the exchange of money with its tangible result. [DBP: beli](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=150348&keyword=beli)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 beli＝买：membeli 是“去买”，pembeli 是“买的人”，pembelian 是“购买这件事或买来的东西”。

etymology.historical_story: Perpaduan grows from padu, a Malay word describing solidity, close combination, and strength. The circumfix per-…-an turns that base into a noun for joining or being united. Its social meaning makes cohesion imaginable through physical togetherness. Malaysia's national unity action plan explicitly identifies padu as the root while examining how people understand unity. [National Unity Action Plan](https://www.perpaduan.gov.my/images/document/dasar-perpaduan/v17_PTPN.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住中间的 padu（紧密、牢固）：per- + padu + -an，把“紧紧合在一起”变成“融合、团结”的名词。

etymology.historical_story: Phantom entered Middle English through Anglo-French forms such as fantosme. Early meanings already connected appearances, illusion and things lacking reality. Its initial ph was later restored to reflect its Greek ancestry. That history helps explain why modern English uses the word for both ghostly figures and supposedly real but fictitious things. [Merriam-Webster: phantom](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/phantom).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 phantom 联想成雾里看得见却摸不着的影子：既能记住幽灵，也能记住虚幻、并不存在的含义；ph 读 /f/。

etymology.historical_story: The base masalah comes from Arabic masʾala, meaning a question or problem, as recorded in [Loan-Words in Indonesian and Malay](https://sealang.net/indonesia/lwim.old/htm/m.htm). Malay combines this borrowed base with its own per-...-an morphology. The resulting noun illustrates how an imported word can become part of a productive local word family, useful for discussing educational, social, and administrative questions.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先抓住熟悉的 masalah（问题），再把 per-...-an 想成包住问题的文件夹：permasalahan 就是其中需要讨论、处理的问题。

senses.zh_definition: 平均数，尤指把一组数值的总和除以数值个数所得的算术平均值。
senses.en_definition: The arithmetic mean: the sum of a set of values divided by the number of values.
senses.ms_definition: Nilai yang diperoleh dengan membahagikan jumlah sekumpulan nilai dengan bilangan nilai dalam kumpulan itu; hitung panjang.
senses.nuances: purata pendapatan 中的 purata 表示平均值；secara purata 表示‘平均而言’。日常的‘普通、一般’不宜一律译成 purata，例如‘能力普通的人’通常需用 biasa 或 sederhana。算术平均数不等于中位数 median 或众数 mod。释义及派生词依据 [DBP：purata](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=purata)。

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries explain purata through the older expression hitung panjang, alongside the mathematical definition of an arithmetic mean. Modern school exercises, weather summaries, and workplace reports use the same word to compress several observations into one figure. This continuity offers a useful cultural bridge between everyday reckoning and the numerical language of contemporary public life.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 purata 联想成‘铺平它’：高低不同的数值重新铺平，每份一样多，就是平均值。此为记忆联想，并非词源。

senses.ms_definition: Perihal (perbuatan dsb) menyalahgunakan (sesuatu).

etymology.historical_story: Penyalahgunaan makes an abstract noun from salah guna, combining the ideas of wrongness and use. Malay nasal prefixation changes the initial s into the ny sequence, while the suffix -an completes the noun. The resulting single written word names the act of misuse across different objects. Its structure is explicitly illustrated in a linguistic description of Malay compounds. See [Nomoto and Soh’s Malay chapter](https://www.tufs.ac.jp/ts/personal/nomoto/SelfArchive/NomotoSoh2019_Malay.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: salah 是“错”，guna 是“使用”：错误使用 → 滥用；peN-…-an 把这个行为变成名词，并让开头 s 变成 ny。

morphology.pattern_note: peN- 遇到词根首音 k 时，鼻音实现为 /ŋ/，k 脱落，形成 peng- + esan + -an；不是给单音节词加 penge-。

etymology.historical_story: The root kesan connects marks and traces with the act of finding something from evidence. Malay builds mengesan for the action and pengesanan for the process. The same family therefore links a tracker following traces with technical detection, while pengesan names the person or device doing the detecting. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=pengesan)

etymology.historical_story: The abbreviation pk points back to pikul, a word associated with loads carried on the shoulder and also with a traditional weight measure. This pairing connects bodily work with the recording of goods. The shortened spelling is a writing convention, not an affixed word, so its meaning must be recovered from the surrounding record. [Malay Civilization: pikul](https://www.malaycivilization.com.my/kamusmelayu/), [DBP: pk](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=80920&keyword=pk)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到数量后的 pk，就把缩掉的字母补回 piKul：联想肩上挑着一担货；这是拼写记忆法，不是历史构词。

etymology.historical_story: DBP identifies protes as an English borrowing. Its integration into Malay is visible in memprotes and pemprotes: Malay prefixes attach to the borrowed base while its initial consonant cluster survives. The word covers written and spoken objections as well as public expressions of opposition, so its meaning should not be reduced to street demonstrations. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=protes).

etymology.historical_story: Pembesar joins the Malay base besar, meaning big or great, to the prefix peN-. Its meanings connect two kinds of greatness: a person’s elevated rank and a device’s enlarging function. Courtly pembesar and everyday pembesar suara thus belong to the same word family, although their modern referents are very different. [DBP word family](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=besar).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: besar 是大；pem- + besar：地位大的是高官，使影像或声音变大的是放大器具。

etymology.historical_story: Penyambut is formed from sambut, a Malay base associated with receiving, welcoming, and responding. Its dictionary meanings connect several kinds of reception: a person receives visitors, a timber member supports joists, and a grammatical object receives an action. This is a useful semantic comparison, rather than a documented chronology of how those meanings developed.

headword.orthography_note: professional 是英语拼写；规范马来语为 profesional，只有一个 s。此处保留输入键、词形和空值；status 按指定结构保留，仅作词条记录状态，不构成该英语拼写获马来语规范认可的声明。主 IPA 对应英语原词；下列马来语释义和标准例句采用 profesional。[DBP 拼写指南](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf)。

morphology.pattern_note: 按输入词包，将英语原词作为未加马来语词缀的整体记录；英语内部可分析为 profession + -al。马来语适应形式为 profesional，英语 /ʃ/ 对应马来语此词中的 /si/。以下词族均使用规范马来语拼写。

word_family.gloss: 须专门知识或训练的职业

senses.zh_definition: 与需要专门知识、训练或资格的职业有关的。
senses.en_definition: Relating to an occupation requiring specialized knowledge or training.
senses.ms_definition: Berkaitan dengan bidang pekerjaan yang memerlukan pengetahuan atau latihan khusus.
senses.nuances: 本义及以下各义的规范马来语词形均为 profesional；不能因使用此词就推定某人具有特定执业资格。[DBP 四项词义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=profesional)。

senses.zh_definition: 表现出专业能力、规范做法及得体工作态度的。
senses.en_definition: Showing the competence, conduct, and standards expected of a trained practitioner.
senses.ms_definition: Menunjukkan kemahiran, kecekapan dan tatacara kerja yang sesuai dengan bidangnya.
senses.nuances: 可评价工作方式或行为；secara profesional 表示“以专业方式”。这不要求行为者必须是某个受监管职业的成员。

senses.zh_definition: 以某项活动为有报酬的职业或谋生手段的。
senses.en_definition: Engaged in an activity for payment or as a livelihood.
senses.ms_definition: Melakukan sesuatu kegiatan dengan menerima bayaran atau sebagai mata pencarian.
senses.nuances: 常用于运动、表演等领域，与业余身份相区分；表示职业身份，本身不保证技艺更高。

senses.zh_definition: 凭专门知识和技能从事某一专业的人；专业人士。
senses.en_definition: A person practising an occupation requiring specialized knowledge and skill.
senses.ms_definition: Orang yang mengamalkan sesuatu profesion berdasarkan pengetahuan dan kemahiran khusus.
senses.nuances: 此处指人；para profesional 表示一群专业人士。正式介绍宜补充具体专业或职位，避免空泛称赞。

etymology.historical_story: The English spelling professional and the standard Malay spelling profesional illustrate how borrowed vocabulary is adapted rather than copied letter for letter. DBP's spelling guide explicitly pairs these two forms. In Malaysian writing, the distinction matters: English retains the double s, while Malay uses one. Malay also builds its own derivatives, including keprofesionalan and memprofesionalkan.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住拼写切换：英语 professional 双 s，马来语 profesional 单 s；专业态度可以相同，书写规范要随语言切换。

morphology.pattern_note: 单音节独立词，不拆分。berpal-pal 中的 ber- 与重叠形式须按义项区分：可表示距离有若干 pal，也可表示帆船迂回航行。

word_family.gloss: 距离有好几个 pal；另一同形义为帆船左右迂回航行

senses.zh_definition: 旧时距离单位，约合1500米；亦可指相应的里程标桩。
senses.en_definition: An old unit of distance of approximately 1,500 metres; also a corresponding milestone or distance marker.
senses.ms_definition: Unit ukuran jarak lama yang bersamaan dengan kira-kira 1,500 meter; juga batu atau tonggak penanda jarak.
senses.nuances: DBP 标注 IB，表示经荷兰语进入印尼语的借词。主要见于旧文献及历史叙述；约1500米不是现代英里的精确换算值。以下为历史语境中的典型组合，不表示现代高频用语。依据：[DBP：pal](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=15740&keyword=pal)。

senses.zh_definition: 用于 membuang pal 或 berpal-pal，指帆船不断改变左右航向，以斜向迂回的方式航行。
senses.en_definition: In membuang pal or berpal-pal, to sail on alternating oblique courses; to tack.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam ungkapan membuang pal atau bentuk berpal-pal, belayar secara serong dengan menukar arah ke kiri dan ke kanan.
senses.nuances: 这是 DBP 分列的 pal II，不能把它解释为距离单位的普通引申义。动词义依附于固定表达，通常不单独使用 pal 作谓语。依据：[DBP：pal I 与 pal II](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=pal)。

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary preserves two separate entries under this short spelling. One belongs to older distance measurement, where a journey could be counted in pal and associated with roadside markers. etymology.historical_story: Penyatuan grows transparently from satu, meaning one. Malay turns that numerical idea into a process noun through peN-...-an: separate elements are brought into one whole. DBP illustrates the word with German reunification, showing how ordinary counting vocabulary supports the language of political history. The same formation also serves organizational and physical integration.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先抓住 satu＝一：penyatuan 就是把原来分开的东西变成一体；s 遇 peN- 后变成 peny-。

etymology.historical_story: Malay forms many names for people through productive prefixes. Pereka brings together pe- and reka, turning the activity of devising into the person who performs it. The same family connects designing objects with composing imagined material. Fashion and graphic design give this established formation familiar professional settings, while its broader creative meaning remains available.

etymology.historical_story: Pengangkut illustrates a productive Malay pattern rather than an opaque imported word. The base angkut concerns carrying or transporting; peN- forms a noun for the person or implement performing that work. The dictionary records both meanings, linking the human carrier and the transport device through the same practical function: moving a load. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=angkut)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: angkut 是“搬运”，peN- 给动作配上“执行者或工具”：pengangkut 就是搬东西的人或设备。

etymology.historical_story: DBP separates patil into three homonymous entries: a woodworking adze, a venomous fish spine, and a plate of material. These meanings evoke different settings: a workshop, a fish stall, and mechanical equipment. Their shared spelling does not establish a common historical origin, so an attractive story linking all three would be speculative. [DBP: patil](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=patil)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按场景记 patil：木工台上是“小锛”，鲶鱼身上是“毒棘”，电池里面是“极板”。

etymology.historical_story: Malay kacau connects physical mixing with disturbed order. Adding peN- produces a noun for either the person who disrupts or the implement that stirs. This shared formation explains why a laboratory stirrer and a social troublemaker have the same name. Context identifies whether the stirring happens in a container or among people.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 kacau＝搅：搅东西的是搅拌器，搅局的人是捣乱者。pengacau 把“搅”的两种场景连起来。

etymology.historical_story: Tinju names the fist or a blow delivered with it, while petinju names the participant in boxing. The formation turns a bodily action into a sporting identity. Malay also has peninju for a fist or someone who punches, so the small difference between pe- and peN- preserves a useful distinction in meaning.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: tinju＝拳；pe- 给它加上“从事这项运动的人”：petinju＝拳击手。记住 t 留着，运动员就认准 petinju。

senses.zh_definition: 菲利普斯：英语姓氏；在马来语句中用作人名专名。

etymology.historical_story: Phillips developed as a surname associated with the personal name Philip. Its familiar workshop use comes from Henry F. Phillips, who commercialised a screw-drive design originally invented by John P. Thompson. The same spelling can therefore identify a person in one Malay sentence and a tool system in another. [Surname reference](https://surnames.behindthename.com/name/phillips), [tool history](https://www.oregonencyclopedia.org/articles/phillips_screw_and_driver/).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读作近似“菲利普斯”：见到 Encik 想人名，见到 skru 想十字槽。

etymology.historical_story: This noun grows from selenggara, a base associated with managing, carrying out, and caring for something. DBP also connects selenggara with senggara through the insertion of -el-. Its broad meanings explain a useful bridge: organizing an examination and maintaining a lift both involve keeping an undertaking properly managed. Modern technical usage makes the maintenance meaning especially visible. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=selenggara).

etymology.historical_story: Pain names the measure called a pint in English. Its spelling reflects the sound of that English term more closely than its written ending. The British and American measures share a name but differ in volume, so an imported recipe can require different quantities depending on its country of origin.
