etymology.historical_story: Perkongsian belongs to the Malay word family built around kongsi, a Chinese loan associated with companies and collective enterprise. Malay affixation turns that base into a noun covering partnership and sharing. Its meanings connect commercial cooperation with everyday exchanges of knowledge, while perkongsian hidup extends the same idea to a life shared by spouses. See [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=perkongsian) and this [loanword study](https://jsass.uis.edu.my/index.php/jsass/article/download/218/160/729).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 kongsi 与汉语“公司”的联系：一起经营是“合伙”，一起享用是“共享”；perkongsian 把这种共同关系变成名词。

etymology.historical_story: Peramah is transparently formed from ramah with the prefix pe-, expressing a person's characteristic disposition. DBP records both the adjective describing friendliness and the noun naming a friendly person. This makes the word useful for describing hosts, neighbours and service staff: it identifies a welcoming manner rather than simply the amount someone talks. See [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=peramah).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 ramah＝亲切；加上 pe-，就想到“这个人天生很好聊”：peramah＝亲切、合群的人或性格。

senses.zh_definition: 模仿者；仿效他人行为、风格或作品的人；在不当复制的语境中可指抄袭者。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 可用于讨论模仿行为、艺术风格和原创性；在未核实的情况下，不宜公开用 peniru 给学生、同事或创作者贴标签。友人之间开玩笑也要留意对方是否介意。

etymology.historical_story: Peniru belongs to the Malay tiru family, which connects imitation, copying and things made in imitation of an original. Its agent prefix turns an action into the person performing it. This structure explains a useful cultural distinction: learning by imitation can be ordinary, while being labelled a peniru in creative work can question someone’s originality.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: tiru 是模仿，peN- 标记做这件事的人：peniru 就是模仿者；记住加前缀后 t 脱落。

etymology.historical_story: The salin family connects changing with copying: clothing is changed, while writing is reproduced in another version. Persalinan belongs to the clothing side of this family. Its recorded gift sense preserves a cultural setting in which a complete outfit could express honour or appreciation. This explains its ceremonial flavour without requiring an invented foreign origin. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=persalinan)

etymology.historical_story: Preeti is a Latin-script transcription associated with the name Priti in Hindi, Marathi and Gujarati. Priti derives from Sanskrit prīti, associated with pleasure, joy and love. This history explains the name's background, but does not make Preeti a Malay word meaning love. etymology.historical_story: Porsche takes its name from Ferdinand Porsche, whose surname became the company's brand. Its pronunciation preserves two syllables, including a final unstressed vowel. etymology.historical_story: Malay borrowed plot from English and uses it in several specialized settings. In literary discussion, it organizes the events of a story; in mathematics, it connects coordinates and graphs. Malay morphology extends the borrowed base into memplot, memplotkan, and pemplot, showing how an imported word becomes productive within the language. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=plot)

etymology.historical_story: Psi names a Greek letter, represented by uppercase Ψ and lowercase ψ. Malay dictionaries record its pronunciation as sai. A separate technical abbreviation, psi, stands for pounds-force per square inch. Their identical Roman spelling can mislead learners: one names a letter, while the other identifies a pressure unit. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=psi) [NIST](https://www.nist.gov/pml/special-publication-811/nist-guide-si-appendix-b-conversion-factors/nist-guide-si-appendix-b8)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 字母 psi 读 sai，记住“赛”字音和像三叉形的 Ψ；数字后面的 psi 则看作压力单位缩写。

etymology.historical_story: Pedal belongs to an international family of mechanical terms whose deeper ancestry leads to Latin pedalis, meaning relating to the foot. European forms developed through Italian and French before entering English. Malay uses the familiar form for foot-operated mechanisms, connecting bicycles, sewing machines and vehicles through one practical idea: the foot supplies power or control. [Etymological dictionary](https://www.etymonline.com/word/pedal)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: pedal 与英语 pedal 同形：一看到它，就想象脚踩踏板。把 pé-dal 整词记住，不拆成 pe- 和 dal。

morphology.pattern_note: peN- 遇词根首音 /p/ 时发生鼻音替换：/p/ 脱落，鼻音实现为 /m/，形成 pemantau-，再与 -an 组合。输入包的 pemantau 已是派生词；DBP 明确将基础词确定为 pantau，因此同步校正 root_word 和 root_jawi。[DBP 构词说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pemantauan)

senses.zh_definition: 为掌握进展、状态或变化而进行的持续或定期观察、检查与监督；监测、监控或跟踪监督。
senses.en_definition: The process of regularly observing and checking progress, conditions or activities; monitoring or surveillance.
senses.ms_definition: Perihal, perbuatan atau tindakan memantau.
senses.nuances: 强调持续或定期掌握情况，不必然表示秘密监视，也不等于已经干预或采取执法行动。可用于项目进度、环境质量、健康状态和系统运行等领域。[DBP 词义说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?d=175768&keyword=pemantauan)

etymology.historical_story: Pemantauan illustrates how Malay builds institutional vocabulary through productive affixation. DBP identifies pantau as its base: memantau names the activity, pemantau the person or instrument, and pemantauan the process. This family lets reports distinguish an observer from the work of observing, a useful distinction when describing project progress, equipment readings or organised supervision. [DBP explanation](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=pemantauan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先抓住 pantau（盯着进展看）：memantau 是执行监测，pemantau 是监测者或仪器，pemantauan 是整个监测过程。

morphology.pattern_note: peN- 在词根首音 /t/ 前实现为 pen-，词根首字母 t 脱落：teliti → neliti；再接 -an，构成表示细查、研究等活动的名词。

etymology.historical_story: Penelitian illustrates how Malay builds an abstract activity from teliti, meaning careful or meticulous. The same family distinguishes examining something, meneliti, from being meticulous, ketelitian, and from the person who examines, peneliti. This network makes the word useful across scholarship and administration: the shared idea is sustained attention, whether directed at evidence, documents, or observations. [DBP: teliti](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=254640&keyword=teliti)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: teliti 是“细心”，meneliti 是“仔细查”，penelitian 就是“仔细查这件事”；记住加词缀时开头的 t 消失。

morphology.formula: ∅ + pampasan → pampasan（输入包的整词记录）；实际构词：pampas + -an → pampasan
morphology.pattern_note: is_root、root_word 和 root_jawi 保留输入包记录；语言学上，DBP 将 pampasan 列为 pampas 的派生词，由后缀 -an 构成，词根辅音不变。下列词族共同来自 pampas，而非在 pampasan 后再加词缀。[DBP：pampas 词族](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=244840&keyword=memampas)

senses.zh_definition: 为弥补损失或伤害而支付的金钱、物品等；赔偿金或赔偿物。
senses.en_definition: Money, goods, or other payment given to compensate for loss or injury.
senses.ms_definition: Wang, barang dan sebagainya yang dibayar sebagai ganti rugi.
senses.nuances: 强调弥补损害，与奖励、捐助或一般礼物不同。具体可译为 compensation、damages 或 reparations，须依情境判断。[DBP：pampasan 释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=melukai)

senses.zh_definition: 支付赔偿、弥补损失的行为或过程。
senses.en_definition: The act or process of compensating for loss or injury.
senses.ms_definition: Perihal membayar ganti rugi; pemampasan.
senses.nuances: 此义着重赔偿行为；第一义着重所付的钱物。实际表达中，proses pampasan 等短语可突出过程，但赔偿行为与赔偿金额常在同一语境出现。

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于损害、事故、征地或其他赔偿语境。对方主动提供的慰问金可能称 sagu hati，不宜未经确认就称为 pampasan。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 讨论伤亡或重大损失时，先表达关切，再询问 urusan pampasan；直接追问 Dapat berapa? 容易显得只关心钱。

etymology.historical_story: Pampasan belongs to the family of pampas, a word for a fine or compensation. Malay proverbial tradition preserves the expression Yang mencencang memampas, associating wrongdoing with responsibility for its consequences. The modern noun carries that central idea into discussions of loss and redress, while the suffix -an forms the compensation noun from pampas. [DBP proverb and word family](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=244840&keyword=memampas)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pam.pa.san 连读，联想“赔偿损失”；再记 pampas + -an，看到 wang pampasan 就想到赔偿金。

morphology.pattern_note: 输入的词根标记需更正：paparkan 是 papar 的派生形式。直接加 -kan 时保留 p；构成 memaparkan 时，meN- 变为 mem-，词根首音 p 脱落。paparkan 常用于祈使句，也用于 saya paparkan 等第一人称被动结构。

word_family.gloss: 展示；呈现；在屏幕上显示
展示内容；屏幕显示内容

senses.zh_definition: 展示、呈现或陈述某项内容，使人能够看到、了解或理解。
senses.en_definition: To present, exhibit or set out something so that it can be seen or understood.
senses.ms_definition: Menunjukkan, membentangkan atau menghuraikan sesuatu supaya dapat dilihat, diketahui atau difahami.
senses.nuances: 常用于信息、资料、事实或经历的呈现，口语中有时可换成 tunjuk。独立使用 paparkan 常表示指令；普通主动陈述通常用 memaparkan。释义依据 DBP 对 memaparkan 的说明整理，并非逐字引文。[DBP：papar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=papar)。

senses.zh_definition: 使文字、图像、数据或其他内容显示在电脑、手机等设备的屏幕上。
senses.en_definition: To display text, images, data or other content on a screen.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadikan teks, gambar, data atau kandungan lain kelihatan pada skrin sesuatu peranti.
senses.nuances: 用于电脑操作、投影演示和界面指令。Paparkan 表示执行显示操作；paparan 通常指显示的内容或显示形式，二者不可直接互换。

collocations.en: display the image on the screen

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于报告、教学、界面操作和会议演示。表达“系统显示资料”时通常说 Sistem memaparkan maklumat；表达“这些资料由我展示”时可说 Maklumat ini saya paparkan。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: Paparkan! 单独使用较直接，适合操作指令。请同事协助时可说 Tolong paparkan…；正式主持会议时可说 Sila paparkan…。与上司交流可采用较委婉的请求句。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于报告、教学、界面操作和会议演示。表达“系统显示资料”时通常说 Sistem memaparkan maklumat；表达“这些资料由我展示”时可说 Maklumat ini saya paparkan。

etymology.historical_story: Paparkan is transparently formed from papar with the suffix -kan. DBP records the related verb memaparkan for presenting material to an audience and for displaying information on a computer screen. These connected uses offer a practical cultural bridge: a report presents findings to readers, while a digital interface presents text or images to viewers.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: papar 是“展示”这一词族的核心；加 -kan，联想成“把内容展示出来”。看到屏幕按钮 Paparkan，就想到“显示”。

headword.usage_status: colloquial; Malaysian DBP headword recognition unverified

morphology.pattern_note: 家庭称谓，整词记忆；不能拆成马来语词缀 pa- 与词根 pi。未确认常用的马来语加缀派生词，故词族留空。音节和 IPA 为常规读音分析；输入未提供可核验的爪夷文。

senses.zh_definition: 爸爸；部分家庭对父亲使用的亲昵称呼。
senses.en_definition: Daddy; an affectionate family name for one's father.
senses.ms_definition: Panggilan mesra bagi bapa dalam sesetengah keluarga.
senses.nuances: 属于家庭口语称谓，并非马来西亚通用的正式父亲称谓。此处马来语释义为编辑性说明，不冒充 DBP 原文；status 按指定输出格式保留，不能据此认定其获 DBP 标准词条认可。区域称谓研究记录了 papa/papi 指父亲的用法。[UKM 称谓研究](https://ejournal.ukm.edu.my/akademika/article/download/27605/9687)。

dual_scenarios.en: In the interview, the child explained that he affectionately calls his father 'papi'.

省略疑问后缀 -kah

messages.ms_standard: Papi, saya sudah bersedia. Saya sedang menunggu di pagar sekolah sahaja.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 亲昵感来自家庭习惯。对陌生男性、上司或客户不宜自行使用 papi；正式叙述通常用 bapa，家庭交流可按对方习惯用 ayah、abah 或 papa。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合家人之间或准确引述家庭昵称。不要根据 papi 推断使用者的族群、宗教或社会阶层，也不要把其他语言中的暧昧用法直接套入马来语。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 亲昵感来自家庭习惯。对陌生男性、上司或客户不宜自行使用 papi；正式叙述通常用 bapa，家庭交流可按对方习惯用 ayah、abah 或 papa。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合家人之间或准确引述家庭昵称。不要根据 papi 推断使用者的族群、宗教或社会阶层，也不要把其他语言中的暧昧用法直接套入马来语。

etymology.historical_story: Papi appears alongside papa in regional family naming practices. Research on the Tugu community records papa/papi among father terms used in Indonesia. This documents a cultural setting for the expression, but does not establish one direct borrowing route into Malaysian Malay. Its immediate learning value is affectionate family address. [UKM study](https://ejournal.ukm.edu.my/akademika/article/download/27605/9687).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pa.pi 想成与“爸比”相近的亲昵称呼：先联想爸爸，再记住它只适合已有这种称呼习惯的家庭。

morphology.pattern_note: 现代马来语中作为完整词根记忆，不拆成 pu- 与 saka。此处采用输入中的标准读音；部分马来西亚口音把词末 /a/ 实现为 [ə]。派生词 memusakai、memusakakan 中，meN- 在 /p/ 前实现为 mem-，词根首音 /p/ 脱落。

word_family.gloss: 把财物或传统传给后人

senses.zh_definition: 死者留下、供家属或其他继承人继承的财产；遗产。
senses.en_definition: Property left by a deceased person to be inherited; an estate or inheritance.
senses.ms_definition: Segala harta benda yang ditinggalkan oleh orang yang telah meninggal untuk diwarisi oleh keluarganya dan sebagainya; warisan.
senses.nuances: 常见于 harta pusaka 等表达，强调财产由死者遗留。不能把所有礼物或生前赠与一概称为此义的 pusaka。该词本身不说明谁有继承资格或应获多少份额。释义依据：输入所引《Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat》，可参见 [DBP PRPM：pusaka](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?keyword=pusaka)。

senses.zh_definition: 世代传承的事物，包括祖传器物、土地、习俗或精神文化遗产。
senses.en_definition: Something handed down through generations, such as an heirloom, ancestral land, or inherited tradition.
senses.ms_definition: Sesuatu yang diwarisi turun-temurun.
senses.nuances: 可用于实体祖传物，也可用于习俗或文化传承；通常带有珍惜祖辈传承的意味。keris pusaka 指祖传马来短剑，但 pusaka 本身不必然表示神圣或具有超自然力量。文化用法可参见 [马来西亚国家银行博物馆：PUSAKA](https://museum.bnm.gov.my/PUSAKA/)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Muzium itu mempamerkan sebilah keris pusaka yang telah dipelihara oleh sebuah keluarga selama beberapa generasi.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该博物馆展出了一把由一个家族保存了数代的祖传马来短剑。
dual_scenarios.en: The museum is displaying an heirloom keris preserved by a family for several generations.

dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Cincin ini ialah pusaka daripada nenek, jadi saya hendak menyimpannya dengan baik.

nak 是 hendak 的口语缩略形式
名词谓语前省略 ialah

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于家族传承、博物馆展示及遗产讨论。接触、拍摄或试戴他人的祖传物品前应征得同意；涉及遗产争议时，用语应客观，避免未经依据便指责某人侵占。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 谈到 pusaka 时，财物可能同时承载丧亲情绪和家族记忆。宜尊重持有者对其价值的理解，避免只用售价衡量。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于家族传承、博物馆展示及遗产讨论。接触、拍摄或试戴他人的祖传物品前应征得同意；涉及遗产争议时，用语应客观，避免未经依据便指责某人侵占。

etymology.historical_story: Pusaka connects inheritance with the memory carried by objects and traditions. Its meanings include a deceased person's property and things passed down through generations. Some etymological references cautiously suggest a connection with Sanskrit poṣaka, meaning a supporter or keeper; that proposed origin should remain tentative. Cultural inheritance is well illustrated by an ancestral keris. Reference: [pusaka etymology](https://archive.bukohome.com/content/wiktionary_en_all_maxi_2024-05/A/pusaka).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pu-sa-ka 记成家族接力的三拍：祖辈传、父母守、子孙接。pusaka 的核心是“从上一代传下来”。

morphology.pattern_note: 纠正输入包的词根分析：这里属于 undang 的法律词族，不应解释为表示邀请的 undangan 加前缀。词缀结合不发生词首辅音脱落；连读音节可划为 pe.run.da.ngan。

senses.zh_definition: 与法律或立法有关的；以法律为依据的。
senses.en_definition: Relating to law or legislation, or based on law.
senses.ms_definition: Yang berkaitan dengan atau berasaskan undang-undang.
senses.nuances: 常置于名词之后，形成表示法律领域、制度或职能的短语。这里按修饰功能标为 adjective，并不表示 DBP 原条目明确采用同一词性标签。badan perundangan 特指立法机关；sistem perundangan 通常指法律制度。释义依据：[PRPM: perundangan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=perundangan)。

senses.en_definition: Legislation or a body of laws; matters concerning law.
senses.ms_definition: Keseluruhan undang-undang atau hal yang berkaitan dengan undang-undang.
senses.nuances: 可统称某领域的法规，不等于一部具体法令，也不必然表示制定法律的过程。强调立法行为时可用 penggubalan undang-undang。马来文释义为综合改写。参考：[PRPM: perundangan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=perundangan)。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 不要把 perundangan 一律译为“立法”：法律部门、法律意见和法律制度中的含义各有侧重。也不能用它表示收到宴会邀请。法律词族依据：[PRPM: undang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=undang)。

etymology.historical_story: Perundangan belongs to the legal family associated with undang and undang-undang. Its connection with law is documented in DBP, alongside derivatives concerning enactment and promulgation. For learners, an important cultural distinction is between legislation, legal institutions, and invitations: similar-looking undangan often means an invitation, but that familiar meaning does not explain perundangan. The packet's root assignment therefore requires correction.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 per—undang—an 中间的 undang 联想到 undang-undang“法律”；别被 undangan“邀请”带偏。

morphology.pattern_note: 资料中的 pemandu 是相关派生基底；严格构词的词根是 pandu。peN- 遇词首 p 时变为 pem-，原来的 p 脱落，-an 构成表示行为或过程的名词。

senses.zh_definition: 驾驶汽车、操纵船舶等交通工具的行为或过程。
senses.en_definition: The act or process of driving or operating a vehicle or vessel.
senses.ms_definition: Perbuatan memandu kereta, kapal dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 强调驾驶行为、方式或技能；pemandu 指驾驶者，memandu 是动词。常用于驾驶培训、交通报道及车辆评测。[DBP 释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=pemanduan)

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于培训、考试、工作汇报及日常讨论。提醒长辈或司机时，可说 Pandu perlahan sedikit, ya（开慢一点，好吗），语气更自然。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 评价别人的驾驶技术时，用 Pemanduan boleh diperbaiki（驾驶方式还有改善空间）比直接说驾驶差更委婉。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于培训、考试、工作汇报及日常讨论。提醒长辈或司机时，可说 Pandu perlahan sedikit, ya（开慢一点，好吗），语气更自然。

etymology.historical_story: The pandu family connects finding the way with controlling movement. Malay dictionaries record pandu for a guide or maritime pilot, while memandu also covers driving a vehicle. Pemanduan names the activity. This semantic connection offers a useful cultural bridge between guiding a vessel through unfamiliar waters and steering a car along a road. [DBP: pandu](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=pandu)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 pandu：pemandu 是掌方向的人，pemanduan 是掌方向的驾驶过程。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语整词借入，不作词缀拆分；按资料读作单音节 pot，r 不单独发音。相关技术词多通过复合构词形成。

senses.zh_definition: 计算机或通信系统中传输通道的起点或终点；可指连接设备的物理接口，或供网络服务通信的逻辑端口。

senses.ms_definition: Pangkal atau hujung sesuatu saluran penghantaran.
senses.nuances: 这是资料及 Kamus Dewan 收录的计算机术语义。port USB 是物理接口；网络中的 nombor port 用于标识通信端点。[DBP: port](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=384984&keyword=port)

senses.zh_definition: 【马来西亚口语】适合某种活动或经常聚集的地点，尤指吃饭、休闲或与朋友碰面的好去处。

senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa percakapan, tempat pilihan untuk berkumpul, bersantai atau melakukan sesuatu aktiviti.

etymology.historical_story: Port is an English borrowing established in Malay computing vocabulary for a transmission endpoint. Malaysian conversation also uses it for a favourite gathering place, as documented in reporting about café culture. A helpful conceptual link is a place where people or connections meet, although this is a memory analogy rather than proof of the slang's historical development. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=384984&keyword=port), [BERNAMA](https://bernama.com/bm/news.php?id=2445322)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 电脑的 port 是数据进出的接口；朋友说的 port 是大家碰头的地点，用“连接点”串联记忆。

senses.zh_definition: 寄送、发送、运送或派遣的行为与过程，可涉及信件、货物、款项或人员。
senses.en_definition: The act or process of sending, dispatching, or shipping something, or deploying people.
senses.ms_definition: Perihal atau proses mengirim dan menghantar sesuatu atau seseorang ke tempat atau kepada penerima tertentu.
senses.nuances: 着重发送或派遣这一行为与过程；寄送的东西通常称 kiriman，执行寄送的人称 pengirim。在马来西亚物流服务中也常用 penghantaran。涉及军队时应译为“派遣／部署”，不能机械译为“邮寄”。释义依据词包及 [DBP 的 kirim 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=kirim)。

etymology.historical_story: Pengiriman belongs to the Malay kirim family. Its formation turns sending into the name of an activity, while kiriman commonly names what is sent and pengirim identifies the sender. The dictionary applies pengiriman both to goods moving abroad and to troops being dispatched, showing that its meaning extends beyond postal delivery. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=kirim)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把词根 k 放回去：pengiriman → peN- + kirim + -an。kirim＝寄送，pengiriman＝寄送这件事；kiriman＝寄来的东西，pengirim＝寄件人。

senses.zh_definition: 具有明显反社会人格特征、表现出相应异常行为的人；心理病态者。
senses.en_definition: A person with pronounced antisocial personality traits and associated abnormal behaviour.
senses.ms_definition: Orang yang mempunyai personaliti antisosial sehingga menunjukkan tingkah laku yang tidak normal.
senses.nuances: 这是指人的名词；personaliti psikopat 等结构中可用作修饰语。不能直接等同于精神病性障碍患者，也不意味着此人必然暴力犯罪。影视和争执中常被夸张地用于指冷酷、危险的人，不能据此判断真实个体。[DBP 词义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=psikopat)。该词本身不是现行正式诊断名称。[DBP 专题说明](https://dewankosmik.jendeladbp.my/2026/07/10/24739/)。

etymology.historical_story: Psikopat belongs to an international vocabulary built from Greek elements associated with mind and suffering. Its history is broader than the frightening film character familiar today: related terminology once covered a wider range of mental conditions. Malay treats psikopat as a borrowed whole word, while contemporary usage requires distinguishing psychological description from a casual insult. [Etymological background](https://www.etymonline.com/word/psychopath).

etymology.historical_story: Pennsylvania means Penn's woods: Penn is a family name, while sylvania refers to woodland through Latin silva. The name commemorates Admiral Sir William Penn, father of the colony's founder. The royal charter granted to the younger William Penn in 1681 connects this forest-based name with English colonial history. Malay retains it as an international place name. [Lumber Heritage Region](https://lumberheritage.org/heritage/our-roots/penns-woods-making-of-a-country/), [Luzerne County history](https://www.luzernecounty.org/422/History-of-Luzerne-County)

etymology.historical_story: Penyair belongs to the word family of syair, a poetic term connected with Arabic literary vocabulary. Malay writers developed syair into a distinctive local form rather than simply reproducing Arabic verse. Some traditional manuscripts left their authors unnamed; DBP notes that the author of Syair Bidasari identified himself only as fakir, expressing humility. [DBP: syair and literary history](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=SYAIR).

etymology.historical_story: Pemalu brings two separate Malay word families together in one spelling. Malu supplies the familiar personality meaning, while palu supplies the implement used for striking. Traditional drum vocabulary preserves the second meaning in pemalu beduk. The shared spelling therefore connects two very different scenes: a bashful newcomer and a wooden beater sounding a drum. [DBP: pemalu](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=300728&keyword=pemalu); [DBP: palu](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=palu).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 说人时联想 malu“害羞”→ pemalu“害羞的”；看到 beduk 或 gong，就换到 palu“敲打”→ pemalu“鼓槌、锣槌”。

morphology.pattern_note: peN- 在以 r 开头的词根前采用 pe- 形式，词根的 r 保留；不可误拆为 per- + ogol。

etymology.historical_story: The transparent history here is morphological: rogol supplies the action, while peN- forms a noun naming its agent. Before initial r, the prefix appears as pe-, giving perogol. This explains the modern word without inventing an ancient origin for rogol. The established expression perogol bersiri identifies repeated offending across separate incidents. [DBP entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=perogol).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: peN- 常标出“做某事的人”：rogol 是强奸，perogol 就是实施强奸的人；r 属于词根。

etymology.historical_story: Malay builds pembiayaan from biaya, meaning expenses or funds, using a circumfix that names the act or process of providing them. The same family includes membiayai, to fund, and pembiaya, a funder. This structure links everyday questions about paying costs with the institutional language of project funding and housing finance.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 biaya＝费用，再套 peN-...-an：pembiayaan 就是把费用所需的资金安排好。

etymology.historical_story: A Malaysian ice-cream counter makes this word's meanings tangible: perisa identifies the flavour, while an ingredients list may use it for a flavouring substance. Kamus Dewan also preserves its adjectival meaning, delicious. These recorded meanings do not establish a historical sequence, and the packet's proposed root isa supplies no reliable evidence of the word's origin.

etymology.historical_story: Pendengar shows how Malay builds nouns from everyday actions. Starting with dengar, meaning hear, the prefix peN- produces a word for a listener and, in another dictionary sense, a listening instrument. Radio gives the human meaning a familiar public setting: broadcasters address people they cannot see, bringing individual listeners together as an audience through sound.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: dengar＝听，peN-＝做这件事的人；pendengar 首先记作“听的人”，即听者或听众。

etymology.historical_story: Penghasilan grew through Malay word formation around hasil, meaning a result or yield. Adding peN-...-an shifts attention towards the activity that brings something into being. Dictionary examples connect the word with tin, rubber, and oil production, while other examples concern heat. The same productive pattern therefore links economic output, scientific processes, and creative work. [DBP: hasil](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=hasil).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 hasil＝成果，再把 peng-…-an 看作“产生成果这件事”：penghasilan＝生产、创作；语境涉及钱时也可指收入。

senses.zh_definition: 朋克摇滚；通常以直接有力的节奏、失真电吉他和强烈表达为特点的摇滚音乐类型。
senses.en_definition: A style of rock music typically featuring forceful rhythms, distorted guitars, and direct, energetic expression.
senses.ms_definition: Genre muzik rock yang lazimnya menampilkan rentak bertenaga, bunyi gitar elektrik yang kasar dan penyampaian vokal yang lantang.
senses.nuances: 常见于 muzik punk、rock punk 和 pop punk。这里的马来语定义为综合释义，并非冒称 Kamus Dewan 的逐字定义。DBP 的音乐术语资料收有 rock punk。不要自动套用英语 punk 作‘小混混’等贬称的其他词义。依据：[DBP：rock punk 音乐术语](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=rock)。

senses.zh_definition: 朋克亚文化；与朋克音乐相关、强调自主创作和挑战主流规范的文化及其审美风格。
senses.en_definition: The subculture associated with punk music, including its independent creative practices and unconventional styles.
senses.ms_definition: Subbudaya yang berkaitan dengan muzik punk, termasuk amalan berkarya secara mandiri serta gaya dan sikap yang mencabar kebiasaan arus perdana.
senses.nuances: 在 budaya punk、fesyen punk 等结构中，punk 用于说明文化类型或风格。成员的价值观与穿着并不完全一致，不应把某种发型、暴力行为或宗教立场当作所有成员的共同特征。依据：[V&A：朋克与设计文化](https://www.vam.ac.uk/articles/post-war-design-an-introduction)。

etymology.historical_story: Malay uses the English cultural label punk as a whole word. Its modern musical and visual associations developed through interconnected scenes, notably New York and London in the 1970s. Musicians and designers turned limited resources into an aesthetic of direct performance, altered clothing, and independent production. That background helps explain why punk can name both music and a wider cultural style. [Source: The Metropolitan Museum of Art](https://www.metmuseum.org/ja/essays/vivienne-westwood-born-1941-and-the-postmodern-legacy-of-punk-style).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: punk 对应中文‘朋克’；把短促的 /paŋk/ 联想到一下有力的鼓点，同时记住‘音乐＋文化风格’。这是联想，不是词源解释。

morphology.formula: pengintip + -an → pengintipan；完整构词分析：peN- + intip + -an → pengintipan
morphology.pattern_note: 依输入保留 pengintip 为直接基词，更深层词根是 intip。完整分析中，peN- 在元音 i 前取 peng-，不删除 i；-an 构成行为名词。pengintipan 表示侦察或窥探行为，并非‘间谍们’。

senses.zh_definition: 暗中观察、监视或搜集秘密情报的行为；包括侦察、间谍活动及侵犯私人空间的窥探。
senses.en_definition: The act of secretly observing or gathering information; spying or covert surveillance.
senses.ms_definition: Hal atau perbuatan mengintip.
senses.nuances: 释义沿用 Kamus Dewan。具体可译为‘侦察’‘间谍活动’‘秘密监视’或‘窥探’，取决于对象与目的；不一定涉及国家安全。与 pemantauan 相比，pengintipan 更突出隐蔽观察或探取秘密，因此不宜用来泛指公开、常规的监督。依据：[DBP：intip 及其派生词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=intip)。

etymology.historical_story: Pengintipan belongs to the Malay family built around intip, secret observation. Its structure distinguishes an activity, pengintipan, from a person performing it, pengintip. The dictionary also records mengintip and intipan. This family provides a useful conceptual bridge between watching someone secretly and gathering hidden information, without requiring an unsupported story about an ancient borrowing or a particular historical intelligence service.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 用 intip 串起来记：mengintip＝暗中看，pengintip＝暗中看的人，pengintipan＝暗中观察或搜情报这件事。

word_family.gloss: 等离子体物理学；术语组合

senses.zh_definition: 血浆：血液中通常呈淡黄色的液体部分，血细胞悬浮其中，含有水、蛋白质及其他溶解物质。
senses.en_definition: The usually pale-yellow liquid component of blood in which blood cells are suspended.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis cecair tidak berwarna yang merupakan sebahagian daripada darah.
senses.nuances: ms_definition 展开了输入包中的《Kamus Dewan》释义；其中“不带颜色”的简略描述不如“淡黄色”精确。DBP 高中科学词汇表明确使用 cecair kuning pucat。血浆含凝血相关蛋白，不能与 serum（血清）互换。参见 [DBP PRPM：血浆颜色与定义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=206468&keyword=kuning) 及 [DBP PRPM：血浆成分](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=kalium+klorida)。

senses.zh_definition: 等离子体：含有可自由运动的电子和离子的电离物质状态，通常还可含中性粒子，并表现出集体电磁行为。
senses.en_definition: An ionized state of matter containing free electrons and ions that exhibit collective electromagnetic behavior.
senses.ms_definition: Keadaan jirim terion yang mengandungi elektron bebas dan ion serta menunjukkan sifat elektromagnet secara kolektif.
senses.nuances: 此项为物理学义，与血浆义不同；ms_definition 是术语性综合释义。等离子体不一定完全电离，也不一定具有极高温度。skrin plasma 指利用气体放电的显示屏，不涉及血液。参见 [DBP PRPM：plasma](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=plasma) 和 [美国能源部：Plasma](https://www.energy.gov/science/doe-explainsplasma)。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 科学和医疗语境中属于中性正式词。向普通听众解释时，可先说 plasma darah 或 plasma dalam fizik，明确所指。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于医学、科研、科普和显示技术讨论。谈及他人的血浆捐献或检查结果时，应尊重其隐私及自愿分享的范围。

etymology.historical_story: Plasma ultimately comes from Greek, referring to something formed or molded. It became a biological term before entering physics. Langmuir's 1928 paper used it for a region containing balanced electrical charges. Malay retains the international spelling for both blood's liquid component and ionized matter, so context determines which scientific world is intended. [ITER](https://www.iter.org/print/whatsnew/266); [Langmuir, 1928](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC1085653/?page=-1).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 plas-ma，配两幅画面：血细胞周围的淡黄液体是“血浆”，带电粒子组成的物质状态是“等离子体”。

etymology.historical_story: Philadelphia carries a Greek-derived name associated with brotherly love. William Penn used the name for his planned city in Pennsylvania, and the meaning survives in its familiar civic nickname, the City of Brotherly Love. For Malay learners, this history explains the name without turning its Greek components into Malay prefixes or suffixes. [City of Philadelphia](https://www.phila.gov/media/20230706165653/OEM-Hazard-Mitigation-Plan-2022.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary connects pemandu with both showing the way and operating a vehicle. These meanings share the practical role of directing a journey: a guide leads people along a route, while a driver controls their transport. The form belongs to the pandu family, alongside memandu and panduan. Adding -nya links that guide or driver to someone or something already mentioned.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: pandu 联想“引路”，pemandu 是负责引路或驾驶的人；-nya 把这个人连到前文：他的司机，或那辆车的驾驶员。

morphology.pattern_note: -ku 是 aku 的第一人称单数附着形式，此处表示“我的”，与前面的名词连写；词干不变。ngg 表示 /ŋɡ/，词末 ng 表示 /ŋ/。所给 Jawi 为词基拼写，未包含 -ku。

etymology.historical_story: Punggung illustrates how body-part meanings vary across neighbouring language communities. Malaysian usage normally points to the buttocks, while Kamus Dewan labels the broader anatomical back sense as Indonesian. The same dictionary also records extensions to the backs of objects and hills. The ending -ku simply adds the speaker's ownership; it does not remove those regional differences in interpretation.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 -ku 就认出“我的”；在马来西亚把 punggungku 想成“我坐下时压着的部位”，先记“我的臀部”，避免误当普通的“我的背”。

morphology.pattern_note: 纠正输入包的词根标注：词根为 turun。peN- 接以 /t/ 起首的本族词根时，鼻音实现为 /n/，词根首音 /t/ 脱落；末尾 /n/ 与 -an 结合后重新划分音节。

senses.zh_definition: 下坡；下行坡段：山坡、道路等向较低处倾斜的部分，与上坡相对。

collocations.en: the unloading of goods from a ship

senses.zh_definition: 下降；降低；减少；贬值：价格、数量、水平或价值等变低的过程或结果，也可指人为降低。
senses.en_definition: A decrease, reduction or depreciation in an amount, level, price or value.
senses.ms_definition: Keadaan atau tindakan menjadikan harga, jumlah, paras atau nilai lebih rendah daripada sebelumnya.
senses.nuances: 既可表示自然下降，也可表示主动调低。penurunan sebanyak 10 peratus 指下降幅度为10%；penurunan kepada 10 peratus 指降至10%。输入提示中的数学“化简”不能仅凭英语 reduction 自动列为此词的通用义。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=penurunan)；[DBP 数学术语](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=7120&keyword=pengurangan)

collocations.en: a fall in prices; a price reduction

senses.zh_definition: 还原：化学物种获得电子或氧化数降低的过程；在适用反应中也表现为失去氧或获得氢。
senses.en_definition: Chemical reduction: a gain of electrons or decrease in oxidation state, also describable in relevant reactions as oxygen removal or hydrogen addition.
senses.ms_definition: Proses kimia apabila sesuatu spesies menerima elektron atau mengalami penurunan nombor pengoksidaan; dalam tindak balas tertentu, proses ini melibatkan penyingkiran oksigen atau penambahan hidrogen.
senses.nuances: 这是化学专义，与 pengoksidaan（氧化）相对。agen penurunan 是使其他物质发生还原的还原剂，其自身通常被氧化。[DBP 化学释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=penurunan)；[DBP：agen penurunan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=agen+penurunan)

senses.zh_definition: 权力或权限的下授：上级将特定职权授予下级行使，常见于行政用语 penurunan kuasa。

senses.ms_definition: Pemberian kuasa atau bidang tugas tertentu oleh pihak atasan kepada pihak bawahan untuk dilaksanakan.
senses.nuances: 这是固定搭配 penurunan kuasa 中的行政引申义，不等于削弱权力。具体授予范围取决于相关文件。[马来西亚卫生部行政文件](https://moh.gov.my/images/04-penerbitan/penerbitan-pengurusan/audit-dalam-2011/GPPAD_1_-_2011-PENGURUSAN_DAN_PENTADBIRAN.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: Penurunan belongs to the productive Malay family built around turun, meaning to go down. Its meanings connect a downhill road with falling prices and the lowering of objects. The circumfix peN-...-an forms a noun describing a process or result, while nasal substitution removes the root's initial t. Chemistry gives this familiar downward vocabulary a specialised meaning. [DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=penurunan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先抓住 turun“往下”：道路往下是下坡，价格往下是降价，数值往下是下降；化学语境另记“还原”。

morphology.pattern_note: 借词整词作为独立词素记忆；é 表示 /e/，不是 /ə/。派生时 meN- 或 peN- 在 /p/ 前实现为 mem- 或 pem-，并使词根首音 /p/ 脱落。

etymology.historical_story: DBP's thesaurus identifies potret as an English borrowing. Malay dictionaries record both photographs and painted likenesses under the word, bringing two image-making traditions together. The borrowed base has also entered Malay word formation: memotret names the activity, pemotret the maker or instrument, and pemotretan the process. These derivatives show its integration into Malay vocabulary. [DBP 词条及词源标注](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=potret)

etymology.historical_story: Padanan is transparently formed from Malay padan, expressing suitability or correspondence, with the noun-forming suffix -an. Its dictionary senses connect ordinary matching with comparison and linguistic equivalence. The same idea links choosing compatible objects with choosing an expression in another language: both involve finding something that fits. This explains the semantic connection without claiming an unverified ancient borrowing. [DBP](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=lawan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: padan＝相配；加 -an，记成“相配的组合或对应项”。衣服有 padanan warna，翻译有 padanan kata：都是找一个配得上的。

etymology.historical_story: Pemutar illustrates how Malay builds names for tools and people from an action. Its base, putar, supplies the idea of turning, while peN- creates an instrument or agent noun. The resulting word connects familiar objects such as screwdrivers and record players. In pemutar semangat, the dictionary also records a figurative expression for restoring enthusiasm.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 putar“转”：前面加 peN-，就得到负责“转”的工具或人；pemutar skru 就是转螺丝的工具。

etymology.historical_story: Percobaan illustrates how closely related national languages can share a word-building pattern while choosing different standard vowels. Indonesian builds the noun from coba with per-...-an, whereas Malaysian Malay uses cuba and percubaan. Regional terminology tables preserve both forms, making this word a useful reminder that translation between neighbouring languages still requires attention to local standards. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=eksperimen)

etymology.historical_story: Peri brings together separate dictionary histories beneath one spelling. Its abstract and speech-related senses belong to the literary vocabulary documented by Malay dictionaries. The fairy sense connects with Persian pari, a supernatural female being. These meanings should be learned as distinct branches: describing human circumstances and imagining a fairy are not successive steps in one demonstrated semantic history. [Malay senses](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=peri); [Persian connection](https://www.ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=peri)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记成两幅图：peri kehidupan 是“生活情状”，故事里的 peri 是“仙子”；发音相同，意义分开。

morphology.pattern_note: 名词化，表示转变或更替的过程、情况。前缀末尾的 r 与后接元音连读。资料包将整词误标为词根，此处订正为 alih；其爪夷文见 [DBP：alih](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=382696&keyword=alih)。

senses.zh_definition: 从一种状态、阶段或领导格局转变到另一种的过程；过渡，更替。
senses.en_definition: A transition or change from one state, phase, or leadership to another.
senses.ms_definition: Perihal beralih atau bertukar daripada satu keadaan atau pucuk pimpinan kepada yang lain; pergantian atau pertukaran.
senses.nuances: 侧重前后状态之间的转换，不必然表示进步，也不必然表示渐变。perubahan 泛指变化；peralihan 更突出从某一状态转到另一状态。释义依据 [DBP：peralihan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=peralihan)，马来文已展开原文缩写。

etymology.historical_story: Peralihan is built from alih, the Malay base associated with shifting or changing, rather than borrowed as an indivisible foreign word. Its nominal formation packages a change into something speakers can discuss as a process or period. This explains its usefulness in descriptions of leadership succession, changing circumstances, and transitions between stages.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 alih“转”：beralih 是“发生转变”，peralihan 就是“这一转变的过程”。

etymology.historical_story: For the father sense, English pops is recorded as a familiar alternative to pop. Collins traces that kinship use of pop to poppa, a variant of papa. This supports an English family nickname, not an established Malay borrowing history. Without a source sentence, the packet's token cannot securely be assigned to this particular sense. See [Collins: pop](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/pop).

senses.nuances: 强调实际经营或开展业务，不限定企业规模，也不必然表示拥有企业全部产权。pengusaha kantin 可指食堂经营者，不能一律译成“大企业家”。与强调创业角色的 usahawan 有重叠，但侧重点不同。相关用法见 [PRPM：pengusaha](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=pengusaha)。

etymology.historical_story: Pengusaha makes the relationship between effort and enterprise visible: usaha supplies the base, while peN- identifies the person undertaking the activity. Its dictionary meanings cover both productive enterprise and institutional management. That breadth explains why the same word can describe someone running a small canteen or someone responsible for operating a school, without implying a large corporation.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: usaha 是“努力、经营”；peN- 把行动连到人：pengusaha 就是把事业做起来、经营下去的人。

morphology.pattern_note: 施事前缀 peN- 在 r 前实现为 pe-，词根首辅音 r 保留；表面的 per- 不应误拆成这里的完整前缀。

senses.zh_definition: 规划者；负责制定计划、方案或发展安排的人，也可指承担规划职责的机构或委员会。
senses.en_definition: A person, body, or committee responsible for devising plans or programmes.
senses.ms_definition: Orang atau badan, seperti lembaga atau jawatankuasa, yang merancang sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 常与专业领域连用，如 perancang bandar。perancang 指规划者或规划机构；perancangan 指规划行为或过程；rancangan 指拟定的计划。机构用法常见于 badan perancang。义项及区别见 [PRPM：perancang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=perancang)。

etymology.historical_story: Perancang belongs to the rancang family, alongside merancang, rancangan, and perancangan. Its cultural reach extends beyond individual planners: Malay also uses it for bodies entrusted with shaping collective decisions. Dictionary examples involving education and family planning illustrate that institutional role. This account describes its transparent Malay formation and documented uses without assigning an unsupported ancient origin. See [PRPM: perancang](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=perancang).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: rancang 是“筹划”；加表示行动者的 peN-，perancang 就是“负责筹划的人”。人是 perancang，过程是 perancangan，成品是 rancangan。

morphology.pattern_note: -mu 是第二人称代词 kamu 的附着形式，此处表示领属，严格说是附着代词而非派生后缀；与前词连写，不改变词根读音。马来西亚标准对应为 puteri + -mu → puterimu。

senses.zh_definition: 你的女儿；以较郑重、亲昵或文学化的方式称呼对方的女儿。
senses.en_definition: Your daughter, expressed respectfully, affectionately, or in a literary register.
senses.ms_definition: Anak perempuan kamu, disebut dengan nada hormat, mesra atau bersifat sastera; bentuk baku Malaysia yang sepadan ialah puterimu.
senses.nuances: putri 是印度尼西亚语常用拼写，也见于相关文学及姓名用法；马来西亚标准普通词用 puteri。日常马来西亚口语通常说 anak perempuan awak。-mu 指向受话者，不是“我的”或“他的”。释义为编写释义；基础词义见[DBP：puteri](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=puteri)，附着代词规则见[DBP 语言咨询](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kubaca)。下列为自然组合，不宣称其在马来西亚语料中具有高频地位。

senses.en_definition: Your princess: your royal daughter, or your daughter affectionately described as a princess.
senses.ms_definition: Puteri yang merupakan anak kamu, sama ada anak perempuan raja atau anak perempuan yang disebut sebagai puteri dengan mesra.

etymology.historical_story: Putri belongs to the Sanskrit-derived vocabulary shared across Indonesian and Malay; its ancestor putrī means daughter. Malaysian Malay normally uses puteri, while Indonesian commonly uses putri. Adding the Malay-Indonesian possessive clitic -mu produces the meaning your daughter or your princess. The form combines a borrowed noun with a productive local grammatical element. See [WOLD’s borrowing record](https://wold.clld.org/word/71261839117036542) and [DBP’s clitic guidance](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kubaca).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把尾音 mu 连到 kamu＝你：putri 是女儿／公主，putri-mu 就是“你的女儿／公主”。

morphology.pattern_note: 本词无词缀；派生时，meN- 在 p 前变为 mem-，词根首音 p 脱落：meN- + puja → memuja。

etymology.historical_story: Puja belongs to the Sanskrit religious vocabulary that entered Malay through contact with Indian traditions. Sanskrit pūjā denotes worship or reverence. Malay preserves the ceremonial meaning in puja, while derivatives such as memuja also express intense admiration or love. This creates a memorable bridge between ritual devotion and figurative adoration. See [Sanskrit pūjā](https://ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=puja) and [Malay usage](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=puja).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pu-ja 想成祭拜时的两拍动作：献供、致敬。puja 是仪式，memuja 是进行祭拜或崇拜。

etymology.historical_story: Pelatihan belongs to the Malay latih family, alongside berlatih, melatih, latihan, and pelatih. Its formation illustrates how Malay builds a process noun around a familiar action. DBP records it under latih, so its presence in Indonesian usage does not make it exclusively Indonesian. No deeper historical origin is established here. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=latih)

etymology.historical_story: Penuntut brings together two meanings through its base tuntut: pursuing a claim and pursuing knowledge. The person-forming prefix peN- therefore produces both a claimant and a student. This shared structure offers a useful cultural image of education as an active pursuit, although that image is a learning interpretation rather than proof of which meaning developed first.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: tuntut 是“追求、索取”，peN- 标记做这件事的人：追求知识的是学生，追索权利的是请求人。

etymology.historical_story: Pangkuan connects a bodily place with an emotional idea. Its dictionary senses include the lap, the support of bent arms, and figurative membership in a surrounding group. A useful interpretive bridge is the experience of being held: returning to a family's pangkuan suggests belonging and care. This explains the metaphor without claiming a documented historical sequence.

etymology.historical_story: The expression belongs to Malay administrative vocabulary and is built from kuat kuasa, referring to legal force or authority. Its spelling illustrates a productive distinction: a prefixed compound remains separate as penguat kuasa, while the circumfixed noun penguatkuasaan is joined. This explains the familiar but nonstandard spelling penguatkuasa. [DBP spelling explanation](https://dewanbahasa.jendeladbp.my/2025/05/07/18069/)

etymology.historical_story: The maritime vocabulary preserved in [DBP’s Kamus Dewan entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=pair) connects pair with both the person guarding the sea and the boat used for that work. Its derivatives describe patrolling by boat and sailing back and forth to maintain security. This gives readers a glimpse of maritime life through vocabulary. The entry does not establish the word’s ultimate linguistic origin.

etymology.historical_story: Malay hati names the liver and also serves as a familiar centre of feeling and inner awareness. The supplied analysis connects perhati with hati, while modern dictionary treatment also uses perhati as a base for further derivatives. This offers a memorable cultural association between inward concern and outward attention, rather than a precisely dated origin story.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: hati 联想到“心”：perhati 就是“把心放到眼前这件事上”，因此记住“留意、观察”。

etymology.historical_story: Pelantikan is a transparent Malay formation from lantik, meaning to appoint formally. The supplied dictionary example places it in the world of Tun Perak and the Bendahara, linking the word with Malay court administration. Modern usage extends naturally to directors, teachers and committee members. That continuity concerns institutional use, rather than a proven date of origin.

etymology.historical_story: The form shows two layers of Malay word building. Permulaan names a beginning, while attached -nya links that beginning to something already understood. The dictionary also records foundation and introductory senses. Together, these meanings allow a speaker to discuss where something starts in time, how a story opens, or what an undertaking rests upon.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: mula＝开始；per-…-an把“开始”变成“开端”；再接-nya，就是“这件事的开端”。看到pada permulaannya，直接理解为“起初”。

etymology.historical_story: Peninjau is built from tinjau, whose dictionary meanings range from looking from a distance to visiting, examining and reconnoitring. The agent prefix turns that activity into the person performing it. This shared formation explains why the same noun can identify a civilian observer, a visiting assessment worker or a soldier gathering information ahead of others.

etymology.historical_story: The root cetus evokes the sound and action of sparks produced when metal meets stone. Its dictionary family extends from physical sparks to ideas, feelings, and events that suddenly arise. Pencetus names whatever supplies that initiating spark. This connection explains why the same noun can describe an originator of ideas or a catalyst for wider change. [DBP word family](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=cetus).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: cetus 是“火花”，peN- 标出引发作用的人或事物：pencetus 就是让想法或事件“冒出第一点火花”的引发者。

etymology.historical_story: Pendahuluan is transparently related to dahulu, expressing what comes earlier or first. Its two dictionary senses share that ordering idea: an introduction comes before the main discussion, while an advance payment comes before completion of a purchase. This connection offers a useful semantic explanation without requiring an invented historical anecdote or an unsupported date of origin. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=pendahuluan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 dahulu 的“先”：内容先出现，是引言；钱先支付，是预付款。

word_family.gloss: 按族群或群体分成各群

senses.ms_definition: Hal yang berkaitan dengan suku bangsa; juga sikap atau fahaman yang mengutamakan kaum sendiri sehingga mengetepikan kaum lain.

etymology.historical_story: The word is built from kaum with the Malay circumfix per-...-an. Its dictionary meanings connect family relationships, group affiliation and ethnic identity. This range explains why an expression about kinship can coexist with modern references to communal politics: interpretation depends on which kind of community is foregrounded. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=perkauman).

morphology.pattern_note: root_word 与 root_jawi 按要求保留资料包索引值；实际构词词根为 tebus（تبوس），因此 is_root 校正为 false。peN- 接 t 时，t 脱落并形成 pen-；再接 -an，构成表示行为或过程的名词。DBP 亦将 penebusan 列为 tebus 的派生词：[词族依据](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=penebusan)。

word_family.gloss: 赎回者；赎罪者；用于赎回之物

senses.zh_definition: 付出款项，将典当或已出让的财物赎回的行为或过程。
senses.en_definition: The act or process of redeeming pawned property or buying back something previously sold.
senses.ms_definition: Perihal menebus, khususnya membayar wang untuk mendapatkan kembali barang yang tergadai atau harta yang telah dijual.
senses.nuances: DBP 的总释义为 perihal menebus；此处按常见对象细分。penebusan 强调赎回行为，wang tebusan 可指用于赎回的款项，两者不可直接互换。依据：[DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=penebusan)。

senses.zh_definition: 通过支付赎金或其他代价，使被俘、被扣押者恢复自由的行为。
senses.en_definition: The act of securing a captive's release by paying a ransom or another price.
senses.ms_definition: Perihal membayar wang atau memberikan sesuatu untuk membebaskan tawanan atau orang yang ditahan.
senses.nuances: 用于历史俘虏、赎身或人质事件时，须结合具体语境理解。penebusan 是赎回过程，tebusan 则可指人质或赎金。该用法直接见于 [DBP 的 penebusan 例证](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=penebusan)。

senses.zh_definition: 按照约定条件，将金融权益兑付，或用积分、优惠券等换取商品、服务或利益的行为。
senses.en_definition: Redemption of a financial entitlement, or the exchange of points or vouchers for goods, services, or benefits.
senses.ms_definition: Perihal menebus instrumen kewangan atau menukarkan mata ganjaran dan baucar dengan manfaat yang ditetapkan.
senses.nuances: 这是总义在金融和消费场景中的具体应用，不表示一般货币兑换。不同金融产品的 penebusan 条件并不相同；penebusan saham 可译为股份赎回。该金融搭配见[官方审计报告](https://www.parlimen.gov.my/ipms/eps/2019-12-02/CMD%2058.pdf)。

senses.zh_definition: 通过补偿、善行或付出代价弥补过错、洗雪耻辱；在宗教语境中指赎罪或救赎。
senses.en_definition: Atonement for wrongdoing or restoration of honour; in religious contexts, redemption.
senses.ms_definition: Perihal menebus kesalahan atau dosa, atau memulihkan maruah dan nama baik melalui tindakan atau pengorbanan.
senses.nuances: 宗教语境中的具体含义取决于传统与上下文，不能假定所有宗教对救赎有相同解释。日常承认错误时，menebus kesalahan 通常比名词化的 penebusan 更自然。词义由 [DBP 所列 menebus 的相关义项](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=penebusan)展开。

etymology.historical_story: Penebusan is built from tebus, whose meanings connect recovering property, freeing captives, and making amends. Kamus Dewan illustrates the noun with the ransoming of Quraysh captives, giving it a historical setting. Contemporary financial usage also includes share redemption. Across these contexts, the recurring idea is obtaining release or recovery through payment or another compensating act. [Dictionary](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=penebusan), [financial usage](https://www.parlimen.gov.my/ipms/eps/2019-12-02/CMD%2058.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: tebus＝付出代价换回；peN-…-an 把动作装进名词框：penebusan＝赎回、兑换或赎罪这件事。

senses.en_definition: An Italian surname, usually referring in classical music to the violinist and composer Niccolò Paganini (1782–1840).
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga Itali yang, dalam konteks muzik klasik, lazimnya merujuk kepada Niccolò Paganini, pemain biola dan penggubah muzik Itali yang hidup dari tahun 1782 hingga 1840.

etymology.historical_story: Paganini enters this entry as an Italian surname, rather than a Malay derivation. Niccolò Paganini was born in Genoa in 1782 and studied mandolin before violin and guitar. His European tour beginning in 1828 helped make him a musical legend. Genoa's international violin competition preserves his name, connecting the surname with exceptional violin performance. [Premio Paganini biography](https://www.premiopaganini.it/history/niccolo-paganini)

morphology.pattern_note: 词根首音 t 在 peN- 后脱落，鼻音实现为 n；词尾只写一个 k。输入包将 penolakan 标为词根有误，已按 DBP 更正。参见 [DBP 构词与拼写说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=penolakan)。

senses.zh_definition: 拒绝接受、批准或同意某项申请、提议、要求或观点的行为。

senses.ms_definition: Perihal tidak mahu menerima, meluluskan atau menyetujui sesuatu; penampikan.
senses.nuances: 最常见的现代义项，常用于行政决定、提案及人际关系。penolakan permohonan 指拒批申请；penolakan terhadap cadangan 指对提案表示反对。义项依据 [DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=penolakan) 分述，马来文释义为整理表述。

senses.ms_definition: Perihal menangkal, menangkis atau mencegah sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 见于科学、医学及防护语境；此时不一定涉及人的意愿。具体译法须结合对象，例如器官排斥反应与排斥力。

senses.nuances: DBP 的广义释义包括 pengurangan。日常数学通常说 operasi tolak；税务项目名称通常用 potongan cukai。此义见 [DBP 的 tolak 词族释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=tolak+1)。

etymology.historical_story: Penolakan belongs to the Malay family built on tolak, whose dictionary meanings connect pushing, refusing, warding off, and deducting. These senses share a useful image: something is moved away or taken out. The circumfix peN-...-an names the action or process, allowing the same formation to serve administrative, interpersonal, and technical contexts.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 tolak 的“推开”：把申请推开是拒绝，把危险挡开是抵御，把金额减掉是扣除；peN-...-an 把动作变成名词。

etymology.historical_story: The underlying image is something standing upright: tegak. Malay extends this physical image into moral life, where truth, justice, and convictions can also be upheld. Penegak consequently connects a supporting or erecting function with the public role of a champion. This is a transparent morphological and semantic connection, rather than a dated account of the word’s first appearance. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=tegak)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 tegak＝站得直，再记 penegak＝让东西站稳、让正义站住的人或物。

morphology.pattern_note: peN- 在 b 前变为 pem-，词根首音 b 保留；后缀 -an 构成表示行为或过程的名词。输入包误将 pembaziran 本身识别为词根，此处按实际构词更正。

word_family.gloss: 浪费；过量使用而造成浪费

senses.zh_definition: 浪费；不必要地消耗或糟蹋金钱、时间、精力、食物等资源的行为。
senses.en_definition: The unnecessary or wasteful use of money, time, energy, food or other resources.
senses.ms_definition: Perbuatan membazir(kan) wang, masa, tenaga dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 强调资源被无益地消耗或弃置，通常带负面评价。它表示浪费行为，不是指垃圾这一实体；垃圾一般用 sampah。正式语体与日常讨论均可使用。[DBP：pembaziran](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=pembaziran)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Jabatan ini akan menambah baik proses perolehan bagi mengurangkan pembaziran wang awam.
dual_scenarios.zh: 本部门将改进采购流程，以减少公款浪费。
dual_scenarios.en: The department will improve its procurement processes to reduce the waste of public funds.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kita ambil sikit dulu lah, nanti tak habis, jadi pembaziran je.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Kita ambil sedikit dahulu supaya makanan tidak berbaki dan menyebabkan pembaziran.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我们先拿一点吧，等下吃不完就浪费了。

tak 对应 tidak，je 对应 sahaja。
lah 在这里缓和建议的语气。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 直接说别人的消费是 pembaziran，容易显得指责或否定其判断。向长辈或同事提出建议时，可用 Kita boleh mengurangkan pembaziran（我们可以减少浪费）表达共同改进。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合讨论食物、水电、时间、预算与公共资源。评价宴席或待客安排时宜委婉，避免当着主人或宾客的面把款待直接称为浪费。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 直接说别人的消费是 pembaziran，容易显得指责或否定其判断。向长辈或同事提出建议时，可用 Kita boleh mengurangkan pembaziran（我们可以减少浪费）表达共同改进。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合讨论食物、水电、时间、预算与公共资源。评价宴席或待客安排时宜委婉，避免当着主人或宾客的面把款待直接称为浪费。

etymology.historical_story: Lexicographic accounts trace bazir through mubazir to Arabic mubadhdhir, meaning a spendthrift, and describe its reshaping within Malay morphology. Malay speakers use the resulting root in membazir, membazirkan and pembaziran. The word family illustrates how borrowed vocabulary becomes integrated into productive Malay patterns, allowing the same central idea to name an action, its object-directed form and the act of wasting. [Etymological account](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/bazir)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bazir 记成“白白耗掉”；外面套上 pem-...-an，就把“浪费”变成“浪费这件事”。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 是附着于名词后的代词性成分，此处表示第三人称领属；按给定字段归为 suffix，但不属于派生词缀。peta 原形不变，ny 表示 /ɲ/，不是 /n.j/。

senses.zh_definition: 他或她的地图、图件；具体所指须由上下文确定。

dual_scenarios.zh: 那名官员仔细查看自己的地图后，向居民说明疏散路线。

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流

petanya 在此回指 Amir 的地图；日常交流也常说 peta dia。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Amir dah hantar petanya kat kau ke?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah Amir sudah menghantar petanya kepada awak?

etymology.historical_story: Earlier English–Malay vocabularies record peta as a chart or map, documenting its established cartographic use. Petanya builds on that noun by attaching the third-person possessive -nya. Its meaning is therefore grammatical and contextual: a map associated with someone already mentioned. The historical acronym PETA belongs to a separate dictionary entry. [Historical English–Malay vocabulary](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/7/78/A_vocabulary_of_the_English_and_Malay_languages%3B_%28IA_anr0813.0002.001.umich.edu%29.pdf)

morphology.pattern_note: 词根是 bodoh，输入包把整个词形当作词根属于未解析结果。音节可分析为 per.bo.doh.kan；词根首音 /b/ 保留。所见形式可理解为 memperbodohkan 省去 mem-，但不能据此认定其规范性。正式表达宜按语义使用 membodohkan、memperdaya 或 menganggap bodoh。DBP指出，形容词通常不接受 memper-...-kan。[DBP构词说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=tunjuk+kan)

word_family.gloss: 愚弄；把人当傻子；使人愚昧

senses.zh_definition: （非规范口语形式）愚弄、欺骗某人，利用对方的不知情使其受骗。
senses.en_definition: Nonstandard colloquial form meaning to fool, deceive, or dupe someone.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk tidak baku yang digunakan dengan maksud memperdaya atau menipu seseorang.
senses.nuances: 这里指欺骗行为，不一定指公开羞辱。释义依据规范相关词 membodohkan 的“欺骗”义整理，并非DBP对 perbodohkan 的独立释义；下列搭配用于说明所见口语结构，不代表经过频率统计。[DBP：membodohkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=membodohkan)

senses.zh_definition: （非规范口语形式）把某人当傻子对待，轻视对方的理解力或判断力。
senses.en_definition: Nonstandard colloquial form meaning to treat someone as a fool or insult their intelligence.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk tidak baku yang digunakan dengan maksud menganggap atau memperlakukan seseorang sebagai orang bodoh.
senses.nuances: 重点在轻视或侮辱对方的判断力，不必涉及实际诈骗。与第一义可能重叠。“Jangan perbodohkan aku”通常是在抗议被轻视，语气强硬。规范相关词 membodohkan 收有此义。[DBP：bodoh及其派生词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=bodoh)

collocations.en: don't treat me like an idiot

dual_scenarios.zh: 在那份正式报告中，“愚弄顾客”这一非规范表达被改为“欺骗顾客”，以便更准确地传达意思。

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp／朋友谈论可疑付款要求
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Dia nak perbodohkan kita je dengan alasan tu.

je 对应 sahaja，带有“就是、不过是”的语气。
tu 对应 itu。
perbodohkan 为非规范口语形式；标准对应句按语义改用 memperdaya。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)

etymology.historical_story: The useful starting point is bodoh, meaning foolish or slow to understand. Malay builds related meanings through affixes: membodohkan can describe treating someone as foolish or deceiving them. Perbodohkan is best approached as a nonstandard surface form within this family, rather than an independent historical root. No specific date or place of origin is established by the available evidence.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 bodoh＝“傻”：perbodohkan 的常见意图就是“拿人当傻子”。记规范主动形式：membodohkan。

morphology.formula: ∅ + palace → palace（英语整词；标准马来语通常对应 istana）
morphology.pattern_note: 这是英语词项，不是已核实的规范马来语普通名词。英语读作两个音节，重音在第一音节；不能按马来语字母音值读成 pa.la.ce。输入包的 syllables 和 jawi 均保留为 null。下列词族属于英语，不代表马来语派生关系。

word_family.affix: 历史上为拉丁语词干 palatium + -al
word_family.gloss: 宫殿般宏伟豪华的；与 palace 同源

senses.zh_definition: （英语）宫殿；君主、国家元首或某些高级宗教人士的正式居所。
senses.en_definition: The official residence of a monarch, head of state, or certain high-ranking religious dignitaries.
senses.ms_definition: Kediaman rasmi raja, ketua negara atau pembesar agama tertentu; lazimnya diterjemahkan sebagai istana.
senses.nuances: DBP把 palace 列在英马词典中，马来语对应词为 istana，而不是把 palace 列作马来语词头。以下 ms 搭配提供标准马来语译法。[DBP英马词典](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=istana)

senses.zh_definition: （英语，比喻）宫殿般宏伟豪华的住宅或建筑。

senses.ms_definition: Rumah atau bangunan yang sangat besar dan mewah sehingga menyerupai istana.

collocations.zh: 大理石宫殿；宫殿般的大理石豪宅

senses.zh_definition: （英语，转喻，通常作 the Palace）王室方面；代表君主发言或办事的宫廷机构及人员。

senses.ms_definition: Pihak istana atau pegawai yang bertindak bagi pihak raja.
senses.nuances: 英语新闻中常以 the Palace 指机构及人员，而非宫殿建筑；通常大写。标准马来语对应 pihak istana。[Cambridge：the Palace](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/palace)

senses.zh_definition: （英语，多见于旧式称呼或名称）规模宏大、装饰华丽的娱乐场所，如电影院或舞厅。
senses.en_definition: A large, ornate entertainment venue, especially in historical usage or venue names.
senses.ms_definition: Tempat hiburan yang besar dan berhias mewah, khususnya dalam penggunaan lama atau nama premis.
senses.nuances: 此义不涉及王室。英语旧式用法可指豪华影院或舞厅；翻译时应按场所功能处理。以下 ms 为解释性译法。[Cambridge：palace的娱乐场所义](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/palace)

etymology.historical_story: English palace ultimately comes from Palatium, the name of Rome's Palatine Hill, where emperors built their residences. The place-name became a word for an imperial dwelling, then passed through Anglo-French into Middle English. A particular Roman hillside thus gave English a general name for royal residences. [Merriam-Webster records this history](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/palace).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听 /ˈpæl.ɪs/，想象一座王宫；再接上马来语桥梁：palace → istana → 宫殿。英语词形整体记忆，不拆成马来语词缀。

morphology.pattern_note: 拟声性呼唤语，不作马来语词缀拆分。/pst/ 是参考英语词典的常见记音，并非已核实的马来语规范读音；通常发成短促气声，不逐个念字母。输入未提供音节划分或爪夷文，保留 null。

senses.en_definition: A quiet hissing call used to attract someone's attention discreetly.
senses.ms_definition: Bunyi desisan pendek yang digunakan untuk menarik perhatian seseorang secara perlahan-lahan tanpa menarik perhatian orang lain.
senses.nuances: 实际语法功能是感叹性呼唤语（kata seru）；为适配所给词性选项，归入 particle。输入没有 DBP 释义，本条马来文为编辑释义，不能视为 DBP 官方引文，headword.status 亦不构成收录证明。其主要作用是引起注意，区别于要求安静的 shh。以下搭配为典型话语组合，未作频率排序。义项与读音参见 [Cambridge：psst](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/psst?topic=sounds-used-as-interjections)。

etymology.historical_story: Psst represents a discreet hiss rather than an ordinary word built from a lexical root and affixes. English dictionaries identify its origin as imitative, and similar written calls can appear in multilingual conversation. That resemblance does not establish a particular borrowing route into Malay. The supplied packet gives no historical attestation or DBP definition, so a specifically Malay origin remains unverified. Source: [Collins: psst](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/us/dictionary/english/psst).

morphology.pattern_note: 这是英语整词，在马来语交流中可作为英语夹杂使用，不能分析为马来语 pe- + ace；输入包中的 ace 词根解析因此予以纠正。英语读音为单音节 /piːs/，不按马来语拼写逐字母读音。词族仅列英语派生词。

word_family.gloss: （英语）爱好和平的；不喜争执的

senses.zh_definition: （英语）和平、安宁或和睦：没有战争、暴力、骚乱或人际冲突的状态。
senses.en_definition: Freedom from war, violence, or civil disorder; harmony between people or groups.
senses.ms_definition: Kata bahasa Inggeris yang merujuk kepada keadaan aman atau damai, tanpa peperangan, kekacauan atau persengketaan.
senses.nuances: 这是英语义项，不能因 PRPM 收有英马翻译就标为规范马来语词条。马来语依语境使用 keamanan、kedamaian 或 damai。以下搭配提供标准马来语对应表达，分别对应 world peace 和 peace negotiations。依据：[PRPM：peace，Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=peace)。

senses.zh_definition: （英语）宁静、平静；不受噪声、打扰或忧虑影响的状态。
senses.en_definition: Quiet and tranquillity; freedom from disturbance or anxiety.

senses.nuances: 强调内心或环境的平静，马来语通常用 ketenangan 或 ketenteraman；peace of mind 不能机械译成有关国家安全的表达。以下为英语搭配的马来语对应表达。依据：[PRPM：peace](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=peace)。

senses.zh_definition: （马来语非正式交流中的英语夹杂）食指与中指伸开形成 V 字的手势，常见于拍照。
senses.en_definition: In informal Malay code-switching, a V-shaped gesture made with the index and middle fingers, especially when posing for a photograph.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam percakapan tidak rasmi, sebutan bahasa Inggeris bagi isyarat berbentuk V yang dibuat dengan mengangkat jari telunjuk dan jari tengah.
senses.nuances: 这里指手势，不表示达成和平协议。DBP 的语言咨询记录讨论过俗称 peace 的举双指动作，但该记录不能作为其已获规范马来语词条资格的证明。以下搭配属于口语夹杂。依据：[PRPM：peace 语言咨询](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=peace)。

etymology.historical_story: English peace entered Middle English through Anglo-French forms such as pes, ultimately descending from Latin pax. Its history belongs to English borrowing from French, not Malay prefixation. Malaysian conversational use of the English label for a V-shaped hand gesture is a separate usage context, rather than evidence for a root ace. [Source: Studies in Middle English](https://api.pageplace.de/preview/DT0400.9783653033755_A31442733/preview-9783653033755_A31442733.pdf).

word_family.gloss: 处于分离或隔开的状态

senses.zh_definition: 使事物彼此分开、隔开或形成界限的东西；分隔物、分隔装置，也可指抽象的界限或隔阂。
senses.en_definition: Something that separates or keeps things apart; a divider, separator, barrier, or figurative dividing factor.

senses.nuances: 可指实体隔板、技术分离装置或抽象界限。在 dinding pemisah 等结构中，pemisah 是说明用途的名词。它指分隔者或分隔物；pemisahan 则指分隔的行为或过程。释义及词族见 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=pemisah)。

senses.zh_definition: 介入争执、使争执双方分开或平息争端的人；劝架者、调解者。
senses.en_definition: A person who separates disputing parties or helps settle their dispute; a peacemaker or mediator.
senses.ms_definition: Jurupisah.
senses.nuances: 《Kamus Dewan》第二义转释为 jurupisah。此人物义在现代马来西亚日常表达中较少见；明确指调解者时常用 pengantara 或 pendamai，指赛事裁判时通常用 pengadil。以下为说明人物义的组合，不作为高频固定搭配处理。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=pemisah)、[DBP 同义词资料](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=wasit)。

etymology.historical_story: Pemisah belongs to the Malay word family built around pisah, meaning separation. Its noun-forming prefix identifies something or someone that separates. The dictionary preserves both the familiar divider sense and a less common peacemaker sense: separation can create a boundary, but it can also stop a quarrel. This is a semantic connection, not a dated origin account. [DBP word family](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=pisah).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: pisah 是“分开”；peN- 把它变成“负责分开的东西或人”。记住 pemisah 是隔板，pemisahan 是分隔这件事。

morphology.pattern_note: -mu 是 kamu 的附着式人称代词，此处表示“你的”，并非产生新词义的派生后缀；suffix 是本结构中的位置分类。连接时没有音位替换。输入的 pikiran 是直接构词基础，最终基础词是 pikir；马来西亚规范对应形式为 fikir → fikiran → fikiranmu。

messages.ms_spoken: Aku dah dengar lagu tu. “Pikiranmu” maksudnya apa, ya?
messages.ms_standard: Saya sudah mendengar lagu itu. Apakah maksud perkataan “pikiranmu”?
messages.zh: 我已经听过那首歌了。“Pikiranmu”是什么意思呀？
messages.en: I've listened to that song. What does “pikiranmu” mean?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Maksudnya fikiran kau. Dalam bahasa Melayu Malaysia, kita biasanya tulis “fikiranmu” je.
messages.ms_standard: Maksudnya ialah fikiran kamu. Dalam bahasa Melayu Malaysia, kita biasanya menulisnya sebagai “fikiranmu”.
messages.zh: 就是“你的想法”或“你的心思”。在马来西亚马来文里，我们一般写“fikiranmu”。
messages.en: It means your mind or your thoughts. In Malaysian Malay, we'd usually write “fikiranmu”.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: -mu 带有直接称呼“你”的意味，在亲密关系、诗歌和歌词中自然；面对客户、上级或不熟悉的长辈，宜按关系改用 fikiran anda、pandangan tuan 或 pandangan puan。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 讨论印尼文本时保留 pikiranmu 合适；撰写马来西亚公文或教材时通常采用 fikiranmu 或 fikiran anda。询问别人的想法可用 Apakah pandangan anda?，比命令对方改变思想更委婉。本条 official 为指定条目标签，不代表已核实 DBP 将完整词形 pikiranmu 单独列为规范词目。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: -mu 带有直接称呼“你”的意味，在亲密关系、诗歌和歌词中自然；面对客户、上级或不熟悉的长辈，宜按关系改用 fikiran anda、pandangan tuan 或 pandangan puan。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 讨论印尼文本时保留 pikiranmu 合适；撰写马来西亚公文或教材时通常采用 fikiranmu 或 fikiran anda。询问别人的想法可用 Apakah pandangan anda?，比命令对方改变思想更委婉。本条 official 为指定条目标签，不代表已核实 DBP 将完整词形 pikiranmu 单独列为规范词目。

etymology.historical_story: Pikiranmu combines pikiran with the attached pronoun -mu, meaning your. Its deeper base, pikir, belongs to the word family borrowed from Arabic fikr, meaning thought. Indonesian established the spelling with p, while Malaysian Malay generally uses fikir and fikiran. The contrast helps explain familiar differences encountered in songs and reading. [Source: Indonesian language authority](https://repositori.kemendikdasmen.go.id/3355/1/Penelitian%20Kosakata%20Bahasa%20Arab%20dalam%20Bahasa%20Indonesia.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 pikiran＝想法，再把 -mu 连到 kamu＝你：pikiranmu＝你的想法。马来西亚常见对应形式是 fikiranmu。

morphology.formula: perbuatan + -nya → perbuatannya；内部构词：per- + buat + -an → perbuatan
morphology.pattern_note: -nya 在这里是后附的第三人称代词，表示行为属于前文所指的人；suffix 是本结构中的位置标签。直接词基 perbuatan 沿用输入包，进一步的词根为 buat。相接时不删字母，ny 读 /ɲ/；per- 中的 e 读 /ə/。

senses.zh_definition: 他或她所做的事；其行为或举动。具体指一次行为还是多项行为，由上下文决定。
senses.en_definition: An act, deed, or action performed by the person previously mentioned; his or her action or actions.
senses.ms_definition: Sesuatu yang dilakukan atau dikerjakan oleh orang yang dirujuk melalui kata ganti nama -nya.
senses.nuances: -nya 不标明性别，也不自动表示复数。该词本身既可指善行，也可指恶行；负面含义来自语境。此处马来语释义依据 DBP 对 perbuatan 的说明及 -nya 的功能编写，并非对整个词形的逐字引文。参见 [DBP：perbuatan 与 tindakan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=perbuatan+jahat)。

collocations.en: the consequences of his or her actions

senses.zh_definition: 他或她表现出来的行为、举止或行事方式；常用于与言语、承诺或道德标准作比较。
senses.en_definition: The person's conduct or behaviour, especially as judged against their words or expected standards.
senses.ms_definition: Tingkah laku atau cara seseorang bertindak, khususnya apabila dinilai atau dibandingkan dengan kata-katanya.
senses.nuances: 这是从具体所做之事延伸到行为表现的用法，与第一义相通，并非新的词缀意义。perbuatannya 不等于其性格，也不必然指长期习惯；强调惯常脾性时，perangainya 或 kelakuannya 可能更贴切。DBP 对相关词义的说明见 [kelakuan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kelakuan)。

collocations.en: his or her words and deeds

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 可用于新闻、学校训导、职场说明和日常评价。它不天然等于罪行；没有明确事实时，不宜把对某项行为的批评升级为对人格或犯罪性质的判断。公开场合的道歉和批评也应顾及对方的体面。

etymology.historical_story: An earlier English–Malay vocabulary records perbuatan with meanings spanning work, workmanship, manufacture, action and deed. That range connects making something with doing something. Modern learners can follow the same bridge from buat to perbuatan, then attach -nya to identify whose deed is meant. This is transparent Malay morphology, rather than evidence of a separate borrowed word. [Historical vocabulary](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/7/78/A_vocabulary_of_the_English_and_Malay_languages%3B_%28IA_anr0813.0002.001.umich.edu%29.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: buat＝做；perbuatan＝做出来的事；再接 -nya＝他或她做的事。记住：做 → 行为 → 其行为。

morphology.pattern_note: is_root、root_word 和 root_jawi 按输入数据保留；实际构词可分析为 pancar 加名词后缀 -an，表示发射出的东西或发射结果，词根不发生音变。因此，输入中的整词词基标记不等于语言学上的不可分析词根。[DBP PRPM：pancaran](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=pancaran)

senses.zh_definition: 从某一来源射出、散发或喷出的光、热、声音、水等；放射或喷射的结果。
senses.en_definition: Light, heat, sound, water, or other material emitted or projected from a source.
senses.ms_definition: Yang dipancarkan atau terpancar, seperti cahaya, haba, bunyi dan air; yang dikeluarkan atau diterbitkan.
senses.nuances: 强调从来源向外发出的东西或现象；不专指有害辐射。pancaran air 通常指喷出的水，也可依词典义指喷水的管口或装置，须结合上下文判断。[DBP PRPM：pancaran](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=pancaran)

senses.zh_definition: 经无线电等设备传送出去的广播或播送内容。
senses.en_definition: A broadcast or transmission sent out by radio or similar equipment.
senses.ms_definition: Siaran yang dipancarkan melalui radio atau alat penyiaran yang lain.
senses.nuances: 侧重节目或信号被发射、传送出去；一般谈节目内容时，siaran 更直接。pemancar 指发射设备，不等于 pancaran。[DBP PRPM：pancaran](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=pancaran)

senses.zh_definition: 某种生活、思想或情感向外呈现的写照、反映或表现。
senses.en_definition: A reflection, representation, or outward expression of something.
senses.ms_definition: Gambaran atau bayangan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 属于比喻用法，常见于文学评论及较有修辞色彩的表达；不是物理意义上的发光。[DBP PRPM：pancaran](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=pancaran)

senses.zh_definition: 后裔；子孙；某一血统延续下来的后代。
senses.en_definition: Descendants or offspring of a particular lineage.
senses.ms_definition: Keturunan.
senses.nuances: 词典收录的少见义项；现代日常表达宜用 keturunan 或 zuriat。以下为帮助理解的组合示例，不应视为现代高频搭配。[DBP PRPM：pancaran](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=pancaran)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Laporan teknikal itu menunjukkan bahawa pancaran cahaya daripada lampu baharu lebih sekata dan meliputi seluruh ruang kerja.

dual_scenarios.en: The technical report shows that the new lights provide more even illumination throughout the workspace.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 这是语体中性的名词，可用于技术报告、新闻和日常描述；用于情感或人生时，会带有较明显的文学色彩。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 描述灯光、水流或广播时可直接使用。谈论家世时，通常选用 keturunan；不要因为词典收录后裔义，就把 pancaran 当作日常询问他人血统的惯用词。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 这是语体中性的名词，可用于技术报告、新闻和日常描述；用于情感或人生时，会带有较明显的文学色彩。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 描述灯光、水流或广播时可直接使用。谈论家世时，通常选用 keturunan；不要因为词典收录后裔义，就把 pancaran 当作日常询问他人血统的惯用词。

etymology.historical_story: Pancaran belongs to the Malay pancar family, with -an forming a noun for what comes forth. Its dictionary meanings connect outward movement with communication and representation: light shines out, broadcasts travel outward, and literature reflects life. These connections provide a useful semantic map, although they do not establish the historical order in which the meanings developed. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=pancaran)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 pancar 想成光或水向外射出，再加 -an：射出来的光、水柱或信号，就是 pancaran。

morphology.formula: ∅ + pemasaran → pemasaran；构词关系：peN- + pasar + -an → pemasaran
morphology.pattern_note: 依所给词根字段按整词列示；实际构词中，peN-…-an 接 pasar，词首 p 被鼻音 m 替换，形成表示活动或过程的名词。

senses.zh_definition: 营销；将商品或服务推向市场、促进其销售的活动或过程。
senses.en_definition: The activity or process of marketing goods or services.
senses.ms_definition: Perihal atau perbuatan memasarkan.
senses.nuances: 可涵盖市场推广、销售渠道和促销等活动，范围通常比 pengiklanan（广告宣传）广。pemasaran 指营销活动，pasaran 指市场或销路。[DBP《Kamus Dewan》](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=pemasaran)

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 这是中性、正式程度适中的商业用语，可用于政府文件、求职面试和同事交流；谈论营销本身无需敬语。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合讨论品牌推广、农产品销路或企业业务。介绍自己的工作可说 Saya bekerja dalam bidang pemasaran（我从事营销工作）；若具体指广告投放，可用更明确的 pengiklanan。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 这是中性、正式程度适中的商业用语，可用于政府文件、求职面试和同事交流；谈论营销本身无需敬语。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合讨论品牌推广、农产品销路或企业业务。介绍自己的工作可说 Saya bekerja dalam bidang pemasaran（我从事营销工作）；若具体指广告投放，可用更明确的 pengiklanan。

etymology.historical_story: Pemasaran belongs to the pasar word family, linking the marketplace with the activity of bringing goods to buyers. Its cultural setting includes smallholders as well as companies: the dictionary illustrates it through agricultural marketing and the Federal Agricultural Marketing Authority. This provides a useful bridge between the familiar physical market and the broader commercial activity called marketing. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=pemasaran)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住中间的 pasar（市场）：把产品带向市场，整个过程就是 pemasaran（营销）。

morphology.pattern_note: peN- 在以 /r/ 开头的 rakam 前取 pe- 形式；词根的 r 保留，首音节 pe 读 /pə/。

etymology.historical_story: Perakam combines a Malay noun-forming prefix with rakam, a root identified in research on Arabic loans as related to Arabic raqm. Malay uses this family for recording and preserving information. The resulting noun can name a recording device, while dictionary examples also extend it to newspapers and magazines that preserve accounts of events. [Loanword research](https://mjs.um.edu.my/index.php/JUD/article/download/4257/2103/10321), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=perakam)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 rakam＝录下来，再加 peN-：perakam 就是“把东西录下来的工具”；rakaman 则是“录下来的内容”。

morphology.pattern_note: peN- 遇词首 s 时通常变为 peny-，原来的 s 脱落，产生 /ɲ/。输入包把 penyamun 标为词根，但 DBP 在 samun 条目下列出该派生词，因此此处纠正其构词分析。

etymology.historical_story: The word illustrates a productive Malay way of naming people by their actions. Samun concerns forcible taking, while peN- forms an agent noun. Their combination changes the initial s into the palatal nasal written ny. This explains why penyamun belongs with menyamun and penyamunan rather than being an unrelated root.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 peN- 看成“做事的人”：samun 是抢劫，penyamun 就是实施抢劫的人；s 换成 ny，记住 peny-amun。

etymology.historical_story: English pulpy combines pulp with the adjective-forming suffix -y. Pulp ultimately traces to Latin pulpa, referring to flesh or a fruit's soft interior. The literary association belongs to pulp publishing, named after inexpensive wood-pulp paper. Thus one English adjective can describe both soft fruit material and sensational popular storytelling. [Etymological account](https://www.etymonline.com/word/pulpy)

etymology.historical_story: Pembuatan shows how Malay builds an abstract process noun around the everyday verb buat, meaning to make or do. The same family distinguishes making, the maker and what is made. Its industrial use brings this ordinary vocabulary into factories and economic reports, while phrases about making cakes or furniture preserve its accessible everyday connection.

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries distinguish lowercase mathematical plus from uppercase PLUS. The mathematical word belongs to the international vocabulary of addition. The road name is an acronym formed from Projek Lebuhraya Utara Selatan. For Malaysian travellers, it also functions as a familiar route name in everyday speech. Its historical expansion should be distinguished from the names of the companies operating the network today. ~ cerai padi yg cepat berbuah dan kecil-kecil buahnya; ~ kernap padi semaian utk menggantikan pokok yg mati; ~ ketam padi pulut; ~ kunca peminjaman wang oleh petani dgn perjanjian akan dibayar dgn padi apabila masak nanti; ~ lekas (radin, ringan) padi yg cepat berbuah; ~ Mahsuri sj padi kacukan (antara padi dr Taiwan dgn padi dr Kedah) yg menghasilkan tanaman dua kali setahun; ~ Malinja sj padi kacukan (antara padi Malaysia, India dan Jepun) yg menghasilkan biji padi yg besar; ~ pulut (sipulut) padi yg berasnya melekat-lekat (biasanya dibuat penganan dll); ~ rambai Kd sj padi yg panjang, berwarna putih (tidak lagi ditanam sekarang); ~ usang a) padi yg lama tersimpan; b) Kl orang tua yg berpengalaman banyak; ~ dikebat dgn daunnya prb mengusahakan sesuatu tidak dgn modal lain tetapi dgn bahagian usaha itu jua; ~ masak jagung mengupih prb keuntungan yg diperoleh dgn berlipat ganda; ~ segenggam dgn senang hati, lebih baik drpd ~ selumbung dgn bersusah hati prb kesenangan hati lebih berharga drpd kekayaan; ~ sekepuk hampa, emas spt loyang, kerbau sekandang jalang prb perihal seseorang yg nampaknya kaya tetapi sebenarnya miskin; ~ selumbung dimakan orang banyak prb hiburan kpd isteri drpd seorang suami yg beristeri lebih drpd satu; ~ setangkai bernas semuanya prb keluarga yg bahagia dan beruntung semuanya; baik membawa resmi ~, jangan membawa resmi lalang = spt buah ~, makin berisi makin rendah, jangan spt lalang, makin lama makin tinggi = spt ilmu ~ kian berisi kian runduk prb semakin berilmu atau tinggi pangkat semakin merendahkan diri (tidak sombong); bukan tanahnya menjadi ~ prb bukan tampannya akan jadi orang baik-baik; jika ada ~, tentu ada hampanya = jika ada ~ berhampalah, jika ada hati berasalah prb siapa yg berasa tersindir, dialah yg berbuat sbg yg disindirkan itu; jika kasih akan ~, buangkanlah akan rumput prb jika kasihkan anak isteri, berhentikanlah drpd mengasihi orang lain; menyisip ~ dgn bilalang (lalang) prb mencampurkan yg baik dgn yg jahat, akhirnya musnahlah yg baik itu; spt ~ hampa, makin lama makin mencongak prb orang sombong yg tidak berilmu, makin lama semakin tinggi cakapnya; tak ada ~ yg bernas setangkai prb tidak ada sesuatu yg sempurna segala-galanya; berpadi 1. mempunyai padi; 2. bertanam (bersawah, berladang) padi; musim beremas kemas, ~ menjadi prb orang berharta dapat mencapai apa yg dikehendakinya; padi-padian segala tumbuhan (rumput) jenis padi. (Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat)
senses.nuances: DBP Kamus Dewan 原始释义（未经人工精编）
